article.articleHeadline: 台灣流感高峰 日本病例暴增 疾管署籲快打疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan's influenza peak; Japan sees surge in cases; Taiwan CDC urges vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's seasonal influenza activity remains volatile near a peak, with Japan and Korea also seeing rising cases. Taiwan's CDC urges rapid vaccination amid multiple holidays and travel. In Japan, nationwide surveillance shows 31,000 influenza cases in the week ending Sept 20, averaging 8.48 cases per facility and up 53% from the prior week, tenfold year-on-year. Detectable viruses are about 98% influenza A(H1N1), and people aged 70+ account for 47.5%. Of Japan's 47 prefectures, 44 report increases, with Okinawa the most affected, followed by Tokyo, Aichi, Kanagawa, and Chiba; the surge is linked to Silver Week, with nine consecutive weeks of rise. Across Asia and the US, influenza activity is also climbing (China, Hong Kong, Korea, Singapore, United States). Taiwan began its flu and COVID vaccination drive on Oct 1; first-day doses reached 266,000 (flu) and 100,000 (COVID), the highest in recent years. Lin Ming-cheng stresses dual vaccination reduces pneumonia and cardiovascular risk; high-risk groups should vaccinate.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾インフルエンザが流行のピーク、日本でも症例急増、疾病管理署がワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の通常の流行報道であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準に該当する異常性は見られない。対象国（中国）は主題ではなく単なる列挙に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾・日本の季節性インフルエンザ流行であり、対象国リストの中国は言及されるのみで主題ではないため除外。毎年の季節性インフルエンザ流行であり、ワクチン接種推奨の通常報道。

article.articleHeadline: 2.675 Penderita TBC Ditemukan di Sulbar Sepanjang 2026, 269 Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2,675 TB patients were found in West Sulawesi throughout 2026; 269 died.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis cases in West Sulawesi, Indonesia, reached 2,675 detected in 2026, with 269 deaths during treatment. The West Sulawesi Health Office (DKPPKB) uses cohort-based evaluation for TB management, noting treatment lasts at least six months. In the 2025 treatment cohort (patients starting in 2024), 3,895 began therapy and 3,358 were cured; 236 defaulted and 231 died. For 2026 (treatment period 2025), 3,942 began treatment and 3,268 completed; 269 died and 173 defaulted. Case-finding has fluctuated in recent years: 2020 estimated 4,445 cases, 2,264 found and 2,067 treated; 2021 2,409 found and 2,239 treated; 2022 2,939 found and 2,781 treated; 2024 found 4,089 and 3,895 started treatment. The data highlight a sustained TB burden in the region, underscoring ongoing needs for case finding and treatment adherence.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年通年で西スラウェシ州にて結核患者2,675人を確認、269人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 結核は地域で継続的に発生している既知の疾患であり、通常の年次統計報告であって異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は地域の既知の風土病であり、統計報告の性質が強い。継続的な症例発生があるためprolonged_exposureはYesとしたが、他の基準は該当せずDISMISS相当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : la pire épidémie de l'histoire du pays franchit la barre des 4 000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the worst epidemic in the country's history has crossed the 4,000-death mark
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola virus disease outbreak has become the country’s deadliest on record, now surpassing 4,000 deaths. The episode is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history and, within a few months, has become the most lethal documented in this vast Central African nation. According to Congolese authorities, the death toll crossed the 4,000 threshold as of Friday, October 2, 2026. The update underscores the sustained severity of the outbreak in the DRC, with authorities providing current tallies on the evolving situation. The article highlights the scale of the epidemic in the DRC and marks a grim milestone in the country’s long history with Ebola, reflecting a public health emergency of significant magnitude.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱:同国史上最悪の流行が死者4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行で死者4,000人を突破し、重大な公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限の可能性もあることからIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: DRC史上17回目のエボラ流行で過去最多の死者数を記録。既に大規模流行として国際的注目度が高く、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ribuan Orang Melarikan Diri dari Kamp Pengungsi yang Terdampak Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands of People Flee from an Ebola-Affected Refugee Camp in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Thousands fled from the Ebola-affected Kigonze refugee camp in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, after a security operation forced many to abandon the site that previously housed about 19,000 people. Residents escaped as security forces entered to seize weapons and members of armed groups, with gunfire reported during the operation. The United Nations warned that the challenge of stopping Ebola transmission in the DRC is becoming harder. A transit center for Ebola at Kigonze was burned down this week, hampering outbreak containment. The facility, run by the International Medical Corps and supported by more than 50 staff, was used to isolate and screen suspected cases before patients were moved on for care. This update is based on UN statements dated 1 October 2026, with the report published on 3 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ被害難民キャンプから数千人が逃走
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行地域で治療・隔離施設が破壊され、住民が大量避難したことで感染拡大のリスクが高まっており、国際的な封じ込め対応への影響が懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 治療施設の焼失と住民の大量避難により、エボラの接触追跡・隔離体制が崩壊するリスクが高い。国連も封じ込めの困難化を警告しており、続報での感染者数・拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Xác định các điểm nguy cơ, phòng chống sốt xuất huyết trong mùa mưa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Identify high-risk areas and dengue fever prevention during the rainy season.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is an acute viral infection transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and is a growing concern in Da Nang City during the rainy season. Laboratory data for January–September 2026 show 39 of 56 tested samples positive (70%), all of dengue virus serotype 2 (D2), a strain linked to severe disease. To curb spread, the Da Nang City Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and partners intensify surveillance, deploy field teams to wards with rising cases, and monitor mosquito density and larval habitats to identify risk points. Interventions include larval source reduction, larviciding, spraying at outbreak sites, and community sanitation. Public messaging spans media, social networks, internet platforms, SMS, and the 1022 hotline. Citizens are urged to check water containers 10–15 minutes daily, cover or discard standing water, participate in vector-control campaigns, consider dengue vaccination for those 4 years and older, and seek prompt medical care for fever.

triage.headline_ja: 高リスク地域の特定と雨季におけるデング熱予防
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダナン市で重症化リスクのあるデング熱血清型2（D2）が高い陽性率で検出されており、地域的な流行拡大の可能性があるが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数等の重症度情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの雨季における毎年の季節性流行であり、当局は既存の国内対応体制（CDC主導のサーベイランス・ベクター対策）で管理している。重症型D2型の高陽性率は注視すべきだが、現時点で異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: What Is Mpox (Monkeypox)?
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) is a viral disease with two clades: Congo Basin (up to 10% mortality) and West African (about 1% mortality; the 2022 outbreak). There is no mpox-specific approved treatment; antivirals developed for smallpox may help, usually reserved for immunocompromised patients: cidofovir, brincidovir (Tembexa), and tecovirimat (Tpoxx). Incubation is 5–21 days; initial flu-like symptoms (fever, headache, muscle aches, lymphadenopathy, fatigue) precede a rash that begins on the face and spreads to the hands and feet. Transmission occurs through close contact with infected people or animals, including respiratory secretions, lesions, or contaminated materials; animal exposure includes bites, scratches, meat, or products. Pregnant individuals can pass the virus to a fetus. Diagnosis relies on PCR from lesion samples. Vaccines: JYNNEOS (two-dose, approved 2019; up to 85% effective; effective within four days of exposure) and ACAM2000 (single-dose). Mpox is typically self-limiting in 14–21 days, though severe disease and complications can occur, especially in children.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox（サル痘）とは何か？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はMpoxに関する一般的な解説記事であり、特定の発生イベントや最新の流行状況を報じるものではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は疾患の一般解説（病態、感染経路、診断、ワクチン等）であり、特定国での発生報告ではない。発生地域フィールド（DRC等）はBluedotの誤分類の可能性が高く、本文に具体的な発生国への言及がないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DRC passes 4,000, as health workers are fighting to get paid
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has killed 4,018 people and infected 8,300, according to Health Ministry figures released on Thursday. The authorities characterize this as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, with ongoing transmission across the DRC challenging containment. The situation is further strained by reports that health workers are fighting to receive pay, potentially affecting the response. These figures—4,018 deaths among 8,300 cases—represent the latest update from the Health Ministry as authorities continue efforts to control transmission in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラ死者数が4,000人を超える、医療従事者は給与未払いに苦しんでいる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が継続中で死者4,018人・感染者8,300人に達し、医療従事者の給与未払いが対応を阻害しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 史上最速拡大とされる大規模流行であり、医療従事者の給与未払いが対応能力に影響する可能性があるため、フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola di Kongo sebabkan 4.018 orang meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kongo causes 4,018 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused more than 4,000 deaths, with nearly 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces as of 2026-10-03. The outbreak records 8,300 cases and 4,018 fatalities, a case-fatality rate of 48.4%, with about 2,162 recoveries. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya warns Ebola poses a threat to neighboring countries. The figures come from Actualite, citing the National Institute for Public Health in Congo (INSP). The report, relayed by Sputnik via ANTARA, notes ongoing transmission across seven provinces and highlights cross-border risk, though it provides no symptom detail or laboratory confirmation specifics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、死者4,018人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で約8,300症例・致死率48.4%という大規模なエボラ流行が7州にわたり継続しており、Africa CDCが近隣国への越境リスクを警告していることからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Africa CDC長官が近隣国への拡大リスクを明言しており、国際的な支援・監視体制の強化が必要な大規模アウトブレイクである。症状詳細や検査確認情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : recul de l'épidémie dans plusieurs zones de santé malgré un bilan dépassant 4.000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: Outbreak wanes in several health zones despite a death toll exceeding 4,000.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) shows localized gains despite a death toll surpassing 4,000. Health authorities report 4,018 deaths among 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases across seven provinces, with 2,162 recoveries and a case-fatality rate of 48.4%. Of 63 health zones affected since the start, 12 have recorded no new cases for 42 days, and eight others no new cases for 22–42 days, indicating regional improvements. Kinshasa health officials say zones are beginning to pre-empt transmission, though insecurity continues to hinder access and hampers case detection and interruption of transmission chains. MSF cautions that the true toll may be higher due to surveillance gaps. Declared in May last year, this outbreak is the largest and deadliest in the DRC and the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ出血熱：死者4,000人超えながら複数の保健地域で流行は後退
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)の流行は8,300例確定・4,018人死亡(致死率48.4%)に達し、史上最大規模かつ治安悪化により対応が困難なため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではアンゴラでの症例拡大について言及がないため、verified_locationsから除外した。治安悪化によるサーベイランス不足で実際の死者数はさらに多い可能性がMSFにより指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo says Ebola outbreak eases in areas despite death toll topping 4,000
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak eases in several areas despite toll topping 4,000. As of 2026-10-03, 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with 2,162 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 48.4%. Of 63 health zones affected since the outbreak began in May, 12 have reported no new cases for 42 days, signaling localized improvement though transmission remains uneven. Health authorities say outbreaks are concentrated in individual health zones rather than provinces. Medecins Sans Frontieres cautioned that the true toll may be higher due to gaps in disease surveillance and case detection. The outbreak is the largest and deadliest ever recorded in the DRC and the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally after 2014-2016 West Africa, continuing to require ongoing monitoring and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、死者4,000人超えるもエボラ流行は一部地域で沈静化と発表
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%・死者4,000人超の大規模エボラ流行で、DRC史上最大規模かつ世界第2位の規模であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文はDRC国内の状況のみを扱っており、Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外した。MSFはサーベイランスの不備により実際の被害はさらに大きい可能性を指摘。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di RD Kongo Renggut Lebih dari 4.000 Jiwa, Angka Kematian Tembus 48 Persen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed more than 4,000 lives, with the mortality rate reaching 48 percent.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has claimed more than 4,000 lives, with a case fatality rate of 48.4%. As of 3 October 2026, nearly 8,300 confirmed Ebola infections have been recorded across seven provinces, including 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries. The high mortality and wide geographic spread underscore a severe public health crisis. Regional and international health authorities are monitoring the situation, with Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya warning that the outbreak now poses a serious cross-border threat to neighboring countries. Efforts are focused on containment to prevent further transmission beyond the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者4,000人超に達し致死率48％に
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ流行で死者4,000人超・致死率48％、7州に拡大し国境を越えた拡散リスクが指摘されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当、社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが近隣国への越境拡大リスクを警告しているが、具体的な越境感染例は記事中には記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 4000명 넘게 사망" 걸리면 둘 중 하나 죽는 에볼라 안 멈추는 민주콩고
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 4,000 deaths: Ebola that kills one in two if infected and shows no sign of stopping in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is experiencing an ongoing Ebola outbreak, its 17th, with over 4,000 deaths. As of September 30, cumulative cases reached 8,300 and deaths 4,018 (case fatality rate 48.4%), with 2,162 recoveries. In roughly one month, deaths rose by about 1,000 since crossing 3,000. The outbreak is far from the West Africa 2014–2016 catastrophe in total, but its mortality burden is exceptionally high. About 100 days after the outbreak declaration in May, deaths are seven times higher than in the same period of the West Africa epidemic. Africa CDC cautions that the apparent slowdown in confirmed cases may reflect reporting gaps and security constraints in affected areas, while MSF warns the true scale of transmission could exceed official counts.

triage.headline_ja: 4,000人超が死亡、感染すれば2人に1人が死亡するエボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で収束の兆しなし
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは致死率48.4%、累計死者4,018人と極めて深刻で、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内の状況のみが述べられており、Angolaへの拡大は言及されていないため除外した。渡航・貿易制限については記事中に明示的記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ludhiana: Anti-dengue drives continue, but stagnant water persists in city pockets
article.articleSummary: Ludhiana, India, faces active dengue transmission with 55 cases reported to date and one new positive case on the day, from 5,787 samples tested as of 3 October 2026. Despite intensified anti-dengue drives, residents in pockets such as Giaspura, Daba, Sherpur, Dhandari Kalan, and Hambra near the Dairy Complex report persistent stagnation: open wastewater, stagnant water, garbage and plastic waste along lanes, and drainage inadequacies that fuel mosquito breeding. Community members criticize the lack of sustained clearance despite complaints and MLA visits, urging comprehensive cleanup and proper drainage rather than only periodic fogging. Municipal commissioner Ojasvi Alankar says fogging and preventive measures are ongoing and will be intensified where problems persist. Civil surgeon contact attempts were not answered. The report highlights ongoing vector-control challenges amid rising dengue surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ルディアナ:デング熱対策活動は継続するも、市内各所に水たまりが残存
triage.triage_reason: インドのルディアナにおける季節性デング熱の通常の発生・対策状況の報告であり、症例数は限定的で異常な拡大や重症化の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 55例という限定的な症例数で、地域の媒介蚊対策・衛生環境に関する地元報道。バングラデシュ・スペインの地域情報は記事主題と無関係（発生地域リストのノイズ）。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en el Congo supera las 4.000 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 4,018 deaths and more than 8,000 confirmed cases since it was declared in May 2026. As of October 2, 2026, there are 8,300 confirmed cases, with the disease spreading to seven of the country’s 26 provinces. The case fatality rate stands at 48.4%; 2,162 patients have recovered and 842 are hospitalized or in isolation. It is the second-deadliest Ebola episode on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (~11,000 deaths, 28,000 cases). Healthcare workers in Bunia, Ituri province, protested over delayed salaries, hindering surveillance; contact tracing is about 80.6%. The Bundibugyo variant has no specific treatment; two vaccines for this variant are in Phase 1 trials, and Congo began using Ervebo (originally for the Zaire variant) in late August. The outbreak also reached Uganda, where WHO declared that episode over on August 26 after 20 cases, 15 imported from DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、8,300症例・4,018人死亡という大規模アウトブレイクで、史上2番目に深刻なエボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの波及は既にWHOにより8月26日に終息宣言済み。医療従事者の給与遅配によるストライキがサーベイランスに支障をきたしている点、接触者追跡率が80.6%にとどまる点は管理可能性の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 男子砍毛竹被刺一下 确诊"七日疯" 小伤口大风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man Pricked While Cutting Bamboo, Diagnosed With “Seven-Day Madness” — Small Wound, Big Risk
article.articleSummary: A 69-year-old man in Zhejiang, China sustained a bamboo puncture on his left forearm. The wound became purulent, and a week later he developed trismus, toothache, back rigidity, and generalized convulsions, progressing to respiratory failure. He was treated at Zhejiang University First Affiliated Hospital Qingchun Campus Emergency Department with CPR, endotracheal intubation, and mechanical ventilation, plus high-dose tetanus immunoglobulin, antibiotics, and electrolyte management, before ICU admission and eventual stabilization. He is nearing discharge. The case highlights tetanus as a toxin-mediated disease caused by Clostridium tetani entering through skin or mucosal wounds and producing toxin in anaerobic conditions, not by wind. The bacterium is widely distributed in soil, dust, rust, and animal or human feces and can persist, reactivating under suitable conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 男子、竹を切る際に刺され負傷「七日風（破傷風）」と診断 ― 小さな傷でも大きなリスク
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個人症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常性や人-人感染リスクはなく、破傷風は既知の非伝染性（感染症ではあるが人から人へは伝播しない）疾患であるため。
triage.notes: 破傷風は土壌中の芽胞菌（Clostridium tetani）による創傷感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。単一症例の医療啓発的記事であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての追跡は不要。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का कहर, 4,000 से ज्यादा मौतें, दुनिया के सबसे तेजी से फैलते प्रकोप ने बढ़ाई चिंता
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages Congo; more than 4,000 deaths; the world's fastest-spreading outbreak has raised concerns.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, Congo (DRC) faces an Ebola outbreak recording 4,018 deaths and over 8,300 confirmed cases. The outbreak began on 15 May with detections of Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare Ebola strain. There is currently no proven effective treatment or approved vaccine for this variant, hindering containment. The World Health Organization warns the virus is rapidly expanding into new health zones, stressing already fragile health systems. Africa CDC notes a recent decline in confirmed cases but cautions that insecurity, conflict, and limited community cooperation likely cause underreporting. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids from infected individuals, and without timely care, severe disease and deaths ensue. Ongoing challenges include surveillance access, outbreak response coordination, and risk communication in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが猛威、死者4,000人超え、世界最速の拡大を見せる感染爆発が懸念を高める
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが4,000人超の死亡、8,300件超の症例を記録し、WHOが新たな保健ゾーンへの急速な拡大を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: 日本流感疫情升溫！沖繩、東京、愛知最嚴重　出國前快打疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Japan's influenza outbreak on the rise: Okinawa, Tokyo, and Aichi are the most severely affected—get vaccinated before you travel abroad.
article.articleSummary: Japan’s influenza outbreak continues rising for the ninth straight week, with Okinawa, Tokyo, Aichi, Kanagawa, and Chiba reporting the highest average cases. Week 38 sentinel data (Sept 14–20) show influenza-like illness at 8.48 per site, up 53.1% from the prior week and about tenfold the same period last year (0.8). Across Japan, 44 of 47 prefectures increased; those aged 70+ accounted for 47.5% of cases. About 98% of circulating viruses are H1N1. The surge coincides with Silver Week travel; influenza activity is also rising in China, Hong Kong, Korea, Singapore, and the United States. Taiwan’s CDC notes government-funded influenza and COVID vaccines began Oct 1; from Oct 1–2, influenza doses reached 601,000 (601k), up 9% year-on-year, and COVID doses 209,000, up 19%. On Oct 2, influenza vaccinations totaled 335,000 in a single day—the highest since the 2021 two-dose rollout. Spokesperson Lin Mingcheng urged eligible individuals to vaccinate, noting vaccines reduce pneumonia and cardiovascular risks.

triage.headline_ja: 日本のインフルエンザ流行が拡大！沖縄・東京・愛知で最も深刻　渡航前のワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1優勢）の急増報道だが、対象国（日本は対象外）における通常の季節流行であり、対象国での顕著な事象は確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は日本国内の季節性インフルエンザ流行であり、対象国リストに日本は含まれない。中国・香港・韓国・シンガポール・米国でも流行上昇との記載があるが、具体的データはなく付随的言及に留まるため、いずれも主題として扱わず verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Quezon regains bird flu-free status
article.articleSummary: Quezon province is declared free of avian influenza by the Department of Agriculture, after depopulation of affected poultry, cleaning and disinfection, movement restrictions, and ongoing disease monitoring following avian influenza cases in Lucban and Sampaloc towns in February and March this year. The declaration, issued by Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel on Sept. 24 under Memorandum Circular No. 45, was officially recognized by a Public Information Office advisory on Oct. 1. Subsequent confirmatory tests yielded negative results, confirming a bird-flu-free status. This status supports safe, orderly production and trade of poultry and poultry products in Quezon and underscores sustained surveillance, biosecurity measures, and programs to protect livelihoods of poultry raisers. Avian influenza is a highly contagious viral disease that circulates among wild aquatic birds and can cause outbreaks in domestic poultry; human infection is rare.

triage.headline_ja: ケソン州、鳥インフルエンザ清浄地域ステータスを回復
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去の鳥インフルエンザ発生地域が清浄化（終息）を宣言したという内容であり、新規の公衆衛生リスクや異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はフィリピン・ケソン州における今年2-3月の鳥インフルエンザ発生が終息し、清浄地域ステータスが回復したことを報告するもの。新規感染や人への感染拡大の報告はなく、トリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal Penyakit Tipes: Penyebab, Gejala Utama dan Cara Pencegahannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understanding Typhoid Fever: Causes, Main Symptoms, and How to Prevent It.
article.articleSummary: Typhoid fever, caused by Salmonella typhi, is an intestinal infection of the small intestine observed in Indonesia, where it remains a common health issue. Transmission occurs through contaminated food and drink, particularly when immunity is low. Main symptoms resemble other bacterial infections but include distinctive features. Hospitalization is not always required; IV fluids, nutrition, and antibiotics are indicated when medical care is necessary. If untreated, typhoid can lead to fatal complications, though rapid medical consultation and early antibiotic therapy in urban areas often yield swift recovery. Treatment centers on antibiotics and dietary management, regardless of care setting. Prevention hinges on vaccination, especially for foreigners or tourists visiting endemic areas like Indonesia, workers with limited access to clean food, and individuals prone to recurrent typhoid. Emphasizing vaccination and hygiene can reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: 腸チフスを理解する：原因、主な症状、予防方法
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、腸チフスに関する一般的な健康啓発・解説記事であり、異常性や緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生事例ではなく、腸チフスの一般的な疫学・予防に関する啓発記事であるため、トリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: ​DR Congo Ebola outbreak deaths surpass 4,000: 5 reasons the deadliest outbreak is still not contained​
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has caused over 4,000 deaths and about 8,300 cases across 63 health zones in seven provinces since May 2026. The Bundibugyo virus lacks a licensed vaccine or targeted treatment, hindering containment compared with past outbreaks. WHO modeling in August suggested true infections may be 3–4 times higher than reported, signaling widespread undetected transmission. Only about 15–20% of confirmed cases were initially listed as known contacts, far below the 90% target. Instability, armed conflict, displacement, and mistrust of outsiders complicate response, with displacement camps attacked near Bunia, forcing about 19,000 people to flee and straining beds, staff, and labs. More than 50 healthcare workers have died; some facilities faced wage strikes. The outbreak is spreading to new areas including Sud Ubangi and Haut-Uélé, and there is no vaccine or cure for Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、死者数4,000人超：封じ込めが未だ実現しない5つの理由
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクが4000人超の死者・8300例を超え、ワクチン・治療法がなく、紛争・避難民問題で封じ込めが困難な深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ型エボラであり、新規地域（Sud Ubangi、Haut-Uélé）への拡大、医療従事者50人以上の死亡、武力紛争による避難民発生など、封じ込め困難な要因が多数報告されている。継続的なモニタリングとフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Japan's influenza cases surge, Taiwan at peak; 335,000 people vaccinated with domestic flu vaccine yesterday, a new single-day high.

Taiwan is at the peak of its domestic flu season, while outbreaks are increasing in Hong Kong, South Korea, and the United States. Over the first two days of the national free flu and COVID-19 vaccination campaign that began October 1, Taiwan reported 601,000 flu shots and 209,000 COVID-19 shots, both above last year’s pace; flu vaccination coverage rose 9% year-on-year and COVID-19 vaccination 19% higher. Yesterday’s flu vaccination reached 335,000 doses, a new single-day high, surpassing the prior record of 318,000 set during the 2021 two-stage rollout. In Japan, 44 of 47 prefectures saw higher counts, led by Okinawa, Tokyo, Aichi, Kanagawa, and Chiba, with 98% of detections due to H1N1 and those aged 70+ making up 47.5%. Silver Week travel is a suspected driver. Vaccination against flu and COVID-19 is emphasized to reduce pneumonia and cardiovascular risk.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Japan's influenza has been on the rise for nine consecutive weeks! Be wary of surging cases in Okinawa, Tokyo, and other areas when traveling abroad.

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Rabies, DP4 Blora Beri Vaksin Gratis untuk Anjing dan Kucing
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Prevent Rabies, DP4 Blora Provides Free Vaccinations for Dogs and Cats.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination for dogs and cats offered free of charge in Blora Regency, Central Java, Indonesia, as part of World Rabies Day 2026. The DP4 Blora (Department of Food, Agriculture, Livestock, and Fisheries) organized the event at UPTD Puskeswan Blora on September 29, 2026, providing rabies vaccination along with routine health checks for companion animals. Of the animals treated, 46 received rabies vaccines while four received health examinations but did not meet vaccination requirements. Officials emphasized that vaccination helps protect pets and prevents rabies transmission to humans, urging owners to maintain regular vaccination and health monitoring. The initiative reflects shared responsibility between government and pet owners to curb rabies in the community.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue death toll in Agusan del Sur reaches 14
article.articleSummary: Agusan del Sur recorded 2,018 dengue cases and 14 deaths from Jan. 1 to Oct. 1, prompting a province-wide outbreak declaration on Sept. 29 and a red-alert status as cases exceeded the epidemic threshold. Provincial Health Office officials described the situation as serious across all ages, with ongoing weekly data reviews from 14 municipalities and Bayugan City. Two fatalities had underlying conditions: a pregnant woman and an elderly patient with heart disease; several patients arrived at hospitals late. Rosario accounted for the most cases (543), followed by San Francisco (271), Bayugan City (229), Loreto (204), and Bunawan (180). Prosperidad reported 114 cases; attack rates included Rosario at 10 per 1,000 residents, Loreto 5, Bunawan 4, and San Francisco & La Paz at 3 each; Bayugan City, Talacogon, San Luis at 2 each.

article.articleHeadline: Phú Thọ phát hiện 102 con lợn nhiễm virus tai xanh trên đường tiêu thụ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Phu Tho detects 102 pigs infected with pseudorabies virus on the way to market.
article.articleSummary: 102 pigs weighing about 10 tons destined for Hanoi were found in Tam Dương commune, Phú Thọ Province, on September 18, suspected of carrying pseudorabies virus (blue-ear disease). Phú Thọ’s Economic Police detected the truck, plate 88C-297.38, driven by P.M.K. The owner, K.V.D., from Lập Thạch, Phú Thọ, admitted purchasing the animals from a farm in Đạo Trù, Phú Thọ, and transporting them to Hanoi for sale. No veterinary-inspection registration was observed. Random testing yielded 3 of 10 samples positive for PRRS North American lineage, the pathogen associated with blue-ear disease in pigs. Authorities quarantined the batch, implemented disease-control measures per veterinary protocols, and are coordinating with local authorities to trace sources and restrict movement to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: フート省で輸送中の豚102頭が青耳病ウイルス（PRRS）に感染していることが判明
triage.triage_reason: 動物の家畜疾病（豚のPRRS/青耳病）事例であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は報告されておらず、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: PRRS（豚繁殖・呼吸障害症候群、通称青耳病）はヒトに感染しない家畜疾病であり、人獣共通感染症ではない。記事は食品安全・検疫違反の文脈であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 男子上山砍毛竹，突然被刺一下，3天后全身抽搐，呼吸衰竭，医生：确诊"七日疯"，放任不管，致死率或达100%_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man goes up a mountain to cut Moso bamboo, is suddenly stabbed; three days later he develops generalized convulsions and respiratory failure, doctors diagnose "Seven-Day Madness," left untreated, mortality rate could reach 100%.
article.articleSummary: A 69-year-old man in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China developed tetanus after a bamboo puncture wound sustained while cutting Moso bamboo. Initial wound infection appeared to heal, but three days later he suffered toothache, jaw-opening difficulty (trismus), neck and back stiffness, then generalized convulsions and respiratory failure. Clinically diagnosed with tetanus, he was transferred to Zhejiang University First Hospital (Qingchun Campus) where resuscitation, endotracheal intubation, and mechanical ventilation were provided alongside high-dose tetanus immunoglobulin, antibiotics, electrolyte correction, and ICU monitoring; he subsequently stabilized for discharge. Tetanus is caused by Clostridium tetani spores in anaerobic wounds; incubation ranges from 1 day to months, often around day 7 (Seven-Day Madness). Without treatment, mortality nears 100%; even with comprehensive care, global case-fatality is about 30–50%. Diagnosis is clinical; no rapid diagnostic test exists. Prevention relies on vaccination, proper wound care, and timely medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 男性が山で竹を伐採中に刺傷、3日後に全身けいれん・呼吸不全、医師は「七日風（破傷風）」と診断、放置すれば致死率100%の恐れ
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の破傷風であり、人-人感染がなく公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められないため見送り。
triage.notes: 破傷風は感染症の中でもヒト-ヒト感染がなく、単発の外傷症例であるためシグナルトリアージの対象外。中国での事例だが公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Miles de personas huyen de un campamento de desplazados afectado por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands of People Flee from a Displaced Persons Camp Affected by Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-03, thousands fled the Ebola-affected displacement camp of Kigonze in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where about 19,000 people are housed. The incident occurred amid rising insecurity, with reports that soldiers entered the camp to search for weapons and individuals suspected of belonging to non-state armed groups, and gunfire was heard. The UN notes that violence, threats, and intimidation have forced families to flee and have impeded humanitarian access. The report provides no details on Ebola case counts or laboratory confirmation in this event. The episode underscores how insecurity around displacement sites can complicate outbreak response and aid delivery in the region.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: l'épidémie franchit le seuil des 4000 morts malgré l'optimisme du ministre de la Santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak crosses the 4,000-death threshold despite the health minister's optimism
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths amid more than 8,300 confirmed cases, the deadliest outbreak in the country’s history. As of 3 October 2026, authorities report 19 of 63 health zones with no cases for at least three weeks, while 44 zones remain active. Transmission persists in Beni, Butembo, and Katwa in North Kivu, where insecurity and community resistance hinder response teams. More than half of deaths occur outside health facilities, increasing risk during home care and funerals. Case tracking lags, with contact tracing around 82%, far from the 95% target needed to interrupt transmission chains. The government seeks fresh funding and greater oversight of hundreds of millions mobilized abroad by humanitarian actors. Of the initial 226 million USD response plan, just over half has been justified to the government.

article.articleHeadline: In 1902, Hanoi paid people for rat tails to fight plague; more than 55 million tails were collected, but the rats were still alive
article.articleSummary: During 1902 in Hanoi, then French Indochina, plague-driven rat bounty paid one cent per rat tail; within a year, over 55 million tails submitted, yet many tailless rats remained alive, revealing that tails served as proof of kill, not proof of removal. Officials observed tailless rats still in sewer-linked streets, and rat catchers released animals after payment. The episode, part of the Third Plague Pandemic, is cited in a 2026 npj Biodiversity review (as of 2026-10-03) as an example of unintended outcomes from species bounty programs. The authors, analyzing 283 species across 449 programmes in 60 countries over eight centuries, note that financial rewards can increase participation but also drive fraud, poaching, or preservation of target species. Other cases include Britain’s grey squirrel bounty and discussions of the cobra effect; some schemes fail to reduce populations while altering incentives.

article.articleHeadline: Lagi Musim Flu, Mungkinkah Ayam Peliharaan di Rumah Ikut Ketularan?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It's Flu Season—Could Pet Chickens at Home Also Catch the Flu?
article.articleSummary: Influenza in humans (seasonal flu) and avian influenza (H5N1) are both influenza A but differ in transmission risk to poultry. There is currently no evidence that seasonal human flu strains (H1N1 pdm09, H3N2) spread from people to chickens, though cross-species transmission can occur in some animals (e.g., pigs) and not necessarily in poultry. Avian influenza can spread from infected birds to humans via contact or contaminated environments. Infected poultry may exhibit respiratory distress and high mortality; autopsies can reveal bleeding from the nose to the lungs, but symptoms can resemble other poultry diseases, requiring laboratory confirmation. Biosecurity measures such as mask use, disinfection, and keeping clean coops are advised. Owning backyard chickens does not automatically elevate flu risk—the main concern is exposure to infected birds or contaminated surroundings. Indonesia’s Health Ministry reports rising influenza activity and continues to provide healthcare facilities and medications as of Sept 28, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: l'épidémie franchit le seuil des 4000 morts malgré l'optimisme du ministre de la Santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the epidemic has crossed the 4,000-death threshold despite the Health Minister's optimism.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths as of early October 2026, despite optimism from Health Minister Roger Kamba. In North Kivu, major cities Beni, Butembo, and Katwa remain active sites, with insecurity and community resistance hindering response teams. While 19 of 63 health zones have not reported a new case for at least three weeks, 44 zones continue to register transmission. A troubling pattern is that more than half of deaths occur outside health facilities, raising transmission risks during home care and funerals. Contact tracing stands at 82%, far below the 95% target needed to break transmission chains. The government seeks new funding oversight, demanding clarity on hundreds of millions mobilized abroad by humanitarian partners. Of the $226 million in the first response plan, just over half has been accounted for to Congolese authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:流行が4000人の死者数を超える、保健大臣の楽観論にもかかわらず
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の死者数が4000人を超え、44地域で感染が継続、接触者追跡率も目標未達であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 治安不安と地域社会の抵抗が対応を妨げており、死者の半数以上が医療施設外で発生していることから、家庭内看護や葬儀を通じた感染拡大リスクが高い。資金の透明性を巡る政府と人道支援団体間の緊張も継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola di Kongo Makin Mengerikan, 4.018 Orang Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo Is Getting More Terrifying, 4,018 People Dead
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is worsening. As of 2026-10-03, the outbreak has been confirmed across seven provinces with more than 8,300 cases and at least 4,018 deaths; 2,162 people have recovered, yielding a case fatality rate of about 48.4%. The seven-province tally reported by Actualite, via INSP, notes ongoing transmission and substantial mortality. In an earlier daily update, INSP recorded 6,186 confirmed cases and 3,007 deaths, with 86 new cases and 57 deaths in the previous 24 hours. Health authorities, including Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya, warn the virus could threaten neighboring countries while containment and treatment efforts continue. The report emphasizes public-health responses, without detailing infection sources or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱がさらに深刻化、死者4,018人
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7州にわたりエボラ出血熱が拡大し、致死率約48.4%、8,300例超・死者4,018人と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、周辺国への波及リスクも指摘されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: Africa CDC長が周辺国への拡大リスクを警告しており、国際的拡大の懸念が明示されている。致死率約48.4%と極めて高く、継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo says Ebola outbreak eases in areas despite death toll topping 4,000
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-02, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows localized improvement but remains deadly. Authorities report 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with a case fatality rate of 48.4% and 2,162 recoveries. Of 63 health zones affected since the outbreak began in May, 12 have reported no new cases for 42 days, indicating the outbreak is now concentrated in individual health zones rather than provinces. Health Minister Roger Kamba, speaking in Kinshasa, described the situation as highly variable but improving in parts of the country. Medecins Sans Frontieres warns the official toll may undercount the true impact due to surveillance and case-detection gaps. The outbreak is the largest and deadliest on record in the DRC and the second largest globally.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の発生は一部地域で沈静化も死者数は4000人を超えたと発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（死者4,018人、致死率48.4%）が継続しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCで記録上最大・最も致死率の高いエボラ流行が継続中。63保健地区中12地区で42日間新規症例なしと改善傾向も見られるが、MSFは公式統計が実態を過小評価している可能性を指摘しており、サーベイランス・症例検出のギャップが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak exceeds 8 000 cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpasses 8,000 cases, with 8,067 cases, 3,901 deaths and 2,070 recoveries (48.4% fatality) since mid-May, the worst in the country’s history. The outbreak began in Ituri province and has spread to seven provinces, with Ituri, North Kivu and Upper-Uele accounting for the majority. Case numbers have levelled off, but Africa CDC says the outbreak is not under control. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; there is no approved vaccine or treatment, though several therapies and vaccines are in trials. The response is hampered by scarce resources in remote areas, armed groups restricting movement, and mistrust fueling violence against humanitarian staff, including a health worker killed at a North Kivu checkpoint. A complete shortage of stocks of an experimental Bundibugyo vaccine exists in Tshopo; Ervebo vaccine against the Zaire strain has begun to be administered to frontline staff in a trial. About 70,000 doses were allocated in August, and the United States pledged $267 million last week.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、症例数が8,000例を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクがDRCで7州に拡大し、国際支援（米国の資金拠出）が行われるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラアウトブレイク。Bundibugyo株で承認ワクチン・治療薬なし、武装勢力による活動妨害・医療従事者への暴力も発生。米国が2.67億ドルを拠出するなど国際的関与が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: 飛日本小心「流感連升9週」！東京、沖繩病例暴增 疾管署揭1招護肺顧心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be careful when traveling to Japan: 'Influenza rising for nine consecutive weeks'! Tokyo and Okinawa cases surge; Taiwan CDC reveals one tip to protect the lungs and heart.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity is rising in Japan for a ninth consecutive week, with Okinawa, Tokyo, and Aichi reporting the highest case counts. Across Japan, 44 of 47 prefectures show increases; Kanagawa and Chiba among top areas. The surge, starting around week 30, may be linked to travel during Silver Week. The H1N1 strain remains dominant, and adults aged 70 and older account for about 47.5% of cases. Taiwan’s CDC notes rising influenza activity in neighboring countries—China, Hong Kong, Korea, and Singapore—and also in the United States. In response, Taiwan began the 'Left-Flow, Right-New' vaccination program on October 1, encouraging people to receive influenza and COVID-19 vaccines to reduce severe disease. Vaccination uptake has been strong: influenza doses around 601,000; COVID doses around 209,000, both higher than last year; flu shots hit a daily record of 335,000 on Oct 2, the highest since 2021.

triage.headline_ja: 日本への渡航は要注意『インフルエンザ9週連続増加』！東京・沖縄で症例急増 台湾疾管署が肺と心臓を守る一つのコツを公開
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行拡大に関する情報であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当せず、対象国における新規・異常な公衆衛生事象とは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は日本の季節性インフルエンザ流行および台湾の予防接種キャンペーンであるが、日本・台湾・韓国・香港・シンガポール・米国は対象国リストに含まれない。中国（香港含む）のみ対象国として言及されているが、具体的な感染状況の詳細は乏しく、単なる近隣国の動向報告に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: 秋天仍要防登革熱！台南增第9例境外移入 查獲1287個陽性孳生容器
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Autumn Dengue Prevention Still Essential! Tainan Reports 9th Imported Case; 1,287 Positive Breeding Containers Seized.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports continued dengue activity in 2026. In Tainan, on Oct 2, 2026, one imported dengue case was confirmed: a Filipino man in his 20s from Gangqian Li, Xinshi District, who developed fever and headache on Sept 29, flew through Kaohsiung airport on Oct 1 after an NS1 positive at airport quarantine, with PCR confirmation on Oct 2. This marks Tainan’s ninth imported case of the year; the patient is hospitalized until viremia resolves. Nationwide, through Oct 2, 2026, 179 dengue cases have been recorded, including 12 local transmissions and 167 imported, with Vietnam the top source, followed by Indonesia, the Philippines, the Maldives, and Malaysia. Authorities emphasize continued vigilance as daytime temperatures (25–27°C) favor Aedes mosquitoes. The Dengue Prevention Center reports 1,287 positive breeding containers from January–September (63.4% barrels, jars, pots) and promotes inspect, drain, clear, scrub. Clinicians are urged to apply TOCC screening and NS1 testing for travellers with fever and suspected dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 秋もデング熱警戒が必要！台南で第9例目の海外渡航歴ありの輸入症例を確認、陽性ボウフラ発生容器1,287個を摘発
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入例・散発的な国内感染であり、既知の季節性デング熱対策の一環。対象国リストに該当する国での発生事例ではなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（台南・高雄）における輸入デング熱症例の報告であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピン・モルディブ・マレーシアは輸入元として言及されているのみで、各国での発生が主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 4.000 muertos en República Democrática del Congo por un brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused more than 4,000 deaths and surpassed 8,000 confirmed cases (4,018 deaths among 8,300 cases; 2,162 recoveries; case fatality rate ~48.4%). Detected mid-May in Ituri province (northeast), it has spread to northern and eastern regions. Ongoing armed conflict, displacement, and limited healthcare access hinder containment. In North Kivu, four deaths have occurred among six cases; area controlled by anti-government M23 group. Violence has displaced over 5,000 people per UN; a transit center for Ebola patients was burned after soldiers entered a displacement camp; a contractor involved in case finding was killed at a health center. Population distrust complicates prevention and contact tracing. Vaccines and therapies are under study; Bundibugyo genotype drives this outbreak. The Ervebo vaccine is being administered to frontline workers as part of a clinical trial, previously shown effective against the Zaire variant. France allocated €13.4 million (Jan–Jul) and the United States €237 million to bolster the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行により4,000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%・8,300例超・4,000人以上の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、武力紛争による対応困難・国際支援(米仏の資金拠出)も確認されるためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスの資金拠出はDRC国内への支援であり、米国・フランス自体での発生ではないためverified_locationsから除外。武力紛争(M23支配地域)による対応妨害が流行拡大の主要因。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात में डेंगू के 24 नए मामले, यूपी-बिहार से 'राष्ट्रीय एकता दिवस' परेड शामिल होने गए लोग पड़े बीमार - gujarat dengue 24 new cases before national unity day parade maharashtra up bihar attendees test positive
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 24 new dengue cases in Gujarat, people who had gone from Uttar Pradesh and Bihar to participate in the National Unity Day parade fell ill.
article.articleSummary: Laboratory-confirmed dengue cases total 24 in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, amid National Unity Day preparations. Participants from Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Kerala, Bihar and Chhattisgarh gathered for the October 31 parade at Unity Nagar and were housed in a large Gandhinagar hostel complex. At Gandhinagar Civil Hospital, 34 people were admitted on Thursday; 23 were dengue-confirmed. By Friday afternoon, five more admissions occurred, including one additional confirmed case and four suspected. About 10 patients have been discharged; the remainder are stable with no severe complications reported. Most confirmed patients are aged 25–30 years. Transmission source has not been officially determined. Public health authorities in the district and state have been alerted for formal investigations; emergency room activity has not spiked beyond those hospitalized."

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でデング熱24件の新規確認、UP州・ビハール州から「国民統一の日」パレード参加者が発症
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドで季節性・流行性の疾患であり単発のクラスターは通常対応可能だが、複数州からの参加者間での集団発生であり感染源未特定のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 重症例なし、国内の地方公衆衛生当局が調査中。デング熱はインドの流行地域で季節性に発生するため特段の異常性は低いが、複数州からの参加者間クラスターのため感染源調査の続報を注視。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Travel Alert: Japan's flu has risen for nine consecutive weeks, with these three areas more severely affected; Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Korea are also on the rise.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan CDC reports Japan's influenza activity has risen for nine consecutive weeks, with Okinawa, Tokyo, Aichi, Chiba, and Kanagawa the hardest hit among Japan's 47 prefectures. In Week 38 (Sept 14–20), influenza-like illness averaged 8.48 cases, up 53.1% from the previous week and tenfold the year-ago level, with H1N1 as the dominant strain. The public-funded influenza vaccination campaign rapidly expanded, surpassing 600,000 doses in two days. With Silver Week holidays (Sept 19–23) drawing crowds, travelers are advised to take preventive precautions. Beyond Japan, influenza activity is rising in China, Hong Kong, Korea, Singapore, and the United States. Authorities emphasize vigilance for travelers returning from affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 海外渡航注意！日本のインフルエンザが9週連続で増加、特に3地域で深刻　中国・香港・韓国・シンガポールでも上昇

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak eases in some zones as deaths top 4,000
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, declared in May, has claimed 4,018 lives among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with a case fatality rate of 48.4% and 2,162 recoveries. Health authorities report easing in several areas, with 12 of 63 health zones reporting no new cases for 42 days. The outbreak remains concentrated in individual health zones rather than provinces. MSF cautions the true toll may be higher due to gaps in surveillance and case detection. Escalating violence in eastern DRC hampers response; a key transit centre for suspected patients was destroyed at the Kigonze displacement camp in Ituri province. The outbreak is the largest and deadliest in the DRC and the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally after the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の流行が一部地域で沈静化も死者数は4000人を超える

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് വൈറൽ പനിയും പകർച്ചവ്യാധികളും പടരുന്നു. ആശുപത്രികളിൽ രോഗികളുടെ വൻ തിരക്ക്. ഇന്നലെ മാത്രം 6,689 പേർക്ക് വൈറൽ പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു. മലപ്പുറം ജില്ലയിലാണ് ഏറ്റവും കൂടുതൽ പനി ബാധിതരുള്ളത്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral fevers and infectious diseases spreading across the state; hospitals see a heavy rush of patients; yesterday alone, 6,689 people diagnosed with viral fever; Malappuram district has the highest number of fever cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, Kerala's health department reports a continuing surge of viral fevers and related illnesses. Yesterday, 6,689 people were diagnosed with viral fever across the state, with Malappuram district recording the highest burden, as 1,423 people sought treatment there. Dengue fever cases rose, with 35 laboratory-confirmed dengue diagnoses yesterday, while about 20 chickenpox cases have been reported this month. Palakkad, Kasaragod, and Thiruvananthapuram districts also show sharp rises in fever cases. Hospitals face heavy patient inflows, and medicine shortages persist, aggravated by delays in stock arrivals from other states. The health department says there is no immediate cause for alarm, but fears persist among the public due to drug shortages and ongoing transmission, prompting calls for urgent government action to ensure medicines and supplies.

triage.headline_ja: 州内でウイルス性発熱と感染症が拡大、病院は患者で混雑。昨日だけで6,689人がウイルス性発熱と確認され、マラプラム県で最多の患者が発生
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州でデング熱・水痘を含むウイルス性発熱が継続的に拡大し、医薬品不足や住民の不安など社会的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱・水痘・ウイルス性発熱の増加であり、保健当局は「直ちに警戒すべき状況ではない」としているが、医薬品不足と患者急増による社会的懸念が報告されている。重症度・死亡例に関する情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: 24 National Unity Day Parade Personnel Test Positive For Dengue In Gujarat
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak linked to Rashtriya Ekta Diwas preparations in Gujarat. In Gandhinagar, 24 confirmed dengue cases among security and cultural contingents hospitalized out of 34 brought to Gandhinagar Civil Hospital; five more admissions by Friday afternoon included one confirmed and four suspected infections. About 10 patients have recovered. Affected individuals are predominantly 25–30 years old and traveled from across India, including Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Kerala, Bihar and Chhattisgarh, staying at a large hostel in Gandhinagar. The source of transmission is not yet formally identified. Rashtriya Ekta Diwas events are scheduled for Oct 30–31, with a parade at Ekta Nagar on Oct 31 and thousands of participants. Epidemiological teams are surveying accommodations, implementing vector-control measures, and expanding diagnostics. No wider spike in city emergency admissions reported. Gujarat’s dengue season has seen over 2,100 cases from more than 135,000 diagnostic samples.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州の国民統合記念日パレード要員24名がデング熱陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 特定の集団（パレード参加者）における局地的なデング熱クラスターであり、インドの季節性デング流行の一環とみられる。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、大規模イベント前の感染拡大状況として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで季節性に流行している感染症であり、本件は国民統合記念日の大規模集会前に発生した局地的クラスター。感染源は特定されておらず、ベクター対策が実施中。10月30-31日の大規模イベント開催を控え、感染拡大の可能性を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Covid, torna a crescere il virus in Europa? L'esperto: "Attenzione alla nuova PJ.2.1, è l'osservata speciale"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID, is the virus growing again in Europe? The expert: "Watch out for the new PJ.2.1, it's the variant under special surveillance."
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is resurfacing in Europe, with France reporting an uptick in cases by late September 2026, though overall circulation remains low and no alarm is raised in Italy or across Europe. Italian expert Federico Gueli describes a normal seasonal resurgence linked to school reopening. The WHO tracks four Variants Under Monitoring: XFG and NB.1.8.1, plus BA.3.2 (a South African lineage impacting children) and PQ.16.1.1 (China-origin, D420N). PQ.16.1.1 spread across Asia, the US, and Oceania but has limited impact in Western populations with existing immunity. Since spring 2025 no global-dominant variant has emerged; variants are localized and fragmented, with BA.3.2 and NB.1.8.1's lead contested by XFG. The current trend is post-pandemic, with higher immunity reducing super-spreading events. A new PJ.2.1 variant is under special surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: COVID、欧州で再び感染拡大?専門家「新変異株PJ.2.1に注意、特別監視対象」
triage.triage_reason: 季節的な感染再燃であり、専門家も警戒不要としている。重症度や異常性を示す情報はなく、対象国（中国含む）における主体的な発生も確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は欧州（主にフランス・イタリア）における季節的なCOVID-19増加を扱っており、中国はPQ.16.1.1変異株の起源として言及されているのみで、中国国内の発生状況が主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A di Tangerang tembus 30 ribu kasus dalam 9 bulan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases in Tangerang surpass 30,000 in nine months.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A exposure in Tangerang Regency, Banten Province, Indonesia, reached 30,000 cases from January through September 2026. The Tangerang Health Office (Dinkes) head Hendra Tarmizi attributes the surge to extreme weather and prolonged dust pollution from a long dry season. Monthly counts rose from the usual 20,000–25,000 to about 28,000–30,000, with Aug–Sep 2026 showing an increase of roughly 5,000 cases per month. Several healthcare facilities have not conducted laboratory tests to detect Influenza A subtypes, though most acute respiratory infections (ISPA) are attributed to influenza viruses. Transmission is described as rapid, similar to COVID-19, via close contact and droplets. The rise affects all age groups and is spread across all 29 districts of Tangerang Regency. Prevention emphasizes maintaining immune defenses and adhering to health protocols to reduce close contact with cases.

triage.headline_ja: タンガラン県でインフルエンザA感染者が9か月間で3万件突破
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ様疾患(ISPA)の増加が報告されているが、サブタイプ検査未実施で重症度・死亡例等の情報が不足しており、新規病原体や異常事態と断定できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・タンゲラン県における通常のインフルエンザ様疾患(ISPA)増加を報告したものであり、乾季・大気汚染が主要因とされている。ラボでのサブタイプ確認が行われておらず、実際の病原体や重症度は不明。続報でラボ確認結果や死亡例の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 連假出國注意！日本沖繩、東京等地流感病例大增 中港韓星也升溫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Holiday travel alert! Flu cases surge in Okinawa and Tokyo, Japan, and Mainland China, Hong Kong and Korean stars are also heating up.
article.articleSummary: Japan reports a flu surge, especially in Okinawa and Tokyo. In the 38th week (Sept 14–20), influenza-like illness sentinel data show an average of 8.48 cases, up more than 50% from the prior week and tenfold year-on-year, with H1N1 accounting for 98% of detections. Those aged 70+ constitute about 47.5% of cases. Of 47 prefectures, 44 saw increases; Okinawa, Tokyo, Aichi, Kanagawa, and Chiba were highest, possibly linked to Silver Week travel. Separately, flu activity is rising in China, Hong Kong, South Korea, and Singapore. Public-funded vaccination for influenza and COVID-19 begins in October, with Stage 1 from Oct 1 for seniors 65+, Indigenous 55+, preschoolers (6 months–before primary), high-risk groups, pregnant women, parents of infants, and care/health staff; Stage 2 from Nov 2 expands to adults 50+ with no high-risk chronic disease. Oct 1–2 totals: influenza vaccines 601,000 doses; COVID vaccines 209,000, with a daily flu vaccination record of 335,000 on Oct 2.

triage.headline_ja: 連休の海外渡航に注意！日本の沖縄・東京等でインフルエンザ急増、中国・香港・韓国・シンガポールでも上昇
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1主体）が日本で前週比50%増・前年比10倍という異常な増加を示し、中国・香港・韓国・シンガポールでも同時に上昇傾向が見られるため、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高まりからフルRRAでの確認が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は日本（沖縄・東京等）のインフルエンザ流行であり、日本・韓国・香港・シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国（香港含む）については『flu activity is rising』と明記されているため対象国として含めた。H1N1は季節性株であり新型株出現の情報はない。重症度（入院・死亡）に関する具体的データは記事になく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Plague in Russia? Lab worker dies in Siberia, hospital quarantined
article.articleSummary: Laboratory worker in Russia’s Irkutsk region, Siberia, died of plague, prompting hospital quarantine and medical observation for about 200 people. The Irkutsk anti-plague institute employee, Daria Sh. (27–28), was hospitalized in Shelekhov with severe pneumonia, placed on a ventilator, and died Thursday; officials have described the illness as a particularly dangerous infection, with media outlets noting suspected pneumonic plague. The death report includes an unconfirmed claim that she broke a test tube containing live bacteria. The case involves Yersinia pestis, the plague bacterium, with incubation typically 1–7 days. WHO notes human plague remains endemic in several countries, with most 2019–2025 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar. The last major plague pandemic began in Yunnan, China (1855–c.1960). The incident coincides with hospital quarantine and ongoing exposure monitoring in Irkutsk.”} }{}{

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト？ 作業員がシベリアで死亡、病院が隔離
triage.triage_reason: シベリアの研究所職員が肺ペスト疑いで死亡し、約200人が観察下に置かれ病院が隔離されるなど、重篤性・異常性ともに高い事例であるため。
triage.notes: 事例はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。記事中のDRC・マダガスカル・中国（雲南省）はWHOの疫学的背景情報・歴史的パンデミック言及であり、現事例の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza di Indonesia Naik, Kenali Gejala dan Penanganannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza Cases in Indonesia Rise; Learn the Symptoms and Their Management.
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases rise in Indonesia, with Jakarta-based Health Ministry (Kemenkes) data cited by Bisnis.com showing a late-September 2026 uptick (week 38). Of 265 specimens tested, 148 were positive for influenza (56% positivity), reflecting seasonal activity rather than a crisis. Influenza, primarily caused by influenza A and B, circulates in Indonesia’s tropical climate, aided by seasonal transition and increased mobility. Common symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, muscle aches, headache, and fatigue; most patients recover within about one week, and many do not require hospitalization, though complications can threaten the young, elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities. Management emphasizes rest, hydration, and acetaminophen or ibuprofen for symptoms; antibiotics and aspirin should be avoided in children. No current emergency status; guidance urges staying home to limit transmission. Locations: Indonesia, Jakarta.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアでインフルエンザ患者数が増加、症状と対処法を知る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の増加であり、緊急事態との明言もなく、重症化や異常性を示す情報もないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、緊急性や異常な拡大の兆候はない。

Individuals aged 70+ comprise 47.5% of cases. The surge is likely linked to Silver Week travel. Oct 1–2 totals: flu vaccines 601k, COVID vaccines 209k (YoY +9% and +19%); Oct 2 daily flu shots 335k, a record higher than 318k on Oct 3, 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 連休中の海外渡航ではインフルエンザに注意　日本の沖縄・東京などで流行拡大

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يحصد أكثر من 4 آلاف وفاة في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims more than 4,000 lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Across the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola has claimed more than 4,000 lives amid 8,300 confirmed cases and 2,162 recoveries, in the nation’s seventeenth outbreak. Originating in Ituri province in the northeast, the outbreak has spread to seven provinces in the north and east, with response hampered by resource shortages, armed groups, and public distrust. In North Kivu, the M23 movement, backed by Rwanda, has reported 6 Ebola cases, including 4 deaths, in areas under its control. The latest data underscore the severity of the seventh and ongoing outbreak. Friday's update documents 8,300 infections, 4,018 deaths, and 2,162 recoveries as the outbreak remains active.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で死者4000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ大規模アウトブレイク(8,300症例、死者4,000人超)が7州に拡大し、武装勢力の影響で対応が妨げられており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ルワンダは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではRwanda領内での感染事例は言及されておらず、M23勢力の背景説明のみのため verified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 台南第9例登革熱境外移入　菲律賓男移工入境檢出
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan's ninth imported dengue fever case; Filipino male migrant worker detected on entry.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its ninth imported dengue fever case in Tainan City: a Filipino male migrant worker in his 20s. He developed fever and headache while in the Philippines on Sept 29, arrived at Kaohsiung International Airport on Oct 1, and tested NS1 positive at quarantine, subsequently hospitalized in Tainan. Dengue was laboratory-confirmed on Oct 2. He had planned to work in Xinshi District, Tainan, and did not enter the community during hospitalization; investigators conducted health education, residence/workplace inspections, and mosquito-control measures. Nationally, Taiwan totals 179 dengue cases (12 locally acquired, 167 imported) as of Oct 2, with imported infections mainly from Vietnam, followed by Indonesia, the Philippines, the Maldives, and Malaysia.

triage.headline_ja: 台南第9例の輸入性デング熱、入国時にフィリピン人男性移工から検出
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入性デング熱の個別症例であり、検疫で検出・隔離管理されているため公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。フィリピンは感染源国として言及されているが、発症・感染自体はフィリピン国内での曝露によるものであり、対象国での新規発生事例ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国リスト外）での輸入症例報告。フィリピンは感染源として言及されているのみで、フィリピン国内での感染拡大事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 傳老撾百萬頭瘟豬進入中國 被製成臘肉熟食已有人中毒(圖) - 大陸時政 -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reported: One million swine fever–infected pigs from Laos have entered China and been processed into cured pork products and other ready-to-eat meats; at least one person has been poisoned (Photo).
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks in Laos and Vietnam have raised cross-border fears in China. Lao authorities report ASF spread to 7 provinces and 91 counties, with 14,002 pigs dead, prompting nationwide bans on inter-provincial transport of live pigs and pig products and prohibiting live-pig imports. In Vietnam, outbreaks have been reported in a northern province (Thai Nguyen) and in the southern Kiên Giang Province, with the latter accounting for 16 outbreaks this year affecting about 88 farms. In China, reports from social platforms claim large numbers of dead pigs from Laos are entering the mainland and being processed into cured pork products and ready-to-eat meats; meanwhile, multiple Chinese regions—including Jiangxi, Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, Hunan, and Chongqing—face rising ASF risk and associated transport/hygiene concerns. Official Chinese updates mention only a September report of swine O-type foot-and-mouth disease in Chongqing; the authenticity of broader claims is questioned. At least one poisoning case linked to the meat has been reported (Staphylococcus aureus).

triage.headline_ja: 老挝から大量のアフリカ豚熱感染豚が中国に流入し、燻製・加工肉に製造されたとの情報、既に中毒者が発生（写真）
triage.triage_reason: ラオス・ベトナムでのASF拡大に伴い、中国本土への家畜由来製品流入と複数省での感染リスク上昇が報告され、国際的拡大と貿易・輸送制限（省間輸送禁止、輸入禁止）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: ASF自体はヒトに感染しない動物疾病だが、SNS上の未確認情報（ラオス産死亡豚の加工肉流入）と食中毒事例（黄色ブドウ球菌、別病原体）が混在している点に留意。中国当局は9月の重慶での豚O型口蹄疫のみ公式確認しており、広範な流入の真偽は未確認。ラオスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 传老挝百万头瘟猪进入中国 被制成腊肉熟食已有人中毒(图) - 大陆时政 -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Report: A million swine fever–infected pigs from Laos have entered China and have been processed into cured pork and ready-to-eat foods; at least one person has been poisoned (Photo) - Mainland Politics.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks are spreading from Laos into neighboring Vietnam, raising concerns for China. Laos reports ASF across seven provinces and 91 counties, with 14,002 pig deaths, prompting bans on inter-provincial movement of live pigs and pig products and a prohibition on importing live pigs. Vietnam records new ASF activity in Son La with additional cases in the south. In China, posts from farmers warn of rising ASF risk in East, South and Southwest provinces, including Jiangxi, Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, Hunan and Chongqing, noting high-risk contract-rearing and fattening farms and cross-border transmission risks. A circulating Oct 1–3 claim alleges many Lao diseased pigs entered China to be processed into cured pork and ready-to-eat foods, linked to a poisoning case from Longjiang pig’s feet rice, diagnosed as Staphylococcus aureus intoxication. Official MOA reports only O-type foot-and-mouth disease in Chongqing, casting doubt on broader claims.

triage.headline_ja: ラオスから豚熱（ASF）感染豚100万頭が中国に流入し腊肉・調理済み食品に加工されたとの情報、中毒者も発生か（写真）―大陸時政
triage.triage_reason: ラオス・ベトナムでのアフリカ豚熱（ASF）拡大と中国への越境流入疑惑があるが、人体健康被害は別原因（黄色ブドウ球菌食中毒）であり、公式には重慶での口蹄疫のみ確認とされ情報の真偽が不確実なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本件は動物疾病（ASF・口蹄疫）が主題でヒトへの直接感染性はない。報道内の人体中毒事例はASFとは無関係の黄色ブドウ球菌食中毒。ラオスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。中国当局は『腊肉に豚熱感染豚使用』の噂を否定し、重慶での口蹄疫（O型）のみ公式確認としている点でデマの可能性が指摘されており、情報の信頼性に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Inside the study for a remedy to fight Congo's deadliest Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo’s Ituri province has logged over 8,300 confirmed cases and about 4,000 deaths since mid-May, with seven provinces affected and the outbreak outpacing efforts to track and slow transmission. A post-exposure prophylaxis trial of Gilead’s oral antiviral obeldesivir enrolled just over 250 participants and aims for nearly 1,000 children and adults over 12 who had contact with a confirmed case within five days and are asymptomatic; half receive a placebo. Participants are monitored daily in person for 21 days, with a 42‑day follow-up by phone. If symptoms develop, they receive supportive treatment. The study is coordinated by ALIMA, with Congo’s National Institute of Biomedical Research and ANRS Emerging Infectious Diseases. Ervebo vaccination is being used for health workers, though its protection against Bundibugyo is still under study. WHO notes the outbreak could surpass West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll of 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ最悪のエボラ流行に対する治療薬治験の内側
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で8,300例超・死亡4,000人規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が7州に拡大し、2014-2016年西アフリカの流行規模を超える恐れがあるとWHOが指摘しており、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: Ituri州はDRCのADM1地域。Angolaは発生地域として挙げられているが記事本文中に具体的な発生言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan's ninth imported dengue fever case; Filipino male migrant worker detected on entry.

article.articleHeadline: น้ำท่วมขังเคหะร่มเกล้า ภก.หวั่นโรคฉี่หนู-เท้าเปื่อยจากการลุยน้ำ | The Active
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flooding at Romklao Public Housing; Pharmacist Warns of Leptospirosis and Foot Rot from Wading Through Floodwaters | The Active
article.articleSummary: Flooding at Romklao Public Housing in Lat Krabang, Bangkok raises leptospirosis and foot rot risk after Sept 25–27 floods. A local pharmacist distributed free anti-leptospirosis meds and basic supplies, warning floodwaters can spread Leptospira, especially with wounds. Early symptoms of leptospirosis include high fever, headache, red eyes, calf pain. Preventive course: two tablets for about seven days; if still exposed after seven days, repeat. Medication should be prescribed by a pharmacist; if allergic, consult a doctor. Leptospirosis can be life-threatening, causing liver failure, kidney failure, and pneumonia. Authorities are draining water in eastern Bangkok, particularly Lat Krabang and Romklao community, using pumps and flood barriers to reduce water levels and prevent backflow.

triage.headline_ja: ロムクラオ公営住宅の浸水、薬剤師がレプトスピラ症と足の皮膚炎のリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症予防啓発レベルの記事で、現時点では確定症例数や集団発生の規模が不明。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低いが、流行しやすい環境（浸水）のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 洪水によるレプトスピラ症の予防啓発記事であり、症例数や死亡者数などの具体的な疫学データは記載されていない。地方自治体レベルでの排水対応は行われているが大規模な外部支援要請の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Inside the study for a remedy to fight Congo's deadliest Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: RWAMPARA, Congo — More than 250 participants have been enrolled in a trial of an investigational drug designed to prevent Ebola infection amid Congo’s fast-moving Bundibugyo virus outbreak, described as the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the Central African country. The drug targets Bundibugyo virus, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment. The trial began in July and is one of several studies launched to provide protection and slow the outbreak. No laboratory-confirmation details, infection sources, or explicit case/death counts are provided in the report. The effort highlights ongoing public health measures in Congo to curb transmission while pursuing additional preventive options against the Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ史上最も致死的なエボラ出血熱流行に対する治療薬治験の内側
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で同国史上最も致死的とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が継続しており、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認という異常事態であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョウイルス（エボラ）流行に対する治験薬の研究を中心に記述。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリー上では出来事の主題として言及されていないため除外した。具体的な感染者数・死亡者数、国際的拡大の有無については記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 台灣流感高峰、日本暴增10倍　疾管署籲快打疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan's influenza peak; Japan surges tenfold; Taiwan CDC urges vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity is rising in Taiwan and neighboring Japan, prompting vaccination push. Taiwan’s CDC estimates the current wave may peak this week, with weekly influenza visits reaching about 150,000 and the outbreak potentially persisting into mid-November. In Japan, surveillance through Sept 20 reports 31,000 weekly influenza cases nationwide, averaging 8.48 cases per facility and a 53% week-over-week increase, roughly 10 times last year. About 98% of detected strains are A(H1N1), matching Taiwan’s circulating strain; individuals aged 70+ comprise 47.5% of cases. Okinawa is the most affected prefecture, followed by Tokyo, Aichi, Kanagawa, and Chiba, with the surge linked to Silver Week travel and lasting for nine weeks. Other countries also seeing rises: United States, China, Hong Kong, South Korea, and Singapore. Taiwan began publicly funded 'Left-Flow Right-New' influenza vaccination on Oct 1, with high-risk groups urged to vaccinate; vaccination plus COVID-19 vaccines may reduce pneumonia and cardiovascular risk.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾でインフルエンザ流行がピークに、日本では10倍に急増　疾病管理署がワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 日本・台湾を中心に季節性インフルエンザ（A/H1N1）が急増しているが、重症度・死亡例データが不明であり、対象国（中国等）への直接的な影響も限定的なため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主な舞台は日本・台湾であり、両国とも監視対象国リストに含まれない。中国・香港・韓国・シンガポール・米国も『他国でも増加』として一文で触れられるのみで、主題的な発生国としては確認できないため verified_locations は空とした。季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1優勢株）の通常の流行拡大と考えられるが、日本での前年比10倍増という報告は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு, டைபாய்டு பாதிப்பை தடுக்க சென்னையில் சிறப்பு ஏற்பாடுகள்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Special arrangements in Chennai to prevent dengue and typhoid.
article.articleSummary: In Chennai, India, on 2026-10-03, the Chennai Metropolitan Corporation’s medical team is conducting special medical camps across 15 zones to prevent dengue, typhoid, and related fevers and to treat affected individuals. The camps are part of a citywide public health effort to curb vector-borne and febrile illnesses. Activities include guidance to residential areas on preventing stagnant water accumulation, mosquito control measures, and the distribution of pamphlets on fever prevention. Public awareness materials emphasize preventing mosquito breeding and fever control. The initiative focuses on early detection and treatment at the camps, aiming to reduce transmission and protect residents from dengue and typhoid outbreaks in the city.

triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節的な公衆衛生対策（予防キャンプ）の報道であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による通常の予防的公衆衛生活動であり、症例数や重症度などの具体的データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Covid: In Europa risorge il virus, occhi su PJ.2.1!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: In Europe the virus is resurging, eyes on PJ.2.1!
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, Europe faces renewed COVID-19 activity after a period of relative calm. France records a rise in cases toward the end of September, while Italy reports no alert and keeps the situation under control, aided by reopened schools. The World Health Organization flags four variants of interest: recombinants XFG and NB.1.8.1, plus BA.3.2, which circulated in Europe until last summer, and PQ.16.1.1 from China, which spread in Asia but has not produced a similar impact in Europe or the U.S., where immunity is higher. Since spring 2025 no single variant has become globally dominant; outbreaks are fragmented with countries observing lineages. In Europe, Spain, France and the United Kingdom report rising cases, and most European variants derive from XFG. There is no evidence linking PJ.2.1 to increases in France or Italian regions such as Lombardy, Veneto, Lazio, or Campania. Overall, the situation is cautiously stable.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19:ヨーロッパでウイルスが再燃、PJ.2.1に注目

triage.notes: 記事は主に欧州（イタリア、フランス、スペイン、英国）のCOVID-19動向を扱っており、対象国リストにある中国はPQ.16.1.1変異株の発生源として言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Lục Yên bảo vệ đàn vật nuôi trước bệnh dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lục Yên protects its livestock herds from African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) threatens pig farming in Lục Yên Commune, Yen Bai Province, Vietnam. About 14,800 pigs are raised in backyards and small farms. Authorities urge strict biosecurity: daily housing cleaning and disinfection, ready disinfectants and lime, weekly environmental treatment, and restricted entry of people and vehicles. Maintain clean water, feed only properly cooked scraps, monitor health, and report suspected cases to veterinary authorities rather than selling or slaughtering sick pigs. From Feb 8 to Sep 23, 2026, ASF has affected 31 communes/wards with 2,364 pigs infected, dead, or culled, totaling 97.7 tons; seven communes remain within a 21-day window. Proactive prevention protects herds, production, environment, and the local economy.

triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ASF）であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響はなく、IHR・WPRO基準にも該当しないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: രോഗനിര്‍ണയവും ചികില്‍സയും വൈകിയാല്‍ മരണം വരെ സംഭവിക്കാം, സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് കുട്ടികള്‍ക്കിടയില്‍ അഞ്ചാം പനി വ്യാപിക്കുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Delay in diagnosis and treatment can be fatal; the fifth fever is spreading among children in the state.
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, a vaccine-preventable viral illness referred to as the fifth fever is spreading among children, with Kozhikode reporting 80 confirmed cases this year (vs 30 last year) and Malappuram showing rising numbers. In the past month, one child died in Kozhikode and two in Malappuram, underscoring the danger of delayed diagnosis and treatment. Major symptoms are high fever and body rashes; transmission occurs via airborne spread and close contact. The Measles-Rubella (MR) vaccine is essential, with doses typically given around 9 months and again between 16-24 months; gaps in adherence are fueling ongoing transmission, with cases clustering within families. Health authorities have issued advisories and are urging timely diagnosis, appropriate care, and strict vaccination coverage to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 診断・治療の遅れが死亡につながる恐れ、州内で子どもの間に麻疹（五日熱）が拡大
triage.triage_reason: インドのケララ州で麻疹の症例増加と小児死亡が報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは不明であり、ワクチン未接種が要因とみられる局地的流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ケララ州コジコード・マラプラム地区で麻疹症例が前年比増加し、過去1か月で小児3名が死亡。ワクチン接種率の低下が要因とされる。国内の公衆衛生対応として地方当局が注意喚起を実施。

article.articleHeadline: Donna muore di peste in Russia, 200 persone in quarantena, il batterio "fuggito" da un laboratorio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman dies of plague in Russia, 200 people in quarantine, the bacterium 'escaped' from a laboratory.
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old laboratory technician, Darya Shipilova, died of pneumonic plague in Irkutsk, Siberia, Russia. The fatal case, caused by Yersinia pestis, is not believed to be natural transmission; early reports point to a laboratory incident involving a broken vial at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute. About 200 people have been quarantined to limit spread. Pneumonic plague is among the forms that can pass between people. Irkutsk lies in eastern Russia near Lake Baikal, close to the Mongolian border (roughly 1,700 km from Beijing and 4,200 km from Moscow). Prompt antibiotic treatment is essential, and mortality with timely therapy is around 10%, though some Yersinia pestis strains show resistance. No formal government statement has been issued; the case is under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト感染した女性が死亡、200人が隔離、細菌は研究所から『流出』
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が実験室由来の可能性があり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクと異常性からIHR基準を複数満たすため。
