article.articleHeadline: 台南連爆2登革熱境外移入！蚊子最愛溫度曝 入秋也要防蚊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two consecutive imported dengue fever cases reported in Tainan; mosquitoes love warm temperatures—stay vigilant against mosquitoes even as autumn arrives.
article.articleSummary: Two consecutive imported dengue fever cases were reported in Tainan City, Taiwan, as of 3 October 2026. The first case involves a Taiwanese woman in her 50s from the South District who traveled to Ha Long Bay, Vietnam (Sept 19–24); she developed fever on Sept 27, sought care Sept 28–29, and was laboratory-confirmed as dengue fever type 1. The second case is a Filipino man in his 20s from New City District (Gangqian Li); he developed fever Sept 29, arrived at Kaohsiung Airport on Oct 1 with NS1 positive at quarantine, and was PCR-confirmed dengue fever on Oct 2, remaining hospitalized without community exposure. Nationwide this year: 12 locally acquired and 167 imported dengue cases. Control measures include education, environmental inspections, and vector control; 1,287 positive containers were found Jan–Sept, with barrels, jars, and pots comprising 63.4% of breeding sites. Temperature 25–27°C favors mosquito activity; travelers should use protective measures and seek prompt care if symptomatic.

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Tshisekedi et Jean-Noël Barrot évoquent la sécurité, Ebola et un projet de 1,3 million d'euros pour les victimes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Tshisekedi and Jean-Noël Barrot discuss security, Ebola, and a €1.3 million project for the victims.
article.articleSummary: DRC faces its 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak as President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi and French Minister Jean-Noël Barrot reviewed security in the east and the Ebola response during a Kinshasa meeting on October 2. With Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba and Deputy Foreign Minister Noëlla Ayaganagato present, the talks reinforced France–DRC cooperation and outlined field efforts, including Barrot’s upcoming trip to Bunia in Ituri to support the outbreak response. Separately, a declaration of intent was signed to strengthen the rule of law and aid victims of sexual violence in conflict zones, between the Congolese Ministry of Justice and France’s Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs, in the presence of FONAREV officials. The project, with a budget exceeding €1.3 million for 2026–2028, funds legal fees, mobile legal clinics, itinerant hearings, and training for judges, prosecutors, and police to improve documentation and judicial processing of crimes.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：ツィシケディ大統領とジャン=ノエル・バロ仏外相、治安・エボラ・被害者支援への130万ユーロプロジェクトについて協議
triage.triage_reason: 既知の進行中のエボラ流行（第17波）に関する外交・支援協議の記事であり新規異常事態ではないが、流行継続中のため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola en República Democrática del Congo supera los 4.000 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-03, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths (case fatality rate 48.4%), the worst and most lethal on record for the country. The epidemic began in Ituri province (northeast) and is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which no vaccine or specifically approved treatment exists. It has spread rapidly to six northern and eastern provinces, in areas with weak state presence and armed groups. In its early phase, Bundibugyo virus can cause seemingly mild symptoms, delaying detection. Several therapies and vaccines are in trials for this strain, which is relatively poorly characterized; historically, Zaire ebolavirus has driven most outbreaks in the RDC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行が6州に拡大し、ワクチン・治療薬が未確立のBundibugyoウイルスによる過去最悪の流行であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo型による史上最悪の流行であり、武装勢力が存在する地域での対応困難さも懸念材料。フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 日本流感連9週上升！沖繩、東京病例增　國內流感疫苗2天逾60萬人接種
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Japan's influenza cases have risen for nine consecutive weeks! Okinawa and Tokyo see more cases; more than 600,000 people vaccinated against influenza in two days.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 3, 2026, influenza activity in Japan has risen for nine consecutive weeks, with Okinawa, Tokyo, Aichi, Kanagawa, and Chiba reporting higher case counts. Week 38 (Sept 14–20) saw an average of 8.48 sentinel/lab-confirmed influenza cases, up 53.1% from week 37 (5.54); year-on-year the week is about tenfold last year’s 0.8. Those aged 70+ account for 47.5% of cases, and 98% of circulating viruses are H1N1. Across 44 of 47 prefectures, cases increased; the surge began in week 30 and may be amplified by Silver Week travel. Outside Japan, China, Hong Kong, South Korea, Singapore, and the United States also report rising influenza activity. In Taiwan, Phase 1 of the public influenza and COVID-19 vaccination program began Oct 1. In two days (Oct 1–2), influenza vaccinations reached 601,000 doses (60.1万), up 9% YoY; COVID-19 vaccines reached 209,000 (20.9万), up 19%. On Oct 2, daily flu vaccinations rose to 335,000 (33.5万). Taiwan’s CDC notes high domestic flu activity, with outpatient visits potentially 150,000 this week and continued risk through mid-October; eligible individuals are urged to complete the ‘Left Flu, Right New’ vaccination program, which also reduces pneumonia and cardiovascular risk.

triage.headline_ja: 日本のインフルエンザが9週連続増加！沖縄・東京で症例増加　国内インフルエンザワクチン2日間で60万人超接種
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの定例的な流行報告であり、H1N1は既知の季節性株。IHR基準・WPRO基準とも明確な該当はなく、アジア各国・米国での同時期の流行上昇も例年見られる現象の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 記事は主に日本・台湾のインフルエンザ流行状況とワクチン接種実績を報じるもの。中国・香港・韓国・シンガポール・米国も流行上昇が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのは中国のみで、香港は中国に含めた。季節性インフルエンザの定例報道でありシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളത്തിൽ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി പടരുന്നു; മഴക്കാലത്ത് വീടുകളിൽ ശ്രദ്ധിക്കേണ്ട സുരക്ഷാ മുൻകരുതലുകൾ ഇതാ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is spreading in Kerala; here are safety precautions to take at home during the monsoon season.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is spreading in Kerala, India, after two days of heavy rain, with daily cases reportedly exceeding ten thousand; Ernakulam district alone reported 43 cases in two days last week. Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP) data up to October 2 confirm ongoing transmission, while the India Meteorological Department forecasts heavy rainfall through October 7, likely sustaining dengue risk. Home prevention focuses on removing standing water in tanks, containers, and other sites every two days; cover tanks; install window screens; sleep under mosquito nets; wear long-sleeved, light-colored clothing; and use repellents containing DEET, picaridin, or IR3535. Avoid lemon eucalyptus oil products for children under 3 years and any repellent for infants under 2 months. If dengue is suspected, drink fluids, rest, and avoid aspirin or NSAIDs; ORS recipe: 1 L water, 6 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt. Red flags—severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, extreme weakness, or shortness of breath—require immediate medical care. Community ward cleanup and school checklists are planned; keep emergency contacts handy.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でデング熱が拡大中；モンスーン期における家庭での予防対策
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で例年の雨季に伴うデング熱の季節的流行であり、異常性は低いが、1日あたり症例数が多く継続的な感染リスクがあるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は主に家庭での予防・応急処置情報であり、重症例や死亡者数の記載はない。モンスーン期の季節性デング熱として既知のパターンに該当する可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات "إيبولا" في الكونغو تتجاوز 4 آلاف وتحذيرات من سرعة انتشاره
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 4,000, with warnings about how rapidly it is spreading.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, Ebola has killed 4,018 people out of 8,300 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, roughly half of infections and the fastest wave the country has faced. The outbreak was declared on 15 May and is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant with no approved cure or vaccine. The World Health Organization warns of rapid geographic spread into new health zones, increasing pressure on already limited public health resources and complicating containment. Authorities report ongoing transmission and difficulties in stopping spread, underscoring the lack of targeted medical countermeasures and the urgent need for sustained resources to manage the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ死者数が4,000人を超え、急速な拡大に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、死者4,000人超、WHOが新たな保健地域への急速な拡大を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 承認済みの治療薬・ワクチンがないBundibugyo株による流行で、致死率が約50%と極めて高く、国際的な資源投入の緊急性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: தலைநகரை அச்சுறுத்தும் டெங்கு பரவல்: சென்னை முழுவதும் சிறப்பு முகாம்கள்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue outbreak threatening the capital: Special camps across Chennai.
article.articleSummary: Chennai faces a dengue outbreak along with typhoid and typhus fever across multiple districts and residential areas. The city administration has intensified containment with 15 special fever clinics operating in all zones to curb transmission and ensure rapid treatment for affected residents. Public health messaging aims to build comprehensive awareness of protective practices at home to stop further spread of viral fevers. In key localities, including Saidapet, civic and health department officials are on the ground, launching intensive outreach and field operations. Printed leaflets explain how to prevent mosquito breeding and how to guard against dengue. The drive prioritizes rapid diagnosis, community engagement, and vector control to reduce cases and protect vulnerable populations in the capital city.

triage.headline_ja: 首都を脅かすデング熱の流行：チェンナイ全域に特別キャンプを設置
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイでデング熱・腸チフス等の季節性流行が報告されているが、重症度や拡大規模など詳細情報が不足しており、既存の対策（特別クリニック・啓発活動）で管理可能とみられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・チェンナイで毎年季節的に発生する感染症であり、地方自治体が通常の公衆衛生対応（特別クリニック、啓発活動、媒介蚊対策）を実施している段階。重症度・死亡者数等の具体的データが記事に記載されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola approaches the CAR border, fragile water and health systems face a critical test
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) threatens the Central African Republic (CAR) border and Uganda. As of 1 September, the DRC reported over 6,200 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 3,000 deaths; Uganda recorded 19 cases (2 deaths, 7 recoveries). The outbreak centers in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with cross-border movement toward CAR raising transmission risk. Ebola spreads by contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain and bleeding, with fatality rates varying from 25% to 90% by strain and care. WASH and health-system fragility in eastern DRC amplify transmission; 1.15 million IDPs and 1.8 million returnees in North/South Kivu, and 360,000 in extreme WASH deprivation. Response includes water trucking, chlorination points, latrine rehabilitation and hygiene kits. A WHO/Africa CDC six-month plan costs USD 518 million (June–November 2026); major pledges include US ~$512m, EU €79.5m (+€15m for Ebola), UK £20m, and AU ~$80m toward a $100m continental target.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがCAR国境に迫る中、脆弱な水・衛生システムが重大な試練に直面
triage.triage_reason: DRCで6,200例超・3,000人超の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、ウガンダへの越境伝播が確認され、CAR国境にも拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、中央アフリカ共和国への越境リスクが言及されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。国際的な資金拠出（WHO/Africa CDC計画、米・EU・英・AUの支援）から国際的関心の高さが伺える。

article.articleHeadline: 200 Menschen in Quarantäne: Pest-Ausbruch in Sibirien befürchtet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 200 people in quarantine: plague outbreak feared in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: Plague outbreak feared in Siberia as a hospital in Schelechow, near Irkutsk, is quarantined after a patient is suspected of a highly dangerous infection, potentially pneumonic plague. A young woman with severe pneumonia, who was intubated and died, has not had official death confirmation. Reports vary: she may have contracted plague after returning from Thailand, or she was a laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute where a vial with live plague bacteria shattered during sample preparation. Investigators opened a criminal case for possible safety violations linked to the fatal incident. Governor Igor Kobsew convened a special sanitation and infectious-disease commission meeting; Anna Popova attended. Authorities urge calm; identified contacts are under medical surveillance, with laboratory results negative so far. Public events in Irkutsk have been canceled. Reported contact numbers range from about 100 to nearly 200.

triage.headline_ja: 200人が隔離:シベリアでペスト(鼠疫)アウトブレイクの懸念
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑いの死亡例が発生し、病院隔離・接触者約200人の健康監視、公的行事中止など深刻かつ異常な事態であり、IHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてタイが記載されているが、記事内ではタイ渡航歴が感染経路の一説に過ぎず、実際の発生・隔離事象はロシア・イルクーツクで起きているため、対象国リストに該当する国はなしと判断した。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱清消爆烏龍！ 藥霧竄住家 害喉痛就醫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever fumigation fiasco! Pesticide mist invades homes, causing sore throats and prompting medical visits.
article.articleSummary: Changhua City, Taiwan, records the year’s second locally acquired dengue fever case, both in Changhua City. On Oct 2, 2026, four townships—Changhua City, Hemei, Xiushui, and Putou—launched cross-district fumigation to curb dengue, using thermal fogging machines. A high-concentration pesticide mist reportedly drifted into residents’ homes, causing throat irritation, coughing, throat pain, and hoarseness, prompting medical visits by a family member and nearby neighbors. Neighbors complained of strong odors and irritation. The spraying team wore protective gear, and officials said the mist escaped from another manhole cover, drifting into homes where occupants were present. Environmental and Health Bureaus pledged to cover medical expenses and review spraying methods, while residents urged prior notification during this outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 登革熱清消爆烏龍！ 薬霧が住宅街に侵入、喉の痛みで受診者続出
triage.triage_reason: 台湾彰化市における局地的な登革熱症例（年間2例目）への薬剤噴霧作業に伴う副次的健康被害の記事であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念や感染拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は登革熱の媒介蚊駆除における薬剤噴霧の失敗と住民への健康被害であり、感染症そのものの拡大や重篤化は報告されていない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれず、中国（PRC）の主題でもないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Terus Menyebar, Lebih dari 4.000 Orang Tewas di RD Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak Continues to Spread, More Than 4,000 People Have Died in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, the worst in the country’s history, has caused 4,018 deaths from 8,300 confirmed cases with 2,162 recoveries (case fatality about 48.4%) as of October 2, 2026. The outbreak began in Ituri province in the northeast and has spread to seven northern and eastern provinces, including North Kivu, where four deaths are reported among six cases in areas controlled by the anti-government M23 group. Response efforts are hindered by ongoing conflict and distrust of authorities, with more than 5,000 displaced and a transit center for Ebola patients burned in Ituri after soldiers entered to aid refugees. France has pledged €13.4 million for Ebola control (January–July 2026) and the United States will add $267 million. Vaccines and treatments targeting the Bundibugyo strain are under study.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大続く、コンゴ民主共和国で4,000人以上死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%・8,300症例・4,000人以上の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生被害があり、複数州への拡大、紛争による対応阻害、国際支援の表明など、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスは資金援助国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。紛争地域（M23支配地域）での感染拡大・対応困難が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat: Dengue Hits 'Ekta Diwas' Parade Contingent, 24 Test Positive
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak among Rashtriya Ekta Diwas preparations in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, with 24 personnel testing positive over two days. On Thursday, 34 admissions yielded 23 positives; Friday saw five more admissions (one positive, four suspected). All patients, mostly aged 25–30, present fever and body ache and remain stable with no complications; about 10 discharged by Friday afternoon. Infections involve personnel from Uttar Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Kerala and Bihar staying in a common Gandhinagar hostel for Ekta Diwas prep at Ekta Nagar. Source of infection under epidemiological assessment; no confirmed outbreak link yet. State data noted earlier: over 1.35 lakh suspected dengue samples tested across 42 hospitals, with 2,099 positives in 2026 up to that point. The Rashtriya Ekta Diwas parade is planned for Oct 30–31, with ~10,000 police/paramilitary, cultural performances, flypast, and PM Modi’s address.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州：『エクタ・ディワス』パレード隊でデング熱発生、24人が陽性
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設内での局地的デング熱クラスターであり、重症例や死亡は報告されていないが、大規模行事(10,000人規模)前であり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで地域的流行性疾患であり、本件は共同宿泊施設での集団感染。10月30-31日の大規模パレード前のため、感染拡大の推移に注意が必要。州全体では既に2,099例の陽性が報告されており、季節性流行の一環とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Temuan Influenza A di Tangerang Capai 30 Ribu Kasus Sepanjang Januari-September 2026, Kadinkes: Hampir Ribuan Kasus per Bulan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases in Tangerang reach 30,000 from January to September 2026, Health Office head: nearly thousands of cases per month.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A exposure in Tangerang Regency, Banten, Indonesia, reached 30,000 cases from January to September 2026, per Hendra Tarmizi, head of the Tangerang Health Office. Monthly cases rose from about 20,000–25,000 to nearly 28,000–30,000, with August–September 2026 adding roughly 5,000 cases per month. The surge is linked to extreme weather and dust pollution from a prolonged dry spell. Many health facilities have not conducted laboratory tests to confirm influenza A; most acute respiratory infections are attributed to the influenza virus. The rise spans all ages and all sub-districts. Transmission is rapid via close contact and droplets. Prevention emphasizes boosting immunity and reducing close contact with infected individuals, with higher risk of severe disease for young children and adults with asthma or bronchitis.

triage.headline_ja: タンゲラン県のインフルエンザA型症例、2026年1〜9月で3万件に到達、保健局長：月あたりほぼ数千件
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ様疾患の増加だが検査未確定で原因病原体が不明瞭であり、乾季・大気汚染による季節性要因と説明されているため異常性は低い。ただしヒト-ヒト感染拡大の継続性があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 多くの医療機関で検査が未実施のため、インフルエンザA型と確定診断されたわけではなく急性呼吸器感染症全般がインフルエンザとして計上されている可能性がある。乾季・大気汚染との関連が指摘されており、季節性変動の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னையில் 2,000 பேருக்கு டெங்கு! 109 இடங்களில் இன்று சிறப்பு மருத்துவ முகாம்கள்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue hits 2,000 people in Chennai! Special medical camps at 109 locations today.
article.articleSummary: Chennai has recorded about 2,000 dengue fever cases, with 50 new infections confirmed yesterday. To curb spread, the city’s authorities have intensified mosquito-control activities and are operating 109 special medical camps across 15 administrative zones of the Greater Chennai Corporation today. Tamil Nadu as a whole is experiencing rising dengue activity, with approximately 18,000 cases reported in the state up to last week; officials have not released statewide figures since then. Health officials advise residents who develop dengue symptoms to seek prompt testing at nearby hospitals. The report highlights ongoing public-health measures, including vector control and rapid diagnosis, as part of the broader effort to contain dengue outbreaks in Chennai and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでデング熱2,000人に！本日109カ所で特別医療キャンプ実施
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミルナードゥ州で季節性デング熱が拡大しており（州全体で約18,000例）、地域の公衆衛生対応が強化されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、例年の流行の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: デング熱は南アジアで季節性に流行する疾患であり、本記事はチェンナイ市および州レベルでの対応強化を報じている。重症度（死亡者数等）の具体的情報はなく、通常の流行対策の範囲内と見られるためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: ВО РУСКИОТ РЕГИОН ИРКУТСК ЖЕНА ПОЧИНА ОД ЧУМА! Истата болест во 14 век уби околу половина од населението на Европа - plusinfo.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Irkutsk Region of Russia, a woman died of plague! The same disease killed about half of Europe’s population in the 14th century.
article.articleSummary: In Russia’s Irkutsk region, eastern Siberia, a 28-year-old laboratory technician, Daria Shipilova, died of pneumonic plague. She worked at the Institute for Plague Prevention in Irkutsk; local media suggest she may have contracted the infection via a broken test tube. About 200 people who may have been in contact are in quarantine. The Health Ministry had not yet commented as of 2026-10-03. Governor Aleksei Tsidenov of Buryatia stated the deceased was from neighboring Irkutsk. The causative agent is Yersinia pestis; pneumonic plague spreads person-to-person by airborne routes and is the most virulent form, though bubonic plague via flea bites also exists. Without timely diagnosis and urgent antibiotics, mortality is high for both forms. The article references the Black Death (1346-1353), a pandemic across Euroasia and North Africa that killed an estimated 75-200 million and erased 30-60% of Europe’s population, with major societal upheaval.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア・イルクーツク州で女性がペストにより死亡！同じ病気は14世紀に欧州人口の約半数を死に至らしめた
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が確認され、実験室由来の感染で約200人が隔離対象となっている。重症度・異常性からIHR基準に2項目該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 事例はロシア・イルクーツク州（実験室関連感染）であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。発生地域にThailandが含まれているが記事内容に無関係のため除外。肺ペストの実験室感染例として国際的関心は高く、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: एटा के रसूलपुर गढ़ौली में संक्रामक रोगों का कहर, 15 दिन में छह मौतें - fever rampant in every household in rasulpur garhauli six lives lost in fifteen days etah news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ravages of infectious diseases in Rasulpur Garhauli, Etah: six deaths in fifteen days
article.articleSummary: Six deaths in 15 days, suspected to be due to infectious diseases, have unsettled Rasulpur Garhauli village in Marhara block, Etah district, Uttar Pradesh. The deceased are Khub Singh, Chiranjilal, Dharmjit (alias Pappu), Shanti Devi, Radha, and Yatindra. Residents report fever and illness across many households, but the health department has not officially confirmed the cause as an infectious disease. Authorities responded with anti-larva spraying and fogging; health teams are conducting camps, collecting blood samples, and arranging treatment per test results. Virendra Singh Lodhi, the local MLA, along with Acting CMO Dr. Ravi Ranjan Yadav, BDO Sudhakar Dubey, and ADO Panchayat Deepak Gupta, visited the village to assess the situation and console families. Private medical consultations are also being sought by residents.

triage.headline_ja: エタ県ラスールプル・ガルハウリ村で感染症が猛威、15日間で6人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一村落での原因不明の発熱・死亡クラスターだが、原因病原体や診断が未確定で、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠もないため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 蚊媒介感染症（デング熱等）を示唆する対応（殺虫剤散布、燻蒸）が取られているが、公式な病原体確定情報はまだない。地元自治体・保健当局が既に対応中で外部支援の必要性は現時点で不明。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : 10 geuris d'Ebola sortis des centre de traitement, une première depuis la résurgence de l'épidémie à Beni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: 10 Ebola survivors discharged from treatment centers, a first since the outbreak's resurgence in Beni.
article.articleSummary: Ten Ebola survivors were discharged on October 2, 2026, from treatment centers in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, marking another step in the city’s persistent outbreak. The centers run by International Medical Corps and MSF-Holland reported that the patients spent 10 to 22 days in isolation. Dr. Jérémie Muhindo, who oversees medical care in the response coordination, emphasized rapid symptom detection and immediate referral of suspected cases as the main defense against further transmission. Survivors described receiving adequate care and urged others to trust the response teams. One survivor recalled malaria-like initial symptoms and how he reached the treatment center in a fragile state, recovering to good health. North Kivu remains the second Ebola focus after Ituri, with over 1,600 confirmed cases across multiple health zones, while health workers and communities continue the fight to end the outbreak. Two survivors had previously been discharged from treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:ベニでのエボラ流行再燃以来初めて、治癒者10人が治療センターから退院
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州ベニで累計1,600例超の確認例を伴うエボラ流行が継続中であり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクもあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事自体は治癒者退院という前向きなニュースだが、背景には北キブ州ベニでの大規模エボラ流行（1,600例超）が継続しており、イトゥリ州に次ぐ第二の流行拠点であることから継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh giác với sốt xuất huyết Dengue: Nhóm nguy cơ cao cần theo dõi sát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be Vigilant Against Dengue Fever: High-Risk Groups Need Close Monitoring.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Southern Vietnam accounts for 73.1% of cases, with all individuals at risk of progression to severe disease. High-risk groups include elderly; people with underlying conditions (hypertension, diabetes, cardiovascular/kidney disease); infants; pregnant women; and overweight/obese individuals needing close monitoring. At a briefing by Ho Chi Minh City Department of Preventive Medicine and Takeda Vietnam, experts explain why these groups are prone to complications. The danger phase often occurs days 3–7, even after fever subsides, and can progress to dengue shock syndrome, severe hemorrhage, or multi-organ failure. Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases treated two ill patients aged 16 and 21; one needed ECMO for over a month costing VND 1 billion, the other dialysis for 45 days; a 20-year-old died on September 8. Prevention relies on three measures: remove standing water and breeding sites, use bed nets, seek care for fever; discuss vaccination with health workers.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱に警戒を：重症化リスクの高い層は注意深い経過観察が必要
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム南部での季節性デング熱流行に関する注意喚起記事で、重症例・死亡例の報告はあるが、異常な拡大や国際的リスクは認められず、通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市の予防医学局とTakeda社による重症化リスク啓発ブリーフィングに基づく記事。デング熱はベトナムで季節性に流行する風土病であり、本記事は特定の異常発生ではなく一般啓発・注意喚起が主目的。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 4 آلاف وفاة جراء وباء إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 deaths due to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 4,000 people out of 8,300 confirmed infections, authorities said on Friday, marking the seventeenth and deadliest outbreak in the country’s history. The latest totals show 8,300 infections, 4,018 deaths, and 2,162 recoveries, illustrating the substantial impact on communities across multiple provinces. Six Ebola cases, including four deaths, were recorded in North Kivu Province in the northeast, within areas controlled by armed groups. The outbreak began in Ituri Province in the northeast and has spread to seven provinces across the north and east, signaling a wide geographic footprint of transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で死者4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における過去最悪のエボラ流行（感染8,300人、死者4,018人）で、7州に拡大し武装勢力支配地域も含むため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 史上17回目かつ最も致死的なエボラ流行とされ、武装勢力支配地域での感染確認もあり、対応の困難さが懸念される。致死率は約48%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: જામનગર: નાઘેડી કુમાર શાળામાં રેબીઝ અવેરનેસ અંગે 108 અને 1962 પશુ એમ્બ્યુલન્સ સેવાઓના લાઈવ ડેમો દર્શાવાયા
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jamnagar: Live demos of the 108 and 1962 animal ambulance services regarding rabies awareness were shown at Naghadi Kumar School.
article.articleSummary: World Rabies Day was marked at Naghadi Kumar School in Jamnagar district, Gujarat, with live demonstrations of 108 Emergency Ambulance and 1962 Animal Ambulance services to raise awareness about rabies. The event, led by Dr. Mohmmed Shoyeb Khan of EMRI Green Health Services’ roaming veterinary clinic, involved veterinarians, EMTs, and pilots. The theme 'Stronger Together' emphasized community involvement in rabies prevention, bite management, vaccination, and emergency response. Students were guided on post-bite first aid, dog bite precautions, timely treatment, and vaccination importance. The program highlighted emergency helplines, including 108 Emergency, 1962 Animal Ambulance, 181 Women Helpline, Child Helpline, Khilkhilat Vehicle Service, and 112 All-in-One Emergency Services. Demonstrations of the 108 Ambulance, Karuna Animal Ambulance, and roaming veterinary clinic were conducted to provide practical understanding. A quiz awarded prizes, reinforcing science-based knowledge and promoting animal welfare, social responsibility, and awareness of emergency services.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムナガル:ナゲディ・クマール・スクールで狂犬病啓発に関する108救急車サービスと1962動物救急車サービスのライブデモが実施
triage.triage_reason: 世界狂犬病デーに合わせた啓発イベントの報道であり、実際の感染症発生や症例報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の啓発イベント・教育プログラムに関する内容であり、実際の発生事例の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 24 National Unity Day Parade Personnel Test Positive For Dengue In Gujarat
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, dengue outbreak linked to visiting security and cultural contingents in Gujarat has left at least 24 personnel hospitalized in Gandhinagar, who were rehearsing for National Unity Day celebrations. According to NDTV, dozens more remain under observation after presenting fever, joint pain, and muscle aches over the last 48 hours. Senior medical officers reported the affected individuals are part of contingents preparing for the event, underscoring ongoing transmission among those involved in the National Unity Day rehearsals in Gujarat.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州で国家統一デーのパレード要員24人がデング熱陽性
triage.triage_reason: グジャラート州でのデング熱クラスター（24人入院）だが、インドでは季節性に流行する既知の疾患であり重症度・異常性は限定的。特定グループ内での発生動向を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで季節性に流行する風土病的疾患であり、今回は国家統一デー関連の要員間での集団発生という特異性はあるが、重症度・国際的影響は限定的と判断。続報（感染規模拡大、死亡例等）があればPICKUPに格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: Gia tăng bệnh truyền nhiễm ở trẻ, ngành y tế khuyến cáo phòng ngừa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in infectious diseases among children, the health sector urges preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: From July 1, 2026 to October 3, 2026, Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, reports rising pediatric infectious diseases, led by Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) and hand-foot-mouth disease, with other circulated pathogens including seasonal influenza, adenovirus, COVID-19, measles, and pertussis. Ha Tinh General Hospital’s Pediatric Department notes RSV admissions averaging 15–20 daily, totaling over 160 RSV hospitalizations in September, many progressing to pneumonia and respiratory failure. Nationwide, under-15 RSV cases reach 435; COVID-19 82; hand-foot-mouth 61; measles 7; pertussis 2. RSV begins with mild upper-respiratory symptoms but can advance to bronchiolitis and severe respiratory distress in young children; transmission is via droplets and direct contact; no specific antiviral exists. A 5-month-old, N.H.L. from Toàn Lưu, recovered after timely care. Hand-foot-mouth presents with fever, mouth sores, and vesicular rash on hands/feet; 61 cases since early July. Authorities urge vigilance, avoid self-medicating with antibiotics, and reinforce infection control and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 小児の感染症が増加、保健当局が予防を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の小児呼吸器・手足口病の増加報告であり、重症例は一部あるが国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は見られず、通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: RSVや手足口病による小児入院増加は季節性のものであり、国際的な公衆衛生緊急性は低いが、重症化例（肺炎・呼吸不全）が報告されているため地域の医療機関への負荷を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'espoir d'un traitement préventif contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Hope for a preventive treatment against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is testing a post-exposure prophylaxis (EBO-PEP) antiviral in Rwampara, Ituri Province, with over 250 exposed participants and a target of about 1,000 adults and youths over 12. Initiated in July, the trial administers the experimental antiviral to recent contacts of a confirmed case, with daily follow-up for 21 days and up to 42 days. Some participants joined after losing relatives; ALIMA coordinates the study. No vaccine or approved treatment exists specifically for Bundibugyo Ebola; the Ervebo vaccine is used for frontline health workers, but its protection against Bundibugyo remains uncertain. As of 2 October, the outbreak has 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths (case fatality 48.4%), with >2,000 recoveries, across seven northern and eastern provinces. Violence, displacement, and access barriers hinder surveillance and contact tracing, fueling concern it could exceed West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll (~11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ出血熱に対する予防的治療への期待
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が8,300例・死者4,018例（致死率48.4%）に達し、7州に拡大、暴力や住民移動により監視・接触者追跡が困難で、西アフリカ2014-16年流行を超える懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではルワンダ（Kigali Province）も発生地域として挙げられているが、記事本文はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）での流行・治験に焦点を当てており、ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: AFC/M23 Tighten Respond Against Ebola, 6 Cases Reported - Taarifa Rwanda:
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, six Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases have been detected in North Kivu Province, DRC, according to AFC/M23 authorities. Four cases were identified in Alimbongo and two in Kayna; investigations indicate the cases are linked to imported contamination from Butembo. Four detections occurred after post-mortem sample collections, while two symptomatic patients are currently receiving care. Health teams are intensifying surveillance, expanding the search for suspected cases, and identifying and following contacts to rapidly interrupt transmission. The rebel administration says contact tracing and case management are being reinforced to prevent further spread. A meeting of AFC/M23 leadership held on 2 October in Goma assessed the epidemiological situation and ordered urgent measures to strengthen the response.

triage.headline_ja: AFC/M23、エボラ出血熱への対応を強化 ― 6症例が報告される（Taarifa Rwanda）
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の新規症例（死亡例を含む）が確認され、紛争地域での対応という管理上の課題もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 北キブ州は武装勢力AFC/M23が実効支配する地域であり、通常の公衆衛生対応体制が機能しにくい可能性がある点に留意。ブテンボからの輸入感染とされ、接触者追跡・症例管理の継続状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 吃炒蛋險奪命！一家3口集體中毒送醫　專家曝疑因「1步驟」太愛乾淨惹禍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fried eggs nearly cost them their lives! A family of three poisoned and hospitalized; experts suspect one cleaning step gone too far in the pursuit of cleanliness.
article.articleSummary: In Shenyang, Liaoning Province, China, a family of three was hospitalized after eating fried eggs, with investigators linking the illness to washing eggs before storage. The water removes the eggshell’s natural protective film, allowing microbes, including Salmonella, to invade and accelerate spoilage, and refrigeration cannot fully prevent contamination. If eggs have already been washed, cook them promptly and consume quickly; if refrigerated, finish within three days and keep separate from ready-to-eat foods. Do not freeze eggs; for visibly dirty shells, wipe with a dry cloth instead of washing. Key storage guidance: never wash before storage, avoid mixing with other foods, and store the larger end up to preserve the air cell and extend freshness. When buying eggs, avoid shells with heavy fecal matter or bloodstains. No broader outbreak details beyond this incident were reported.

triage.headline_ja: 炒め卵で危うく命を落とす！一家3人が集団食中毒で病院搬送　専門家は『ある手順』の潔癖さが原因と指摘
triage.triage_reason: 単一家族内の食中毒事例であり、広範な集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はなく、啓発的な生活情報記事の性質が強い。
triage.notes: 記事は食品衛生啓発（卵の洗浄・保存方法）が主眼であり、疾病名にParatyphoid/Typhoidが付与されているが本文はサルモネラによる単発食中毒事例の説明であり、広域アウトブレイクの情報はない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 日本流感疫情連9週上升！病例為去年10倍　疾管署籲「左流右新」再出國
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Japan's influenza outbreak has risen for nine consecutive weeks; cases are ten times higher than last year; Taiwan CDC urges "Left Drift, Right New" as people travel abroad again.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's CDC issued an epidemic alert on 2026-10-03 warning that Japan's influenza activity has risen for nine straight weeks, with Okinawa, Tokyo, and Aichi reporting the highest case counts. Similar upticks are seen in nearby areas and abroad, including China, Hong Kong, Korea, Singapore, and the United States. Taiwan activated the dual vaccination campaign 'Left Drift, Right New' on October 1 and urges travelers to complete vaccination before departure to reduce risk of severe disease and complications. Japanese data from the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare show Week 38 (Sept 14–20) influenza-like illness sentinel cases averaged 8.48 per facility, up 53.1% from 5.54 prior week, and roughly ten times last year's 0.8. Those aged 70+ accounted for 47.5% of cases. The predominant strain is H1N1. Across Japan's 47 prefectures, 44 reported increases, with the top five Okinawa, Tokyo, Aichi, Kanagawa, and Chiba.

triage.headline_ja: 日本のインフルエンザ流行が9週連続で上昇！症例数は昨年の10倍　台湾疾病管制署が「左流右新（インフル・コロナ同時接種）」を呼びかけ、海外渡航者に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 日本国内で季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1優勢株）が9週連続増加し前年比10倍という異常な規模で拡大、複数国（中国・香港・韓国・シンガポール・米国）でも同様の増加が報告されており国際的拡大の可能性がIHR基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 主たる発生国は日本（対象国リスト外）。中国・香港等は『類似した増加が見られる』との付随的言及に留まり、具体的な発症データが示されていないため、対象国リストの基準上verified_locationsには含めていない。季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）であり新規病原体ではないが、異常な増加率と高齢者における重症化傾向がみられるため、続報の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola franchit le cap des 4 000 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the Ebola epidemic surpasses 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpassed 4,000 deaths with 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 fatalities, and 2,162 recoveries; case fatality around 48.4%. The outbreak spans 63 health zones across seven provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Tshopo and Sud-Ubangi—with Ituri hardest hit, especially Mandima, Nia Nia and Mongbwalu. By Oct 2, 2026, the total reached 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths; earlier tallies showed 7,890 cases/3,799 deaths (Sept 23) and 8,067/3,901 (Sept 26). The OMS reported declining new cases and deaths over the last two 14-day periods, but transmission remains high in several zones. Vaccination efforts face a challenge: the Bundibugyo virus, for which Ervebo is not licensed, is circulating. On Aug 20, 70,000 Ervebo doses were allocated; 20,000 for a phase III trial against Bundibugyo, 50,000 for health workers. Security and access constraints in Ituri hinder response; ongoing transmission and community deaths persist.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ流行、死者数が4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ大規模流行（8,300症例、4,018死亡）が7州63保健地域に拡大し、ワクチン未対応のブンディブギョ型ウイルスも循環しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 致死率約48.4%と高く、治安・アクセス制約が対応を阻害。ワクチン未対応株（Bundibugyo）循環により流行制御の不確実性が高い。既に大規模流行として継続監視中の既知イベントと推測されるが、深刻度・拡大性からPICKUP判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: DARJA (28) SLOMILA EPRUVETU, UMRLA OD KUGE POSLE ČETIRI DANA: Nesreća u državnoj laboratoriji, više od 200 ljudi u karantinu! Dramatična situacija u Sibiru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Darja (28) broke a test tube, died of the plague after four days: Accident in a state laboratory, more than 200 people in quarantine! Dramatic situation in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: 28-year-old Darja S., a laboratory technician at the Irkutsk-based State Institute for the Fight Against Plague in eastern Siberia, died of pneumonic plague after a vial containing Yersinia pestis broke on Sept 25. About 200 people who had contact with her were isolated or moved for medical surveillance; the hospital ward was quarantined and admissions/discharges suspended in several departments. She was admitted to a hospital in Shelekhov (about 20 km from Irkutsk) on Sept 29 and died in the night of Oct 2. Authorities confirmed the fatal plague; the institute has not issued a public statement, and officials say no symptoms have appeared among contacts so far. Globally, plague persists with 423 deaths reported 2019–2025 (WHO), most in Congo and Madagascar. Pneumonic plague is deadly if untreated; antibiotics are effective and a vaccine is under development. It remains unclear why she could not be saved.

triage.headline_ja: ダリヤ（28歳）が試験管を割り、4日後にペストで死亡：国立研究所で事故、200人以上が隔離！シベリアで深刻な事態
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの国立ペスト研究所で研究者が肺ペストに感染し死亡、約200人が隔離されるなど、重大かつ異常な事案でIHR基準に2項目該当するため。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア（イルクーツク）で発生したラボ内感染事故であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。DRC・マダガスカルは世界的な流行状況の文脈で言及されているのみで、本事案の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: UMI siapkan tim multidisiplin perkuat Konsorsium TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UMI Prepares Multidisciplinary Team to Strengthen the TB Consortium.
article.articleSummary: Makassar, Indonesia — Universitas Muslim Indonesia (UMI) Makassar is assembling a multidisciplinary team to strengthen the TB Consortium, aiming for a university-led response to tuberculosis. Rector Prof Dr Hambali Thalib said TB management requires cross-disciplinary approaches and that the university can integrate education, research, and community service. UMI will deploy a data-driven strategy across faculties, with Medicine as the leading sector, and Pharmacy, Public Health, Economics, Engineering and others contributing as needed. The plan emphasizes identifying whether local TB burdens stem from health, environmental, or genetic factors to tailor interventions. Plt. Head of LLDIKTI IX Prof dr Budu noted the TB Eradication Consortium will coordinate with three ministries: Health, Home Affairs, and Education, Science and Technology. Indonesia accounted for about 10% of global TB cases in 2024 and ranks second worldwide in TB burden.

triage.headline_ja: UMI、結核コンソーシアム強化へ多職種チームを編成
triage.triage_reason: 大学による研究・教育体制強化に関する発表であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地域流行疾患であり、本記事は大学主導の体制強化・研究イニシアチブに関する内容。新規の症例急増や異常事態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, si aggrava la situazione in Congo: oltre 4mila morti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens: over 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is worsening, with 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, yielding a case fatality rate near 50%. The Ministry of Health reports the rising toll, while Médecins Sans Frontières cautions the true figure may be higher. This outbreak is the deadliest Ebola episode recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to date and the second-largest globally, behind West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic. The report underscores ongoing transmission and the strain on health systems. The article provides no details on symptoms, transmission sources, vaccination status, or imported/exported cases, but the data indicate a severe, expanding public health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴの状況悪化：死者4000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで、致死率約50%、死者4000人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクも懸念されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行のみを主題としており、Angolaへの言及は本文サマリーにないため除外。MSFが実際の数値はさらに多い可能性を指摘しており、過小報告のリスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控健康风险提示：流感中低流行水平波动
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC Health Risk Alert: Influenza Activity Fluctuates at Moderate-to-Low Levels.
article.articleSummary: China CDC health risk alert (Published 2026-10-03) notes influenza activity fluctuates at moderate-to-low levels across China during the Oct 1-7 National Day holiday travel period, while COVID-19 remains at low endemic levels. With increased population movement, authorities urge masking at transport hubs and indoor venues to curb respiratory disease spread. Mosquito-borne diseases persist in southern provinces, with dengue fever and chikungunya fever presenting scattered cases and local clusters; residents are advised to eliminate standing water to reduce vector breeding. Holidays raise risks of norovirus infections and hand-foot-mouth disease due to gatherings and suboptimal food/water hygiene. The WeChat risk alert was published on Oct 2. For outbound travel, travelers should monitor destination-specific infectious disease risks and report overseas travel history if ill after return. Flu vaccination is emphasized as it reduces severe outcomes; the flu season begins in October regionally, prompting early vaccination near home.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理局 健康リスク情報：インフルエンザは中低水準で変動
triage.triage_reason: 季節性感染症（インフルエンザ・COVID-19・デング熱等）に関する定例の公衆衛生注意喚起であり、異常な流行や重篤な影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 国慶節連休に伴う通常の季節性感染症注意喚起であり、複数疾患（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、デング、チクングニア、ノロウイルス、手足口病）に言及しているが、いずれも中低水準・散発的との記述でシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola dépasse les 4 000 morts et devient la plus meurtrière de l'histoire du pays - La Presse de Tunisie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola epidemic surpasses 4,000 deaths and becomes the deadliest in the country's history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths among about 8,300 confirmed cases, making it the deadliest outbreak in the country’s history (the 17th Ebola outbreak there). As of Oct 2, 2026, 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries are reported. In North Kivu, six Ebola cases were noted, four of which were fatal, in areas controlled by the M23 rebels; M23, reportedly backed by Rwanda, announced these figures. The outbreak began in Ituri province and has spread to seven provinces in the north and east. Response is hampered by resource shortages, armed groups, and public mistrust in health authorities amid insecurity. The UN says violent clashes disrupted response in Ituri; a treatment center was burned, and soldiers reportedly entered a site hosting displaced people, causing evacuations. WHO had shown encouraging signs by mid-September, but AU health officials say the epidemic remains uncontrolled.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱の流行が死者4,000人を超え、同国史上最悪の流行に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC史上最悪の流行となり死者4,000人超・7州に拡大、紛争地域での対応困難と国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ルワンダは発生地域として付与されているが、記事はM23がルワンダに支援されていると報じているのみで、ルワンダ国内での発生は確認されないため除外した。武力紛争による対応阻害、治療センター焼失など不安定要因が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Kinshasa met en place un plan de préparation et de réponse de 180 jours chiffré à 1,2 milliard USD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Kinshasa puts in place a 180-day preparedness and response plan valued at 1.2 billion USD.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launches a 180-day, $1.2 billion preparedness and response plan for Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, following official declaration on May 15, 2026. The plan aims to sustain surveillance, patient care, contact tracing, and community prevention as the outbreak spreads across seven provinces and 63 health zones, with Ituri as the main hotspot. At a Kinshasa press briefing on Oct 2, INSP Director-General Dieudonné Mwamba outlined the plan and stressed transparency and accountability in resource use, urging partners to confirm their commitments. Health Minister Samuel Kamba reported involvement of 97 partners, but only 25% had justified resources; noncompliant organizations may be contacted or removed. Incident Manager Steve Ahuka Mundeke provided epidemiological figures: 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths (approx. 48.4% case fatality), with over 2,100 recoveries. Affected provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Tshopo, Sud-Ubangi.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：キンシャサが12億米ドル規模の180日間準備・対応計画を策定
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がDRC7州63保健区に拡大し、確認症例8,300件、死亡4,018件（致死率約48.4%）に達する大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既に2026年5月15日に公式宣言された既知のアウトブレイクに関する続報。致死率約48.4%と非常に高く、97パートナーのうち資源確保が確認できたのは25%のみという資金・リソースギャップが指摘されている。国際支援ニーズが明確。

article.articleHeadline: V DR Kongo zaradi izbruha ebole umrlo več kot 4000 ljudi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, more than 4,000 people have died due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing the worst Ebola outbreak ever recorded. Congolese authorities reported in Kinshasa on October 3 that the outbreak has claimed more than 4,000 lives, with the death toll at 4,018. A total of 8,300 cases have been laboratory-confirmed. The report underscores that this is the deadliest Ebola outbreak to date. All figures refer to confirmed cases and deaths, and no information on specific infection sources or affected provinces is provided in the article. The data reflect the ongoing, severe impact of Ebola in the DRC, marking a critical public health emergency for the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行により4000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 過去最悪規模のエボラ流行で死者4,018人、症例8,300人と公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も満たすためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は感染源や具体的な感染州については言及していないが、過去最悪規模のエボラ流行として深刻度が高く、国際的な支援ニーズが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Đà Nẵng ghi nhận 2 ca sốt rét ngoại lai, người bệnh từng ở châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Da Nang records 2 imported malaria cases, patients who had previously been in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two imported malaria cases in Da Nang, Vietnam, involve travelers returning from Africa. Between September 29 and October 1, Da Nang recorded two malaria cases with epidemiological links to Africa: one had stayed in Nigeria and the other had been in Côte d’Ivoire before returning. Laboratory testing confirmed Plasmodium falciparum infection in both cases; they are currently receiving treatment at Da Nang Hospital. Plasmodium falciparum is a highly dangerous malaria parasite capable of severe disease and life-threatening complications if not promptly diagnosed and treated. The city’s CDC calls for enhanced surveillance, early detection, rapid testing, and timely management to prevent secondary transmission. Health facilities should screen for fever, chills, sweating, or unexplained fatigue, especially in people with recent travel to malaria-endemic regions, and report suspected cases immediately. Since January, Da Nang has recorded four imported P. falciparum malaria cases.

triage.headline_ja: ダナンで海外由来マラリア2例を確認、患者はアフリカ滞在歴あり
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダナンで輸入マラリア症例が2例確認されたが、現時点で散発的な輸入例に留まり、二次感染の報告はなく、国際的拡大のリスクは低い。地域CDCが監視強化を呼びかけており、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 症例はいずれもアフリカ（ナイジェリア、コートジボワール）渡航歴のある輸入例であり、ベトナム国内での感染ではない。コートジボワール・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。地域CDCは監視強化と早期発見・治療を呼びかけているが、二次感染の兆候は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: सरकारी नशा मुक्ति केंद्रों में एचआईवी और हेपेटाइटिस की जांच जल्द
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV and Hepatitis Testing Soon in Government De-Addiction Centers.
article.articleSummary: Punjab government to begin HIV, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C testing in government drug de-addiction and rehabilitation centers, linking 'Triple H' screening to the War Against Drugs initiative. The move aims to screen people undergoing rehabilitation for blood-borne infections, enable timely treatment, and connect patients to ongoing care and medical monitoring. Acknowledging higher risk among those who inject drugs, health minister Dr. Balbir Singh emphasized early diagnosis and counseling. Rather than periodic camps, screening will be integrated into the de-addiction process to provide regular testing and identify those needing further tests or treatment during care. In August, Punjab adopted NAT and CLIA testing to strengthen rapid identification and blood safety for HIV, Hepatitis B and C. Free testing for these infections is available at all general clinics. Private centers have started, with government centers to follow, aiming for seamless screening, treatment, referrals, and follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 政府の麻薬依存症治療センターでHIVおよび肝炎の検査が近く開始へ
triage.triage_reason: 既存の公衆衛生対策（検査体制の拡充）に関する行政施策の報道であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態ではないため該当基準なし。
triage.notes: これは麻薬依存症治療施設におけるHIV・肝炎検査体制の拡充という保健政策に関する記事であり、新規感染症の発生や流行を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Jaunpur News: मच्छर जनित रोगों से बचाव को वार्डों में कराई गई फॉगिंग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaunpur News: Fogging was carried out in wards to prevent mosquito-borne diseases.
article.articleSummary: Jaunpur's Jafrababad Nagar Panchayat intensified fogging after the rainy spell to curb mosquito-borne diseases, notably dengue and malaria. Under Chairperson Umme Rahila, the campaign ran late into the evening across wards including Tadatala, Chak Mahmood, and Shekhwada, plus the main market and other areas. Fogging machines sprayed a chemical solution, targeting drains, water-logged locations, and garbage-prone zones to prevent larvae from breeding. Officials warned that post-monsoon periods heighten the risk of mosquito-borne illnesses. The article reports no confirmed cases, focusing instead on preventive vector-control measures to reduce transmission risk ahead of potential outbreaks as of 3 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ジャウンプル・ニュース：蚊媒介性疾患予防のため各区でくん煙消毒を実施
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例の報告はなく、季節的な予防的防蚊対策についての行政広報記事であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は確定症例のない予防的な防蚊（フォギング）活動の報告であり、デング・マラリアの発生状況についての具体的データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: വെറും ജലദോഷപ്പനിയല്ല, ശരീരത്തെയാകെ തളർത്തുന്ന വൈറൽ അണുബാധയാണ് ഇൻഫ്ലുവൻസ; പ്രതിരോധം പ്രധാനം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not just a waterborne fever, but a viral infection that weakens the body: influenza; immunity is paramount.
article.articleSummary: Influenza is a viral infection caused by influenza A and B. Annual antigenic changes enable reinfection. Symptoms appear abruptly and include fever, body pains, fatigue, dry cough, sore throat, and nasal congestion; children may have vomiting or diarrhea. Most recover in 5–7 days, though cough and fatigue can persist up to two weeks. Transmission occurs via droplets from coughs or sneezes, talking, or contaminated surfaces; contagious from one day before symptoms to about five days after onset. Prevention emphasizes vaccination (annual flu shot for those over 6 months), hand hygiene, covering coughs, and staying away from others when sick. Treatment centers on rest, fluids, and light nutrition; antibiotics are not effective against viruses. Antivirals may be used in high-risk patients if started within 48 hours. Seek care for breathing trouble, chest pain, fever lasting more than three days, or severe fatigue, especially in children. Reported from Thalassery Mission Hospital, Kerala.

triage.headline_ja: ただの風邪ではない、全身を衰弱させるウイルス感染症がインフルエンザ；予防が重要
triage.triage_reason: 特定の集団発生や異常事態を報じるものではなく、インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの症状・予防・治療に関する一般啓発情報であり、特定の集団発生や異常な感染状況の報告ではない。ケララ州の病院名が言及されているが、これは情報源であり発生地という意味ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Laborantin stirbt an Pest in Irkutsk: 200 Personen unter Beobachtung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lab technician dies of the plague in Irkutsk: 200 people under observation.
article.articleSummary: Plague death reported in Irkutsk region, Russia; 28-year-old laboratory technician Darja S. (also reported as Darja T.) died from pneumonic plague after exposure at the Irkutsk Antiplague Institute, which handles live Yersinia pestis cultures. In Schelechow, a hospital department near Irkutsk, the unit is quarantined and about 200 close contacts are under medical observation; no illnesses have yet been reported. The patient was admitted Tuesday with severe pneumonia and died Thursday; officials describe a suspected highly dangerous infection. Investigators have opened a criminal case over safety violations; sources differ on the infection source: a laboratory accident involving a broken reagent vial, or infection after a trip to Thailand. It is unclear whether cases are imported or linked to the lab. The WHO emphasizes pneumonic plague is highly contagious via droplets and can be fatal without prompt treatment. Public events in Irkutsk were canceled.

triage.headline_ja: イルクーツクでラボ技術者がペスト（肺ペスト）で死亡：200人が経過観察下に
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、高い感染力と致死性を有する病原体であることから公衆衛生上重大な懸念があり、感染源（研究所事故か渡航歴か）も未確定で国際的拡大リスクの評価が必要なため。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれるタイへの渡航歴は感染源の一仮説として挙げられているに過ぎず、実際の発生国として確認できないためverified_locationsは空とした。感染源（研究所事故か渡航歴か）の確定情報が待たれる。

article.articleHeadline: Ternyata Ini Alasan Influenza A Cepat Menular, Sebanyak 30 Ribu Kasus Ditemukan di Tangerang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Turns out this is why Influenza A spreads quickly, with as many as 30,000 cases found in Tangerang.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is driving a surge in Tangerang, Indonesia, with about 30,000 influenza A cases recorded from January to September 2026, per the Tangerang Health Office. In the last two months (August–September 2026) cases rose by roughly 5,000 per month. The Health Office notes rapid transmission resembles COVID-19, spreading mainly through close contact and respiratory droplets. Weather factors—persistent rains and dust—are cited as contributing to the rise, underscoring the need for healthy lifestyle and hygiene (PHBS) measures. Prevention emphasizes maintaining immune strength and health protocols to reduce close contact with patients. The surge affects nearly all age groups and spans 29 districts across Tangerang, not limited to a specific demographic.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAがなぜ急速に感染拡大するのか、タンゲラン市で3万件の症例が確認される
triage.triage_reason: タンゲランで季節性インフルエンザAの症例数が急増（29地区・全年齢層に拡大）しているが、重症度や死亡者数、国際的拡大の情報がなく、現時点ではフルリスク評価に進む根拠は不十分なため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 地方保健局（Tangerang Health Office）の統計に基づく報道で、症例数は多いが重症度・死亡・国際的拡大に関する情報がない。季節性要因（降雨・粉塵）が主因とされ、COVID-19との類似性が言及されているのみで、新規変異株等の異常性は確認されていない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Ramai Lagi di RI, Ini Sejarah Panjangnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Still Widespread in Indonesia; Here Is Its Long History.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A remains widespread in Indonesia with rising activity, including Bandung where more residents visit health facilities and emergency rooms. National surveillance in Aug–Sep 2026 shows a 56% positivity rate among 265 sentinel specimens, with 148 testing positive for influenza, dominated by A(H1N1)pdm09. Despite the rise, primary care (puskesmas) activity is medium and hospitals low, reflecting a seasonal pattern in Indonesia. Influenza A is not a new virus; it has circulated for over a century. Symptoms include fever, myalgia, headache, nausea, and fatigue, with transmission mainly via respiratory droplets. Historically, the A type caused the 1918–1919 Spanish Flu (H1N1) with about 500 million infections and 20–50 million deaths. Virus identification occurred in 1933; vaccines began around 1942, and GISRS was established in 1952 to monitor global strains, with pandemics like the 1957 Asian Flu (H2N2).

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアでインフルエンザAが再び流行、その長い歴史
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)pdm09の陽性率上昇が報告されているが、重症度や医療機関負荷は中〜低レベルであり、季節的パターンの範囲内とされているため、現時点ではフルRRAに進める根拠は乏しい。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)pdm09による活動増加で、新規性や異常性は低い。プライマリケア・病院負荷も中〜低と報告されており、現時点ではWATCHが妥当。続報でサーベイランスデータの推移を確認する。

article.articleHeadline: Umrlo že več kot 4000 ljudi, smrtnost virusa 48-odstotna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 people have already died; the virus's fatality rate is 48%.
article.articleSummary: Over 4,000 people have died from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases and a case fatality rate of 48.4%, per AFP as of October 3, 2026. The outbreak, officially confirmed mid-May, spans northern and eastern DRC, with the first Bundibugyo-strain case recorded in Ituri province. Response efforts are hindered by public distrust and violence, including militia clashes in Ituri that displaced more than 5,000 people. In North Kivu, an attack on a health facility killed a contracted worker; a treatment center in Ituri burned. The United States plans an additional $267 million to curb spread. Trials of vaccines and therapies are under way, including initial doses of Ervebo for health workers, a vaccine previously effective against the Zaire ebolavirus strain.

triage.headline_ja: すでに4000人以上が死亡、致死率48%――コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス流行
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%・死者4000人超の大規模エボラ流行であり、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大、治安悪化による対応困難、国際支援（米国の追加資金拠出）も発生しているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 米国は資金拠出国であり発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で、民兵による襲撃や治療施設焼失など対応が著しく困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: V DR Kongo zaradi najhujšega doslej zaznanega izbruha ebole umrlo več kot 4000 ljudi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, more than 4,000 people have died due to the worst Ebola outbreak recorded to date.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the worst Ebola outbreak on record has killed more than 4,000 people, with 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths (case-fatality 48.4%). The outbreak, confirmed in mid‑May, has affected northern and eastern regions, with the initial case linked to Bundibugyo in Ituri province. Response is hampered by distrust and violence, as UN reports show more than 5,000 people displaced from Ituri after militia clashes; an Ebola treatment center was burned, and a contractor responsible for outbreak detection was killed in an attack on a health facility in North Kivu. Treatments and vaccines under evaluation include Ervebo, with first doses given to health workers under a clinical trial. Ervebo has previously shown efficacy against Zaire ebolavirus. The United States plans to provide an additional $267 million to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、史上最悪のエボラ出血熱流行で死者4000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、死者4000人超という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、暴力・不信感による対応妨害や国際支援(米国の追加資金拠出)も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国は発生地域ではなく資金支援国として記載されているため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: احتمال شیوع طاعون ریوی در سیبری؛ قرنطینه بیمارستانی در روسیه
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia; hospital quarantine in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague risk is reported in Siberia after a death in Irkutsk region. A hospital in the town of Shlkhov near Irkutsk quarantined its inpatient ward following a young woman’s death after severe pneumonia and ventilation; authorities have not officially confirmed pneumonic plague. The outpatient clinic remains open. Details of the case are disputed: one account says she returned from Thailand; another implicates a staff member, Darya S., at the Irkutsk Plague Institute, whose handling of live bacteria allegedly led to exposure. Investigations into potential safety violations have begun. Governor Igor Kobzev convened a special meeting; all public events in Irkutsk were canceled; Rospotrebnadzor chief Anna Popova visited. About 197 people are under surveillance; roughly 189 are hospitalized. Plague is rare in Russia, with the last known case in 2016 in Altai, but it is treatable with antibiotics if detected early.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで肺ペスト流行の恐れ；ロシアで病院隔離
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑いの死亡例が発生し、病院隔離・公共イベント中止などの対応がとられており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。タイへの渡航歴は一説として言及されているが未確認・争いがあり、実際の発生地としては扱わない。公式には肺ペストと確認されておらず、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: le chef de la diplomatie française dans l'épicentre d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The French Foreign Minister in the Ebola Epicenter
article.articleSummary: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot arrived Saturday in the eastern Ituri province of the Democratic Republic of Congo, the epicenter of the most severe Ebola outbreak in the country's history, AFP reported. The DRC is grappling with its 17th Ebola outbreak, underscoring a protracted public health crisis in a region long affected by the disease. The report situates Ituri as the focal point of transmission within the DRC’s ongoing Ebola response. No specific figures on cases or deaths, laboratory confirmations, infection sources, or containment milestones are provided in the excerpt. Barrot's visit signals continued international attention to the Ebola emergency, as authorities and partners work to curb transmission in a high-risk setting.

triage.headline_ja: RDC：フランス外相、エボラ出血熱の震源地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で「同国史上最も深刻なエボラ出血熱流行」とされる第17次アウトブレイクが継続しており、フランス外相の訪問という高い国際的関心も確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事には具体的な症例数・死亡者数・感染経路等の詳細データは含まれていないが、エボラ出血熱という疾患特性上、重症度・流行しやすさ・国際支援の必要性は高いと判断した。続報で具体的疫学データの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 4.018 Orang Tewas Akibat Wabah Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4,018 people died due to the Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has caused 4,018 deaths from 8,300 cases, with 2,162 recoveries and a case-fatality rate of 48.4% as of early October 2026. The outbreak began in Ituri (northeastern DRC) in mid-May and has spread to seven provinces across the north and east, including North Kivu, amid instability and conflict. Violence and scarce resources hinder control efforts, with over 5,000 displaced refugees reported by the UN. A Ebola patient transit center in Ituri was set ablaze after army involvement, and a contractor working at a health facility in North Kivu was killed. International support includes France pledging €13.4 million (Jan–Jul) and the United States providing US$267 million. Vaccines and therapeutics are under study against the Bundibugyo strain; first Ervebo doses have been given to frontline health workers in clinical trials, despite Ervebo’s prior effectiveness against the Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行により4,018人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行がDRC複数州に拡大し、紛争により対応が阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 米国・フランスは支援国として記載されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株による流行で複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ等）に拡大しており、紛争による対応阻害が深刻化している。

article.articleHeadline: 3,832 children diagnosed with leprosy as India targets interruption of transmission by 2027
article.articleSummary: 3,832 child leprosy cases reported in India during 2025-26, including 37 with Grade-2 disability at diagnosis, signaling delayed detection. Child cases rose 91.6% above the NLEP target of 2,000. Across all ages, India detected 91,783 new leprosy cases in 2025-26; prevalence 0.56 per 10,000; 1,945 patients had G2D at diagnosis (2.12% of cases); national G2D rate 1.34 per million, above target. India led the WHO’s 2025 global update with the world’s largest share of new cases: 91,783, followed by Brazil 22,901 and Indonesia 16,292, together 78.3%. The WHO notes 3,832 child cases in India during April 2025–March 2026. The National Strategic Plan 2023–27 aims to interrupt transmission at district level by 2027, with zero indigenous child cases for five consecutive years; 2026–27 targets: 1,000 child cases and G2D <0.5 per million. Detection gaps and stigma remain ongoing challenges.

triage.headline_ja: インドが2027年までの感染連鎖遮断を目標とする中、3,832人の小児がハンセン病と診断される
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は慢性感染症であり、国家サーベイランスプログラムの定例報告に過ぎず、急性の公衆衛生緊急事態や国際的拡大のリスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの国家ハンセン病根絶プログラム（NLEP）の年次統計報告であり、ブラジル・インドネシアはグローバル順位比較のための言及に留まり、発生地域としての主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : deux patientes guéries quittent le CTE de Mutwanga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: two recovered female patients leave Mutwanga Ebola Treatment Center.
article.articleSummary: Two female Ebola survivors, Wasingya Sabuni and Kavugho Syayisoghola, were discharged on Oct 2 from the Ebola Treatment Center at Mutwanga General Reference Hospital in Mutwanga health zone, North Kivu, after 22 and 28 days of care. Discharge certificates were issued by Dr. Germain Kamaliro, who urged prompt care-seeking and cautioned against ignorance that leads to deaths. Mutwanga health zone reports 15 confirmed Ebola cases: 2 recovered, 6 under follow-up, 4 dead. Separately, 10 recovered patients left treatment centers in Beni on Oct 2, contributing to a notable daily tally. By Sept 30, no new health zones were affected, with 41 total recoveries across affected provinces. Ongoing community sensitization and survivor reintegration efforts continue to support the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ：回復した女性患者2名がムトワンガのエボラ治療センターを退所
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のDRCエボラアウトブレイクに関する続報であり、死亡例や継続的なフォローアップ患者が存在するなど重症度・流行継続性の基準に該当し、当局の対応（政府の関心）も確認されるためフルRRAでの継続評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 既存のDRC北キブ州エボラアウトブレイクに関する定期的な進捗報告（回復者退院）。新規地域への拡大はなく、感染管理活動は継続中。既知アウトブレイクのため新規性は低いが、重症度・流行継続性の観点から経過監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 男子上山砍毛竹，突然被刺一下，确诊"七日疯"！医生：若放任不管，致死率或达100%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man climbs a mountain to cut bamboo, is suddenly pricked once, diagnosed with "Seven-Day Madness"! Doctor: If left untreated, the mortality rate could reach 100%.
article.articleSummary: 69-year-old Hua Bo (pseudonym) in Zhejiang, China, developed severe tetanus after a bamboo puncture on the left forearm. The wound was red and purulent but seemed to heal; within days he developed toothache, inability to open the mouth (trismus), difficulty chewing, neck and back stiffness, and generalized muscle spasms, culminating in respiratory failure and ICU admission. He received CPR, tracheal intubation, mechanical ventilation, high-dose tetanus immune globulin, and antibiotics; he stabilized and is recovering. Tetanus is caused by Clostridium tetani, found in soil, dust, rust, and animal feces; it is not caused by wind, and untreated infection carries death. With treatment, global mortality remains 30-50%. Incubation ranges from 1 day to months, often around day 7, hence the 'seven-day madness'. Diagnosis is clinical. Prevention focuses on proper wound care, vaccination, and timely medical care after injuries; protection in adults over 40 is low (~11%), and boosters may be advised.

triage.headline_ja: 男性が山で竹を切っていた際に刺され、「七日風（破傷風）」と診断！医師：放置すれば致死率は100%にも
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個人症例報告であり、破傷風はヒト-ヒト感染せず、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 破傷風は土壌中の菌による外傷性感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染しないため、単発症例は公衆衛生上のシグナルとはならない。健康教育目的の一般向け記事と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Raiva em pets: veja como proteger cães e gatos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies in pets: see how to protect dogs and cats.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a risk for pets in Brazil, including the interior of São Paulo. Between 2015 and 2026, Brazil recorded 270 rabies cases in dogs and cats. Transmission occurs mainly via saliva, most often through bites, but deep scratches and licking exposed wounds or mucous membranes also pose risks. Even indoor pets face risk from urban bats. Early signs are nonspecific (fever, reduced appetite, irritability, withdrawal); progressive neurological symptoms include disorientation, aggression, and excessive salivation from swallowing difficulties. Definitive diagnosis is only confirmed postmortem in brain tissue, making any neurological change or exposure to a potentially infected animal an emergency. Prevention centers on vaccination starting at four months with mandatory annual boosters. Vaccination not only protects pets but also reduces human risk and community transmission. PetCenso Saúde data show rabies vaccination is among the most common canine/feline vaccines; insured pets undergo more vet visits and vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: ペットの狂犬病：犬や猫を守る方法
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な啓発記事であり、新規の異常な発生や急性の公衆衛生リスクを示すものではない。過去10年間の累積データに基づく予防啓発情報であり、緊急性・社会的関心の高まりは確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はペット飼い主向けの啓発・予防情報であり、2015-2026年の累積270例というデータに基づく一般的注意喚起。急性アウトブレイクやヒトへの感染拡大を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'impasse face aux combats et à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Deadlock in the face of fighting and Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Fighting in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues amid a severe Ebola outbreak that worsens a dire humanitarian crisis. Despite intensified diplomacy, clashes persist in North Kivu and South Kivu, with the AFC/M23 group controlling vast territories and fighting Congolese forces in Masisi, Walikale, Mwenga, Fizi and Uvira. MONUSCO chief James Swan reported a widening gap between peace talks and ground reality; two ceasefire verification missions visited Minembwe and Masisi. Ebola, declared in May, had 8,000 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths across seven provinces as of 28 September, with the outbreak centered in Ituri and now spreading toward North Kivu; insecurity and access challenges hamper response. Over 26 million facing acute food insecurity; more than 6 million displaced; UN humanitarian plan remains underfunded. Civil society cites M23 abuses and mineral exploitation (cassiterite, coltan, gold) fueling conflict. ADF, ISIS-affiliate, attacks civilian sites in Ituri and parts of North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：戦闘とエボラに直面して行き詰まる

triage.notes: 発生地域にFijiが含まれるが記事内容と無関係なため除外。エボラはイツリ州を中心に北キブ州へ拡大中で、紛争（AFC/M23）により対応が妨げられている。致死率が高く、人道危機（避難民600万人超、食料不安2600万人超）と相まって深刻度が高い。

She developed fever on Sept 30, with cough and vomiting on Oct 1, and tested positive for Influenza B at Queen Elizabeth Hospital's Pediatric Intensive Care Unit. She had not received the 2026/27 seasonal flu vaccine. Household contacts recently had mild fever and upper respiratory symptoms and have recovered. The Department of Health's Centre for Health Protection reports influenza activity remains high and is expected to stay elevated in coming weeks, with more school outbreaks. Since late June, 21 severe pediatric influenza cases have been recorded in Hong Kong: 16 recovered/discharged, 2 stable, 2 critical, 1 death. No travel during incubation; investigation ongoing.

article.articleHeadline: അഞ്ചാംപനി വ്യാപിക്കുന്നു; നഷ്ടമായത് മൂന്ന് കുട്ടികളുടെ ജീവൻ | Measles is spreading
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles is spreading; three children have died.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks are rising in Kerala, with Kozhikode district contributing to the surge. As of October 2, 2026, 477 cases have been confirmed and 940 cases are under suspicion, with three deaths reported. The current year shows a markedly higher burden than last year, which had 37 confirmed cases and 331 symptomatic individuals seeking care. In Kozhikode, one death was reported last month, and authorities note two additional deaths among those suspected of infection. Health officials have issued heightened vigilance amid the spread. Symptoms include high fever and characteristic rashes; delayed diagnosis and treatment can be fatal. Vaccination remains the main preventive measure, but gaps persist. The Measles-Rubella vaccine is recommended at 9 months and again at 16–24 months; in Kozhikode, some deaths occurred among children who could not be vaccinated due to other illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が拡大;3人の子供が死亡

article.articleHeadline: Krievijā gandrīz 200 cilvēku hospitalizēti pēc aizdomām par mēra infekciju
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Russia, nearly 200 people hospitalized after suspected plague infection.
article.articleSummary: In Russia’s Irkutsk Oblast, nearly 200 people are hospitalized for observation after contact with a patient who reportedly died from pneumonic plague. No official confirmation yet; Shelekhov Hospital is quarantined for a 'highly dangerous infection,' while the regional hospital complex remains open. About 189 people are under observation; 12 were referred to an anti-plague institute, with some showing symptoms but no confirmed infection. The deceased was a young woman who arrived Sept 29 with pneumonia-like symptoms and died two days later after ventilatory support. Possible infection sources include work at an anti-plague institute or a lab accident; other accounts mention travel to Thailand. Governor Igor Kobzev convened an emergency commission; Chief Sanitary Doctor Anna Popova arrived. Known contacts are under medical supervision; initial tests have been negative. Yersinia pestis causes bubonic, pneumonic, or septicemic plague; pneumonic form can spread person-to-person.

article.articleHeadline: RDC- France : la coopération et la riposte contre Ebola abordées à la Présidence congolaise - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC-France: Cooperation and the Ebola response discussed at the Congolese Presidency - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 3 October 2026 — President Félix Tshisekedi and French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot reviewed bilateral cooperation and the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola response strategy, with Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba and Deputy Foreign Minister Noëlla Ayanganagato present. Discussions covered eastern DRC security and the government’s outbreak response, with Barrot planning a Bunia visit to bolster the effort and to implement France’s commitments under a protocol on impunity and reparations for sexual violence in conflicts. France delivered 20 tonnes of aid in July to the DRC, directed to Ituri province, the outbreak’s epicentre, coordinated by the Crisis and Support Centre (CDCS) of the Foreign Ministry. Bilateral cooperation spans diplomatic, security, health, and sustainable development domains, reinforced by high-level engagements.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国・フランス：エボラ対応における協力がコンゴ大統領府で協議される - ACP

article.articleHeadline: Antiviral Research: N70S/Y155H Combined Mutation of Neuraminidase of Avian Influenza H9N2 Virus confers oseltamivir and zanamivir resistance and pathogenicity to Mice
article.articleSummary: H9N2 avian influenza circulating in China carries dual neuraminidase mutations N70S and Y155H, linked to reduced in vitro susceptibility to oseltamivir and zanamivir; peramivir remains effective. In vitro assays show up to 42-fold and 23-fold reductions in neuraminidase inhibition for isolates with N70S/Y155H compared with non-mutants. In vivo, these H9N2 strains exhibit high pathogenicity in BALB/c mice without prior adaptation. The N70S/Y155H mutations are common among recent Chinese isolates (1998–2024). The study highlights limited in vivo protection by neuraminidase inhibitors against these mutants and urges enhanced surveillance and prevention for H9N2 with N70S/Y155H. While not definitively elevating public health risk, it underscores the need to monitor resistance trends in poultry-derived H9N2.

triage.headline_ja: 抗ウイルス薬研究：鳥インフルエンザH9N2ウイルスのノイラミニダーゼのN70S/Y155H複合変異はオセルタミビルおよびザナミビル耐性およびマウスへの病原性を付与する
triage.triage_reason: H9N2の薬剤耐性変異株が中国で流行し、マウスモデルで高い病原性を示しているが、ヒト感染の直接的なクラスターや重症例の報告がなく、現段階では情報不足。引き続き監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は学術的な研究論文の報告であり、ヒト感染の確定例やアウトブレイク報告ではない。ただし、N70S/Y155H複合変異の薬剤耐性特性とマウスでの高病原性、および中国での流行が確認されているため、鳥-ヒト感染の可能性と耐性菌株の監視という観点からWATCHレベルの継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Drug trial seeks to halt DR Congo's deadliest Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyro ebolavirus outbreak in eastern DR Congo: 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,000 deaths since mid-May, spanning seven provinces with Ituri as the epicenter. No approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus. A post-exposure prophylaxis trial of Gilead’s antiviral pill obeldesivir began in July at an Ituri health centre, enrolling over 250 high-risk contacts (health workers and relatives) who are asymptomatic; target ~1,000 participants aged 12+ exposed within the last five days. The study is randomized, 50% placebo; participants monitored daily for 21 days, with a final follow-up at 42 days. If symptoms develop, they receive supportive treatment. The trial aims to determine if obeldesivir can interrupt transmission before symptom onset, since Ebola spreads only after symptoms begin, potentially breaking the infection chain. Coordinated by ALIMA with INRB and ANRS Emerging Infectious Diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 治療薬治験、DRコンゴ史上最悪のエボラ流行の阻止を目指す

triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないボンジブゴエボラウイルスの流行で、国際機関（ALIMA、INRB、ANRS）が治験を実施中。死亡者数4,000人は極めて深刻。

She developed fever on 30 September, with cough and vomiting on 1 October, and was treated at a private clinic before transfer to Queen Elizabeth Hospital for PICU care. article.articleHeadline: Actualité | RDC-France : Félix Tshisekedi et le ministre français des Affaires Étrangères Jean-Noël Barrot discutent de la sécurité et de la riposte contre Ebola | mediacongo.net
