article.articleSummary: On 3 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi met French Minister of Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot in Kinshasa to review bilateral cooperation, the security situation in the eastern regions, and the government's Ebola outbreak response. The visit also aims to implement France–DRC commitments under a protocol addressing impunity and providing reparations for sexual violence linked to conflicts. article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Medical camps to prevent dengue infection in Chennai.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever control measures are underway in Chennai as the civic administration intensifies sanitation and vector-control operations in high-incidence areas. Teams survey areas with higher dengue activity and conduct on-site screening; residents with fever lasting more than three days are advised to undergo blood testing. The program emphasizes early detection and treatment at the camps, with a focus on preventing dengue transmission by improving sanitation and eliminating mosquito breeding sites. The public can avail themselves of these camps for treatment.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola cases reported in areas controlled by M23 rebels in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, six new Ebola virus disease cases were reported in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo in territories controlled by the M23 rebel coalition. Two cases are in Kaïna and four in Alimbongo, near the Lubero frontline with government forces. The four cases were identified through post-mortem testing of deceased individuals, while two other patients remain under treatment as authorities intensify contact tracing. The M23 alliance controls portions of North Kivu and South Kivu. The outbreak, first declared in May, has exceeded 8,300 confirmed cases and more than 4,000 deaths according to official data. This development follows the recovery and discharge of the lone active patient earlier in the week, as reported by Reuters.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部のM23反政府勢力支配地域で新たなエボラ感染例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部の大規模エボラ流行（8300例超、死者4000人超）が反政府勢力支配地域で継続・拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当および国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 紛争地域（M23支配域）での発生であり、接触者追跡や治療アクセスが制限される可能性が高く、既存の大規模流行（2026年5月発生、8300例超・死者4000人超）の継続事例として扱うべき。地域安全保障上の制約がアウトブレイク対応に影響する点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde intensifica ações de combate ao Aedes aegypti em João Pessoa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department intensifies measures to combat Aedes aegypti in João Pessoa.
article.articleSummary: João Pessoa, Brazil’s coastal capital, faces conditions favorable for Aedes aegypti proliferation due to El Niño–related heat and irregular rainfall, raising risks of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya as of 3 October 2026. The Municipal Health Secretariat intensifies prevention, monitoring, and vector control through integrated actions with the Municipal Health Network and other city departments. Environmental Surveillance prioritizes education for children and adolescents from early childhood through high school to curb breeding sites. Community Health Agents conduct home visits to identify risk microareas, especially areas with stored recyclables that can accumulate water. Epidemiological Surveillance investigates residences and workplaces of suspected or confirmed dengue or Zika cases to locate sources. Intersectoral collaboration with Emlur and Seinfra targets abandoned lots and infrastructure issues; residents are urged to seal water tanks, eliminate standing water, clean gutters, store tires in rain-protected places, and report hazards.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、ジョアン・ペソアでネッタイシマカ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 蚊媒介感染症のリスク上昇に対する通常の予防・対策活動の報告であり、異常な流行や症例急増の情報はない。
triage.notes: エルニーニョによる気候条件が媒介蚊の繁殖に適しているため予防的措置を強化しているという内容で、具体的な症例数や流行の急増は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC health minister says worst of Ebola is over
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-03, the DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) appears to have peaked, with cases and deaths declining in Ituri, North Kivu and other eastern/northeastern provinces since mid-May. The multi‑provincial outbreak spans seven provinces amid ongoing conflict, displacement, insecurity, and community mistrust that hinder response. The World Health Organization cautions the outbreak is not yet under control and urges scale-up of interventions, noting most infections and deaths occur in communities due to delays in seeking care. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976; there is currently no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo. Trials in the UK and Canada are testing vaccines targeting Bundibugro, with plans for availability before year-end. A video caption cites the outbreak topping 8,000 confirmed cases. The article provides no explicit imported/exported case details, emphasizing domestic transmission and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DRC保健相、エボラ出血熱の最悪期は過ぎたと発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで多州にわたる大規模エボラ流行（17回目、8000例超）が継続中であり、WHOも制御下にないと警告していることから、深刻性・異常性・流行継続性の観点でフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: UKとカナダはワクチン治験の実施国であり、流行発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。感染拡大の国際的波及に関する明示的記述はないが、紛争・人口移動による地域内拡大リスクは継続している。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Trial of post-Ebola exposure drug underway
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s eastern Ituri Province hosts a post-exposure Ebola trial (EBO-PEP) with more than 250 participants; investigators aim to recruit nearly 1,000 exposed individuals aged over 12 who had contact with a confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola case within the last five days but are asymptomatic. The experimental antiviral pill acts as post-exposure prophylaxis given immediately after suspected exposure, with in-person monitoring daily for 21 days and a final follow-up at 42 days. Bundibugyo Ebola has no licensed vaccine, though Ervebo is used for health workers and may offer some protection, its efficacy against Bundibugyo is unproven. The trial underscores DR Congo’s deadliest Ebola outbreak, which has tallied at least 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,000 deaths since mid-May. Participants describe hopeful effects, noting reduced household transmission in some families.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ曝露後予防薬の治験が進行中
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイク(確定症例8,300例、死亡4,000人)が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事自体は曝露後予防薬(EBO-PEP)の治験に焦点を当てているが、背景として既知のDRC史上最大級のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクの継続を報告しており、既存の大規模流行の最新動向として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Inside the study for a remedy to fight Congo's deadliest Ebola outbreak - WTOP News
article.articleSummary: RWAMPARA, Congo — Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Congo, centered in Ituri, has risen to at least 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,000 deaths since mid-May, spanning seven provinces and outpacing containment efforts. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus. A trial coordinated by ALIMA tests Gilead’s experimental antiviral obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis to prevent disease after suspected contact. More than 250 participants have enrolled; the study aims to recruit roughly 1,000 adults or children over 12 who had contact within five days but show no symptoms; half receive placebo. Participants are monitored daily for 21 days, with a 42-day follow-up. If symptoms develop, supportive care is provided. Health workers have begun Ervebo vaccination, though efficacy against Bundibugyo is unclear. Imported/exported cases include MSF staff evacuated to the Netherlands; an ALIMA physician tested positive after returning to France in June. The outbreak remains Congo’s largest.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ最悪のエボラ流行に対する治療薬研究の内側 - WTOP News
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続し、死者4000人超、複数国への感染者輸出（オランダ・フランス）も発生しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: オランダ・フランスへの感染者輸出は確認されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療薬がない点、死亡者数の多さ、国際的な感染者流出が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Nowy wirus wykryty w Chinach. Przenoszą go kleszcze
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new virus detected in China. It is transmitted by ticks.
article.articleSummary: ALTNV, the Asian longhorned tick nairovirus, was detected in China as a new tickborne pathogen. In a study of 3,163 patients with suspected tick-borne disease, 10.4% tested positive for ALTNV by viral RNA or IgM; among DBV-negative cases the ALTNV-positive rate was 15.1%. ALTNV infection alone led to full recovery, but 38 co-infections with Dabie bandavirus (DBV; SFTS) occurred, with higher respiratory symptoms (61% vs 38%) and greater kidney injury (84% vs 66%); 7 deaths (18.4%) were among the co-infected group. SFTS, caused by DBV, has 10–30% mortality in Asia. Surveillance of 47,400 ticks from 15 Chinese provinces found ALTNV RNA in 1.3%, highest in Haemaphysalis longicornis (Asian longhorned tick) at 1.8%. Laboratory data show ALTNV replicates in multiple cell types and can be transmitted by H. longicornis to mice, highlighting the need to differentiate ALTNV from DBV in SFTS-endemic areas.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で新種のウイルスを検出。マダニが媒介
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規のマダニ媒介性ウイルス(ALTNV)が科学的調査により発見されたが、現時点では急性アウトブレイクではなく、公衆衛生への実際の影響や拡大リスクについての情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国での大規模疫学・ウイルス学的サーベイランス研究の結果報告であり、アウトブレイク発生の報告ではない。DBV(SFTSウイルス)との共感染例で重症化・死亡が見られる点は注視が必要だが、ALTNV単独感染は軽症・回復とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Inside the study for a remedy to fight Congo's deadliest Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Congo’s Ituri province has 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,000 deaths since mid-May, with spread to seven provinces. A post-exposure prophylaxis trial tests Gilead’s antiviral pill obeldesivir for exposed individuals; begun in July. The study aims to enroll about 1,000 participants aged 12+, with half receiving a placebo, and daily monitoring for 21 days plus 42-day follow-up. If symptoms develop, they receive supportive treatment. Led by ALIMA with Congo’s National Institute of Biomedical Research and ANRS Emerging Infectious Diseases, the trial seeks to interrupt transmission and provide protection ahead of vaccines. Ervebo vaccination is used for frontline workers, though protection against Bundibugyo is still under study. Imported/exported cases include MSF staff evacuated to the Netherlands and an ALIMA staffer who tested positive in France in June. WHO notes the outbreak continues to outpace containment and could exceed 11,000 deaths in West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ史上最悪のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対する治療薬の研究
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で8,300症例・4,000人死亡という大規模アウトブレイクが発生し、7州に拡大、さらに医療従事者の感染がオランダ・フランスに輸出されるなど国際的拡大がみられるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: オランダ・フランスへの症例輸出は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。アンゴラはBluedot付与地域に含まれるが記事サマリー上で発生国として言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolas uzliesmojums Kongo DR kļūst nāvējošāks: vīruss prasījis jau vairāk nekā 4000 dzīvību
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo is becoming more deadly: the virus has already claimed more than 4,000 lives.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, there are 8,300 confirmed Ebola virus infections and 4,018 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The current outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, which initially escaped detection by conventional tests. Experts believe many infections went unrecorded as the epidemic circulated unnoticed for months. Transmission began in Ituri Province in the northeastern DR Congo, before spreading to remote northern and eastern regions afflicted by conflict. The Ebola virus was first identified in 1976, and across the past five decades outbreaks in Africa have claimed more than 15,000 lives. This reflects a significant toll in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大:ウイルスによる死者はすでに4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認例8,300人・死者4,018人という大規模アウトブレイクであり、希少株（ブンディブギョ株）による検出遅延や紛争地域での拡大など、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と非常に高く、希少なブンディブギョ株による長期間の未検出流行が指摘されている。紛争地域での拡大により対応が困難化している可能性があり、国際的な支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : " Aujourd'hui, nous ne parlons plus d'épidémies provinciales, mais zonales " (Ministre de la Santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: "Today, we no longer talk about provincial epidemics, but zonal" (Health Minister) - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports the 17th Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak across seven provinces: Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Ituri, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Sud-Ubangi. Health authorities say epidemics have shifted from provincial to zonal terms; of 63 health zones, 12 have had no cases for 42 days and eight for 22–42 days, enabling responders to focus on zones with ongoing transmission. The peak of the outbreak is considered past by incident manager Steve Ahuka. The National Institute of Public Health calls for consolidated financing data, with a 11–13 September workshop gathering information from 25 implementing partners out of about 94 active partners. Overall, 8,224 confirmed cases have been reported with 3,982 deaths, 2,121 recoveries, and 851 currently hospitalized, yielding a case-fatality rate of 48.4%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：「今日、我々はもはや州単位の流行ではなく、ゾーン単位の流行について語っている」（保健大臣）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、致死率48.4%、死者3,982人という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトと複数州にまたがる拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイク（第17次）であり既にフルRRA対象となっている可能性が高いが、最新の状況更新（ピーク越え、資金調達課題）として継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Bas-Uélé: prévention et sensibilisation au centre d'une réunion de la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bas-Uélé: Prevention and Awareness-Raising at the Heart of a Response Meeting - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Bas-Uélé, Democratic Republic of Congo: Prevention and awareness at the core of a response meeting in Buta on 3 October 2026. Governor Mike-David Mokeni presided a multi-stakeholder evaluation of the Ebola response, urging united prevention and vaccination efforts and publicly vaccinating to encourage community uptake. Three health zones are affected: Buta, Ganga, Viadana, with intensified surveillance and community engagement called for by Dr. Jean-Robert Tsimanga after the first confirmed case. A doctor who died in Kisangani from Ebola was remembered with a minute of silence. The meeting recommended establishing an Ebola Treatment Center, removing access barriers on supply routes, and boosting population awareness. Increased involvement of political-administrative and customary authorities in messaging about symptoms, transmission, and prevention was urged. The session aims to strengthen coordination among provincial authorities, health services, and partners to limit spread and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: バス・ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：対応会議の中心は予防と啓発活動 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国バス・ウエレ州で複数の保健区域（Buta, Ganga, Viadana）にまたがるエボラ出血熱の発生が継続しており、医療従事者の死亡例も確認されている。重症度・感染拡大リスクが高く、政府・国際支援の必要性も示唆されているためフルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内（バス・ウエレ州）の既存エボラ対応の進捗に関する会議報告。Kisangani、Viadanaはいずれも同国内の地名であり、DRC以外の対象国は関与していない。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Tewaskan Lebih dari 4.000 Warga di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak kills more than 4,000 people in the Congo
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is grappling with an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of October 2, the government reported more than 4,000 deaths (4,018) and 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces; over 2,000 people have recovered. The outbreak is the worst in the DRC's history and, after surpassing the 2018–2020 Ebola epidemic, ranks as the second-deadliest globally, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) which infected over 28,600 and killed more than 11,000. The first cases were in Ituri, with spread to North Kivu; transmission continues in eastern Congo, despite signs of slowing in some areas per UN and government. In the northwest, South Ubangi became the seventh province to report cases last month, underscoring ongoing challenges to containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行、4,000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱(Bundibugyoエボラウイルス)が7州に拡大し、死者4,000人超・感染者8,300人超に達する史上最悪規模の流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため除外。現在の発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia Peringkat Dua TB Dunia, UMI Siapkan Tim Multidisiplin |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia Ranks Second Worldwide in TB, UMI Prepares a Multidisciplinary Team | Republika Online.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia, ranked second in tuberculosis (TB) burden, sees Universitas Muslim Indonesia (UMI) Makassar form a multidisciplinary TB consortium to strengthen national response. WHO data show 10.7 million TB cases in 2024, with Indonesia contributing 10 percent (1.07 million) and 125,000 deaths. In 2024 Indonesia notified 889,000 TB cases, underscoring gaps between estimated burden and reported cases. South Sulawesi is among burden provinces, each with more than 40,000 cases. UMI’s rector says the Faculty of Medicine will lead, with roles for Pharmacy, Public Health, Economics, and Engineering. Government aims for TB elimination by 2030, intensifying contact tracing in 2026, active case finding with free health checks, portable X-ray, and rapid tests. Since April 2026, SATUSEHAT IndonesiaKu has integrated with the TB Information System to improve detection and follow-up; in 2024, 19.4% of household contacts received preventive therapy. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis and transmitted by air, influenced by housing and ventilation.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、結核世界2位にランクイン、UMIが多分野チームを準備
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性的な結核流行に関する大学機関の取り組み紹介記事であり、新規または異常な公衆衛生事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni: des jeunes formés aux enterrements dignes et sécurisés dans une aire de santé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: young people trained in dignified and safe burials within a health zone - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 3 October 2026, in Beni, Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, a training session for youths in dignified and safe burials (Eds) was organized to ensure proper Ebola-related death handling and dignified interment within the health zone during this epidemic period. The program, requested by residents, aims to expand to all health areas and even cells, with volunteers needed since it is unpaid work. Trainees learned steps of burial from body preparation and packaging to transport and interment, aiming to prevent cemetery threats and maintain serenity. Previously, youths assigned to grave digging sometimes acted aggressively toward grieving families, with demands to open the casket. To address this, the military governor backed a security framework to accompany response teams and curb deviations during burials.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ出血熱：若者たちが保健区域で尊厳ある安全な埋葬の訓練を受ける - ACP

triage.notes: 記事は既知のエボラ流行下における地域コミュニティの安全な埋葬訓練プログラムに関する内容で、新規感染者数や死亡者数などの最新疫学データは含まれていない。既存の流行状況の進捗として継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Več kot 4000 smrti zaradi okužb s smrtonosnim virusom: kaj lahko naredijo? - Svet24.si
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 deaths from infections with a deadly virus: what can be done?
article.articleSummary: As of October 3, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing an Ebola outbreak with 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths, a case fatality of 48.4%. The outbreak, officially confirmed in mid-May, is affecting the northern and eastern regions, with the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain first identified in Ituri province in the northeast. Response efforts are hampered by distrust of authorities and violence, including militia clashes in Ituri that forced more than 5,000 people to flee. A health center treating Ebola patients in Ituri was burned, and the following day an attack on a health facility in North Kivu killed a contractor charged with case-finding. The United States has pledged about $267 million to help contain the outbreak. Trials are under way for vaccines and therapeutics; first doses of Ervebo have begun among health workers in a clinical study, though Ervebo was previously shown to be effective against the Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的ウイルス感染による4000人以上の死亡：何ができるか？

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 4 آلاف وفاة جراء وباء إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية %
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 deaths due to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has caused over 4,000 deaths among about 8,300 confirmed cases, with 2,162 recoveries reported. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, and the deadliest in its history, beginning in Ituri (northeast) and spreading to seven provinces in the north and east. Response efforts are hampered by resource shortages, armed groups, and population distrust in conflict zones. In North Kivu, six confirmed Ebola cases—four deaths—occurred in areas controlled by M23 rebels. Violent clashes have disrupted the response, and a treatment center in Ituri was set ablaze after soldiers entered a displacement site, forcing residents to flee. MSF evacuated one staff member to the Netherlands after confirming Ebola infection; another doctor was deployed to the DRC. WHO reported encouraging indicators mid-September, though Africa CDC's director-general says the outbreak is not under control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行により4000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（約8300症例、4000人超の死亡）が7州に拡大し、武装勢力の妨害や治療施設への攻撃など対応が著しく困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: オランダはMSFスタッフの退避・治療先であり発生国ではないため除外。Africa CDCは流行が制御下にないと評価しており、WHOの楽観的指標と対照的。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: l'épidémie franchit le seuil des 4000 morts malgr...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the epidemic surpasses the 4,000-death threshold despite ...
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has crossed 4,000 deaths and more than 8,300 confirmed cases, the worst outbreak in the country’s history. Health Minister Roger Kamba said at a Kinshasa press conference that the peak is behind them, citing declines in most foci and 19 of 63 health zones reporting no new cases for three weeks. Yet 44 zones remain active, with transmission persisting in Beni, Butembo and Katwa in North Kivu, where insecurity and community resistance hinder response teams. More than half of deaths occur outside medical facilities, raising risks from home care and funerals. Contact tracing coverage is below the 95% target, at about 82%. The government seeks new funding and oversight of humanitarian funds; of $226 million mobilized for the response, just over half has been justified to the government.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国：保健相の楽観論にもかかわらず流行は死者4000人の閾値を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ史上最悪の流行で死者4000人超、44地域で感染継続、コンタクトトレーシングが目標未達であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、治安悪化・地域社会の抵抗・資金管理問題など複合的リスクが存在。国際支援（資金監督含む）の必要性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: How community-led AI-powered X-Rays are helping find TB among those without symptoms
article.articleSummary: TB in Delhi, India, detected through AI-powered chest X-ray screening at two government ART centers between 1 May and 31 August 2026. Of 1,559 PLHIV screened, 273 were presumptive TB (17.51%), and 21 were confirmed TB cases; 12 of these (57.14%) were asymptomatic. All 273 presumptive cases underwent confirmatory molecular testing on the same day, achieving 100% upfront molecular testing in this initiative, a notable contrast to prior rates. All TB cases began treatment under India's National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme. The effort, led by Humana People to People India with government ART centers, demonstrates the value of routine X-ray screening within HIV care to detect asymptomatic or subclinical TB and link to care. Since Dec 7, 2024, AI X-ray vans have screened high-risk populations, contributing to India's FindTB shift; 2025 reportedly saw over a million asymptomatic TB cases detected nationwide. NATCON 2026 in Patiala reported these findings.

triage.headline_ja: コミュニティ主導型AI活用X線検査が無症状者の結核発見に貢献
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの成果報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心の高まりも認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はHIV陽性者を対象としたAI活用胸部X線検診による結核スクリーニングプログラムの成果を報告するもので、国家結核撲滅プログラムの一環としての通常活動。新規感染症脅威やアウトブレイクの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm mùa có thể diễn biến nặng ở người cao tuổi, trẻ nhỏ, phụ nữ mang thai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal influenza can become severe in the elderly, young children, and pregnant women.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza in Vietnam can become severe for people over 65, children under 5, and pregnant women—especially in the last trimester or within two weeks after birth—and those with chronic diseases or immune suppression. Influenza is an acute respiratory infection transmitted mainly via droplets and contact with contaminated surfaces; recent weeks show a slight uptick in cases, but no abnormal rise in severe illness or deaths has been observed. Most infections are mild and self-limiting. Preventive measures include proper mask use in healthcare settings, public transport, crowded or poorly ventilated spaces, and by symptomatic individuals; cough etiquette, hand hygiene, surface cleaning, and ensuring good ventilation. Do not self-medicate with antivirals or antibiotics without medical guidance. The Department of Preventive Medicine will continue surveillance and update guidelines. In September and the first nine months of 2026, the ministry monitors several infectious diseases and foodborne illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザ、高齢者・幼児・妊婦で重症化の可能性
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の注意喚起であり、重症例や死亡の異常な増加は確認されておらず、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも強く該当しない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な公衆衛生広報記事で、感染者数のわずかな増加はあるが重症・死亡の異常増加はないと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Ebola di Kongo Sebabkan 4.018 Orang Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Kongo have caused 4,018 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached approximately 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries reported as of October 3, 2026. The case-fatality rate stands at 48.4%. Figures are sourced from INSP via Actualite and cited by Antara, highlighting ongoing transmission within the DRC. The outbreak is described as a threat to neighboring countries by Jean Kaseya, Director General of Africa CDC, underscoring cross-border risk and the need for sustained surveillance and control measures across the seven affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱患者、4,018人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、約8,300症例・7州に拡大するエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクであり、国際的拡大リスクも指摘されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Africa CDC局長が周辺国への脅威を明言しており、越境拡大リスクが高い。続報でのケース数・死亡者数の推移と国際対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông qua đời sau 47 ngày Vì không tiêm vaccine dại khi bị chó cắn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man dies 47 days after being bitten by a dog because he did not receive the rabies vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death in Hà Nam province, Vietnam: A man died 47 days after a dog bite, having never sought post-exposure vaccination. Bite date: August 10; symptom onset and death: September 26. Local authorities captured the dog suspected of the bite. Before his death, he posted a video urging others not to neglect post-bite care and to seek care. Rabies is almost always fatal once clinical symptoms appear; the virus travels from the wound to the nervous system. Post-exposure prophylaxis aims to generate antibodies before the virus reaches the brain, and treatment should start as soon as possible after exposure. After exposure from a dog, cat, or other animal, wash the wound with soap and water, disinfect, and visit a healthcare facility for exposure assessment and vaccination if indicated. Exposure levels I, II, III guide care and may include rabies immunoglobulin for higher risk; evaluation for wounds on face, head, or hands.

triage.headline_ja: 犬に噛まれた男性、狂犬病ワクチン未接種のため47日後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病ワクチン未接種による単発の死亡例であり、ベトナムでは散発的に発生している既知の公衆衛生課題。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染がなく、本記事は啓発目的の個別症例報告。公衆衛生上の危機対応レベルの事案ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Tewaskan 4.018 Orang, Kasus Tembus 8.300
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Kongo kills 4,018 people, cases surpass 8,300.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Kongo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has reached 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths as of October 1, 2026, marking the largest and deadliest outbreak there since 2018–2020. Over 2,000 patients have recovered. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri Province and has since spread to eastern Kongo and North Kivu, which now accounts for about 40% of new cases since late August. The Bundibugyo strain has no known cure or vaccine. South Ubangi Province in the northwest became the seventh province to report cases last month after a traveler from eastern Kongo died. Authorities, including MSF staff like Stephanie Hoffman in Butembo, warn of rapid transmission and ongoing fatalities, noting at least 50 health workers have died. The government and UN cite slowing transmission in Ituri, but spread continues elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで4,018人死亡、症例数8,300人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が複数州に拡大し、死者4,018人・症例8,300人に達する大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による2018-2020年以来最大規模のアウトブレイク。7州に拡大し、医療従事者50人以上が死亡。MSFやUNが対応中で、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Civic workers trained in prevention of infectious diseases before monsoon
article.articleSummary: An in-service training session for Tiruchi City Corporation field workers, led by City Health Officer M. Karthikeyan, focused on preventing dengue, scrub typhus, and leptospirosis ahead of the northeast monsoon. Held with district epidemiologist Mathivanan and District Malaria Officer Murugesan, the program outlined preventive measures targeting mosquito breeding and disease hotspots in Tiruchi. Workers were instructed to check for water stagnation in public spaces, locked homes, and construction sites, and to inspect homes, commercial buildings, and construction sites while destroying potential breeding sites such as old tyres, coconut husks, vessels, and other containers. Regular fogging and fumigation cycles will be conducted across all wards of the Tiruchi Corporation as part of ongoing prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン前に感染症予防研修を実施、市職員対象
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン前の通常の予防研修活動を伝える記事であり、実際の症例急増や異常事態の報告はないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性感染症（デング熱、ツツガムシ病、レプトスピラ症）に対する予防的な公衆衛生対策・職員研修を報じたものであり、実際の発生・流行状況の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : une organisation de lutte contre le Vih/Sida sensibilise contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: an HIV/AIDS-fighting organization raises awareness about Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Kisangani, as of 3 October 2026, Forum Sida (Fosi), a HIV/AIDS-focused NGO in Tshopo Province, DRC, launched Ebola prevention awareness in schools, starting with Lokombe School on the right bank of the Tshopo River. Provincial coordinator Bruno Longela says the campaign targets prevention amid rising Ebola cases and a 21-day incubation period, noting fear as physicians’ deaths raise alarm. Ebola is highlighted as a disease that kills upon infection if proper care is not received, with survival reduced without timely medical treatment. Activities include door-to-door outreach in classrooms, distribution of an awareness picture box, and six bottles of alcohol-based hand sanitizer to the school. Authorities are urged to maintain regular sensitization to reinforce prevention as Ebola concerns persist in Kisangani and the Tshopo province.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:HIV/AIDS対策団体がエボラ対策の啓発活動を実施 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC・キサンガニ地域でエボラ症例増加と医師の死亡が報告されており、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクと重症度の高さから公衆衛生上の懸念が強い。既存流行の悪化を示唆する情報が含まれるためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事自体はNGOによる啓発活動が主題だが、'rising Ebola cases'や医師の死亡という表現から現地でエボラ症例が増加している可能性が示唆される。続報や公式統計の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Στην Ολλανδία το τέταρτο εισαγόμενο κρούσμα στην Ευρώπη
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: In the Netherlands, the fourth imported case in Europe.
article.articleSummary: Ebola: Netherlands reports the fourth imported case in Europe linked to the current outbreak. The patient is a healthcare worker from the Democratic Republic of Congo, diagnosed positive on 29 September and transferred to the Netherlands for specialized care. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) notes that imported infections among health workers, outbreak responders, and humanitarian staff are not unexpected due to differing exposure levels in affected regions. The three prior imported cases related to the same outbreak involved medical or humanitarian personnel in transmission zones. Transport of the patient is conducted with careful planning, and the probability of further transmission remains very low when appropriate infection prevention and control measures are followed. The EU/EEA are urged to maintain preparedness, prioritizing early recognition and isolation of suspected cases, adherence to protective measures, and suitable laboratory investigation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：オランダで欧州4例目の輸入症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行に関連する欧州4例目の輸入症例であり、IHR基準の『深刻な公衆衛生影響』『国際的拡大』の2項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はオランダでの輸入症例だが、感染源はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行であるため、DRCを対象国として検証した。オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ECDCは今回の輸入例を『予想外ではない』と評価している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 'Good health is a human right': Chhattisgarh Rights Commission drive identifies 1800 new leprosy patients
article.articleSummary: Chhattisgarh detects about 1,800 newly infected leprosy patients through a first-of-its-kind survey ordered by the State Human Rights Commission, revealing a large undiagnosed pool despite ongoing cases. Total registered leprosy patients in the state are 5,366, with Raipur reporting 625. Leprosy, a curable bacterial infection causing nerve damage if untreated, remains stigmatized post-COVID. The survey involved house-to-house screening to identify secondary infections near diagnosed patients, enabling timely treatment and reducing transmission. Five states—Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Jharkhand, Odisha, Madhya Pradesh—together account for about half of India’s leprosy burden; 23 districts in Chhattisgarh have prevalence above 1/10,000. Aradhana Patnaik noted in Raipur (June 2026) that national elimination occurred in 2005. SHRC Chairman Girdhari Nayak urges periodic, aggressive case-detection campaigns across endemic zones to prevent disability and stigma.

triage.headline_ja: 「健康は人権」：チャッティースガル州人権委員会の調査で1800人の新規ハンセン病患者を発見
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は既知の風土病であり、国家調査による積極的症例発見活動の結果であって、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ハンセン病は治療可能な慢性感染症であり、本記事は積極的症例発見調査の成果報告。COVID-19は見出しの疾患リストに含まれるが記事内容とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Τέταρτο νέο κρούσμα στην Ευρώπη - Πώς έφτασε και τι λένε οι Αρχές
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Fourth New Case in Europe - How It Arrived and What the Authorities Are Saying
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease: Europe records a fourth imported case linked to the ongoing outbreak. A healthcare worker from the Democratic Republic of Congo tested positive for Ebola on 29 September and was transported to the Netherlands for specialized care. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) notes that imported cases among healthcare workers, outbreak response teams, and humanitarian responders in the affected red zones are not unexpected due to their higher exposure. The previous three imported cases linked to the current outbreak involved medical or humanitarian work in red zones. The importation does not alter Europe’s overall risk assessment, as transmission remains very low with proper infection prevention, transport, and isolation measures. ECDC calls EU/EEA countries to maintain vigilance, emphasizing prompt recognition and isolation of suspected cases, adherence to protection measures, and appropriate laboratory investigation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ヨーロッパで4例目の新規症例―どのように到達し、当局は何を述べているか
triage.triage_reason: DRCで continuing outbreak の医療従事者がヨーロッパへ移送され4例目の輸入例となったが、ECDCは欧州全体のリスク評価を変更しておらず、コンゴ国内での新規大規模感染拡大という明確な情報はないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで継続中のエボラアウトブレイクに関連し、ヨーロッパ（オランダ）への輸入症例についての報道。主たる発生国はDRCであり、オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ECDCは欧州全体のリスクレベルを変更していない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola salgını: 4.000'den fazla ölüm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: more than 4,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the deadliest on record as of 3 October 2026, with 8,300 confirmed cases and more than 4,018 deaths (case fatality ~48.4%), and 2,162 recoveries. The epicenter is Ituri, with spread across seven northern and eastern provinces, including six cases (four deaths) in North Kivu in areas controlled by the Rwanda-backed M23 group. Violence and resource shortages hinder response, displacing over 5,000 in Ituri; a transit center for Ebola patients was burned, and a contracted-health facility worker was killed in North Kivu. France signaled support with a Bunia visit and €13.4 million allocated (Jan–Jul), while the United States committed a further €237 million. Bundibugyo-type Ebola is circulating; Ervebo vaccine doses (for Zaire ebolavirus) have begun among frontline staff.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱流行:死者4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48.4%、死者4,000人超、7州に拡大し武力紛争地域での対応困難という深刻な公衆衛生事象であり、IHR・WPRO両基準で複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米仏が資金支援を表明（フランス€13.4M、米国€237M）。武装勢力M23支配地域での症例発生・施設焼失・医療従事者殺害など治安要因が対応を著しく妨げている。ブンディブギョ型エボラが流行中であり既存のErvebo（ザイール株用）ワクチンの有効性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani-Ebola : le service d'assainissement de l'Environnement lance une opération de désinfection des espaces - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani-Ebola: the Environmental Sanitation Service launches an operation to disinfect areas - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 3 October 2026, the Environmental Sanitation Service of Kisangani, part of the Tshopo provincial Environment Coordination in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, launched an operation to disinfect public and private spaces to support the Ebola virus disease response. Led by Henoc Sefu Kenge, technicians began early Saturday by disinfecting Hotel Dissa in the Makiso commune. The drive aims to reinforce hygiene and sanitation measures across the city and bolster prevention and control of Ebola transmission. The initiative will continue at additional sites within Kisangani as the environmental sector contributes to the outbreak response. Disinfection targets public and private venues to reduce fomite transmission and support ongoing medical and community health efforts.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ・エボラ：環境衛生局が空間消毒作戦を開始 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2の即時通報対象疾病であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響・国際的拡大リスクを有するため、既存アウトブレイク対応の続報としてもフルRRA相当の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はキサンガニで進行中のエボラ対応における環境消毒活動の続報。既存のアウトブレイク状況（感染者数・死亡者数等）は本文に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Cuộc thi Lan tỏa năng lượng tích cực 2026: Phòng cúm, phế cầu, RSV - giữ trọn nhịp tim khỏe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2026 Positive Energy Spreading Contest: Prevent Flu, Pneumococcus, and RSV - Maintain a Healthy Heartbeat.
article.articleSummary: Influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and Streptococcus pneumoniae infections trigger systemic immune responses—fever, dehydration, hypoxemia, and increased metabolic demand—that extend beyond the lungs. For patients with cardiovascular disease, especially coronary artery disease or heart failure, these changes raise cardiac workload and can worsen underlying conditions. Prevention emphasizes maintaining control of risk factors (blood pressure, blood glucose, lipids), adhering to medications, and sustaining a healthy lifestyle to keep heart disease stable and reduce susceptibility to infections. Vaccination is a key preventive measure to lower infection risk and lessen disease severity from vaccine-preventable pathogens. Overall, reducing respiratory infections is presented as an essential component of protecting heart health within cardiovascular care. The article highlights public health messaging tied to infection prevention for heart patients.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ポジティブエネルギー拡散コンテスト：インフルエンザ・肺炎球菌・RSVの予防 - 健やかな心拍を保つ
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、心臓病患者向けの呼吸器感染症予防啓発に関する一般的な健康キャンペーン記事であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイク事例ではなく、季節性呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザ・RSV・肺炎球菌）予防に関する一般的な公衆衛生啓発・ワクチン接種推奨の広報記事。具体的な発生地域・症例数の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Conheça a tecnologia que reduz em até 99% a presença de Salmonella em carnes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meet the technology that reduces Salmonella presence in meat by up to 99%.
article.articleSummary: Biopark researchers in Toledo, Western Paraná, Brazil, developed a processing-stage technology that reduces Salmonella in poultry carcasses by up to 99.8% and in pork by 95.4% during meat processing. Tests covered multiple chicken serovars and pork strains, with no observed bacterial adaptation and the population reaching the analytical detection limit in chicken trials. Chemical analyses found no residues on carcasses after washing, and consumer sensory attributes—appearance, aroma, flavor, texture—were unchanged. Occupational safety evaluations indicated adequate worker exposure conditions. The solution, born from industry needs and part of the Novo Arranjo de Pesquisa e Inovação (Napi) Alimentos Saudáveis, is moving toward intellectual property protection and regulatory approval for commercial use. Cost estimates were R$0.0032 per kg for chicken and R$0.004 per kg for pork. In Brazil, 2025 saw 15.3 Mt chicken, 5.6 Mt pork, with exports ~6.8 Mt and >US$13B in sales.

triage.headline_ja: 食肉中のサルモネラ菌を最大99%削減する技術とは
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は食肉加工におけるサルモネラ低減技術の研究成果を紹介する内容であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にTyphoid/Paratyphoidとあるが、記事内容はサルモネラ食中毒菌低減の食品加工技術に関するものであり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: TP HCM tăng cường biện pháp phòng tránh nguy cơ bùng phát dịch bệnh sốt xuất huyết và tay chân miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City strengthens measures to prevent the risk of dengue fever and hand-foot-and-mouth disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: As of Week 39 (Sept 21–27, 2026) in Ho Chi Minh City, dengue fever recorded 1,491 cases, up 1.7% from the four-week average, with 2026 cumulative total 35,714. Highest incidence per 100,000 were in Con Dao Special District (883), Chanh Phu Hoa Commune (777), and Minh Thanh Commune (706). Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) reached 1,538 cases in Week 39, up 63.8% from the prior four weeks; year-to-date total 36,676. HFMD per 100,000 also peaked in Con Dao (673), Bình Khánh Commune (535), and Hiệp Phước Commune (443). Hospitalizations increased for HFMD: over 80 cases at Children's Hospital 1 (doubling week-over-week) and over 40 at Children's Hospital City (up 10% from last month). Clinicians warn many HFMD cases progress rapidly to severity (fever, vomiting, lethargy, tremors); urgent hospitalization is advised. Preventive measures emphasize hand hygiene, cleaning toys, safe food, and isolation of affected children; adults should maintain personal hygiene and bathe before contact.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、デング熱と手足口病の流行リスクに対する予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・手足口病ともに症例増加と重症化傾向が見られるが、既知の季節性流行であり国際的拡大リスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: HFMD症例の急増（週比63.8%増）と重症化例が報告されており、今後の推移次第ではPICKUPへの格上げも検討すべき。デング熱は既存の高発地域での季節的増加。

article.articleHeadline: Putin Accused of 'Plague Cover-Up' in Siberia Outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-03, a plague outbreak in Russia's Irkutsk region has caused one death and 189 people to be quarantined. The Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute and Shelekhov District Hospital are under quarantine; antibiotics reportedly sold out. Daria Shipilova, 28, a laboratory assistant at the Institute, is linked to the outbreak; reports differ whether she contracted the disease on a Russia–Mongolia border expedition or after breaking a test tube at the Institute. Mass events have been canceled across the region, and Baikalsk residents were advised not to travel to Shelekhov. Anna Popova, Russia's chief infectious diseases doctor, traveled to Irkutsk to oversee the response. Telegram channel Nezygar compared the response to Wuhan and claimed a cover-up; epidemiologist Mikhail Favorov criticized the handling and the supposed test-tube explanation.

triage.headline_ja: プーチン政権、シベリアでのペスト発生を隠蔽したと非難される
triage.triage_reason: ペスト発生はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、CEPR監視対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しないため、監視スコープ外としてDISMISSと判定。
triage.notes: 記事中で言及される武漢（中国）は過去のCOVID-19対応との比較のための引用であり、本イベントの発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州。モンゴルも国境探検の文脈での言及のみ。いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: गांधीनगर में एकता दिवस परेड की तैयारी कर रहे 14 जवान डेंगू पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 14 jawans in Gandhinagar preparing for Unity Day parade tested positive for dengue
article.articleSummary: 14 out of about 6,000 central paramilitary and state police personnel preparing for Unity Day parade in Gandhinagar tested positive for dengue. The 6,000 included CRPF, BSF, SSB, ITBP; states Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala. Sector-28 and Sector-29 allotted ~1,000 temporary quarters in Gift City area; 60-70 personnel tested so far; 14 positive. Nagar Nigam health dept deployed six teams. Three-tier dengue control: 1) confirm treatment and health surveillance; 2) fogging in ~1,000 quarters and outdoor fogging across campus; 3) 500-meter surveillance around sectors 28 and 29; source reduction; identify breeding sites; immediate action at breeding hotspots. Investigation ongoing to determine if infections contracted locally in Gandhinagar or brought from others; travel histories being checked; some had fever and body ache on arrival. Focus remains on treating infected personnel and preventing spread.

triage.headline_ja: ガーンディーナガルで統一の日パレード準備中の14人の兵士がデング熱陽性
triage.triage_reason: インドで季節的に流行するデング熱の小規模クラスター（14名陽性）であり、地元当局が標準的な防疫対応（フォギング、発生源対策）を既に実施中。重症例や死亡の報告もなく、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年流行する風土病であり、軍・警察関係者の一時居住区での小規模クラスター。地元の衛生当局が既に3段階の対策（治療・サーベイランス、フォギング、発生源対策）を実施中であり、外部支援の必要性は低い。統一の日パレードという国家的行事に関連するため一定の政府関心はあるが、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: गांधीनगर में एकता दिवस परेड की तैयारी कर रहे 14 जवान डेंगू पॉजिटिव - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gandhinagar: 14 jawans preparing for Unity Day parade are dengue positive - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: 14 of nearly 6,000 personnel arriving in Gandhinagar for Unity Day parade preparations tested positive for dengue. In Kevadiya near the Statue of Unity, Sector-28 and Sector-29 temporary quarters host personnel from CRPF, BSF, SSB and other states including Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Andhra Pradesh and Kerala, who are preparing in the Gift City area ahead of the October 31 Unity Day event. About 60–70 personnel have been tested, with 14 dengue cases confirmed; some arrivals had fever, body aches, and other symptoms. The Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation deployed six health teams in Sectors 28 and 29. A three-tier plan includes immediate treatment and health monitoring; fogging in about 1,000 quarters and campus-wide outdoor fogging; and a 500-meter surveillance radius to identify and eliminate breeding sites. Authorities are probing whether infections are locally acquired or brought from home states, given varied travel histories.

triage.headline_ja: ガンディナガル:統一の日パレードの準備をしていた治安要員14人がデング熱陽性
triage.triage_reason: インド・グジャラート州の一地域での小規模なデング熱クラスター事例であり、季節性感染症の通常範囲内で国際的拡大の懸念は低いが、今後の感染拡大や原因特定（現地感染か持ち込みか）の続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの季節性流行病であり、本事例は統一の日パレード準備要員14名の陽性確認という局地的事象。地元自治体により防疫対応（フォギング、サーベイランス）が実施されており、管理可能な範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola bilançosu: Can kaybı 4'bini geçti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola toll: the death toll has surpassed four thousand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths, reaching 4,018, with 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,162 recoveries; case fatality rate 48.4%. The outbreak spans seven provinces and was declared on May 15 after Ituri province reported 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths in a village near the Ebola River. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant involved has no approved treatment or vaccine. Background notes recall outbreaks dating to 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC, and the 2014-2017 West Africa epidemic with about 30,000 infections and over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の死者数、4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7州にまたがるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが4,000人超の死者を出しており、致死率48.4%、承認されたワクチン・治療法がないため、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクを有する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBurundi、Sudan、Angolaが含まれるが、記事本文で明示的に現在の感染拡大地域として言及されているのはDRCの7州のみ。Nzara(Sudan)とYambuku(DRC)は1976年の過去事例への言及であり、現行アウトブレイクの発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : lancement d'un tournoi avec appel au respect strict des mesures-barrières contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: Launch of a Tournament With a Call for Strict Adherence to Ebola Prevention Measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 3 October 2026, Kisangani in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo launched a peace tournament in the city’s capital of Tshopo Province to reinforce social cohesion while strictly enforcing Ebola prevention measures. Governor Paulin Lendongolia urged residents and participants to avoid unnecessary physical contact, follow health recommendations, protect one another, and prevent the event from becoming a conduit for Ebola transmission. He cautioned against panic, called for responsible behavior, and emphasized adherence to health teams’ guidance while helping raise awareness about the Ebola situation in Tshopo. The initiative links sport, community unity, and collective responsibility amid the Ebola epidemic in the province. The governor expressed gratitude to President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo and Finance Minister Doudou Fwamba Likunde for their support, and thanked organizer Jacques Mandjongwe and the Dynamique de la Force des changements for their role.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:エボラ対策の徹底遵守を呼びかけるトーナメントが開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCトショパ州で進行中のエボラ流行に関連する内容であり、疾患の重篤性と地域での人ー人感染継続のリスクからIHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事自体は新規症例報告ではなく、既存のトショパ州エボラ流行下での予防啓発イベント（トーナメント）に関する報道。州知事や大統領府、財務大臣の関与が言及されており行政的関心は高いが、感染者数・死亡者数・国際的拡大に関する具体的データは記載されていない。

article.articleSummary: 14 personnel preparing for India's Unity Day Parade at the Statue of Unity near Kevadia, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, tested positive for dengue among about 6,000 central and state security personnel (CRPF, BSF, SSB, Indo-Tibetan Border Police) arriving from states including Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Andhra Pradesh, and Kerala. Of roughly 60–70 individuals tested so far, 14 dengue cases are confirmed. Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation has deployed six health teams in Sector-28 and Sector-29, with about 1,000 temporary quarters allocated for the contingents. A three-tier response is underway: 1) treatment and health monitoring of infected personnel, 2) fogging in the quarters and outside the campus, plus 3) a 500-meter surveillance radius around Sectors 28/29 to identify breeding sites and perform source reduction. Investigations aim to determine whether infections are locally transmitted or imported with personnel, as health histories are reviewed to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ガンディーナガルでユニティ・デー・パレードの準備をしていた治安要員14名がデング熱陽性
triage.triage_reason: 特定イベント（統一の日パレード）に集結した約6000人の治安要員のうち14名がデング熱陽性と確認され、行政による積極的な調査・防疫対応が始まっているため、社会的・行政的関心が高くフルRRAでの経過確認が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで流行性疾患であり今回の事例は特定イベント参加者間の局地的クラスター。地元自治体が迅速に対応(健康監視・燻蒸・サーベイランス)しており、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、国家的行事に関連するため社会的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết diễn biến phức tạp, nguy cơ bùng phát diện rộng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever with a complicated progression, risk of a widespread outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Dong Nai City, Vietnam, is at high risk of a widespread outbreak. Last week (Sept 24–30), 730 dengue cases were reported, including 315 children under 15, with 1 death in Bàu Hàm Commune. Cumulatively from the start of the year, Dong Nai has logged about 16,000 cases and 7 deaths. The health system identified 253 dengue clusters and noted high case numbers in Bình Phước, Nhơn Trạch, Minh Hưng, Long Bình, Nghĩa Trung, and Định Quán. Four dengue virus serotypes (D1–D4) are circulating, increasing risks of reinfection and severe disease, especially among those with obesity, cancer, or chronic conditions. Weather is at the peak of the rainy season, favoring mosquito breeding. Authorities are monitoring dengue in 95 communes, conducting wide-area insecticide spraying in hotspots, and providing personnel, equipment, and chemicals. Localities should pursue larviciding, broad chemical spraying, enhanced surveillance, and rapid outbreak response; residents should remove standing water and protect against bites.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の複雑な進展、広範囲での流行拡大のリスク
triage.triage_reason: ドンナイ省で季節性デング熱の症例・死亡者数が増加しているが、ベトナムでは例年発生する風土病であり、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは低いため、フルRRAには至らないが続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ドンナイ省を中心に複数血清型（D1-D4）が循環し、再感染・重症化リスクが指摘されている。地方当局が殺虫剤散布や監視強化を実施中で、外部支援の必要性は明記されていない。季節性の年次流行パターンの範囲内と判断されるが、症例数・死亡者数の推移は継続的に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani: la DPS renforce la protection du personnel de santé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: the DPS strengthens the protection of healthcare workers - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease response in Kisangani, Tshopo Province, prioritizes protection of health-care workers and rapid intervention after alerts. The DPS notes PPE is deployed immediately to health zones upon receipt, even with stock shortages since PPE is single-use. Four ambulances (three government-funded, one from Enabel) support operations: one to Bafwasende, two for the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE), and one to the Makiso-Kisangani health zone. Investigation teams are established in each health zone to monitor alerts for suspected or confirmed cases and contacts, including follow-up for La Borne kindergarten pupils and Kisangani DH hospital staff and caretakers, after the 21-day closures of these two institutions. Among 15 health workers infected with Ebola, 12 have recovered, two have died, and one is currently in treatment, per the DPS.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニのエボラ出血熱: DPSが医療従事者の保護を強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニでエボラ出血熱の医療従事者感染（15名中2名死亡）が継続しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）とWPRO基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 医療従事者15名感染、2名死亡、12名回復、1名治療中という具体的な被害規模があり、保育園・病院の21日間閉鎖措置も実施されている。国際NGO（Enabel）が支援に関与しており、既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応の一環と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: पंजाब के सरकारी नशा मुक्ति केंद्रों में जल्द शुरू होगी ट्रिपल H स्क्रीनिंग, HIV और हेपेटाइटिस-B/C की होगी जांच
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Triple-H screening to start soon in Punjab's state-run de-addiction centers; HIV and Hepatitis B and C will be tested.
article.articleSummary: Punjab to start Triple-H screening for HIV, Hepatitis B and C at state-run de-addiction and rehabilitation centers, integrating HIV and hepatitis testing with addiction treatment. Under Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's War Against Drugs initiative, the government aims to improve health outcomes by linking testing directly to the rehabilitation process rather than periodic camps. Health and Family Welfare Minister Dr. Balbir Singh noted that injections among substance users increase the risk of blood-borne infections, making timely identification and care essential. The plan will provide testing along with counseling, medical care, and social rehabilitation to those recovering from addiction, helping sustain long-term recovery. Previously, HIV and hepatitis screening camps were held roughly every two months. The government expects rapid rollout at public centers to ensure access to care for affected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州、公立薬物依存症治療センターでHIVおよびB型・C型肝炎のトリプルHスクリーニングを近く開始
triage.triage_reason: 既存の公衆衛生施策（スクリーニング体制強化）に関する報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではないため、IHR・WPRO基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 政府の保健施策（薬物依存症治療センターでのHIV・肝炎検査拡充）に関する記事であり、新規感染症発生や異常事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Officials review dengue prevention measures in Avadi
article.articleSummary: 115 dengue cases reported in Avadi Corporation limits from January to September 2026, with August at 29 and September at 63—the highest monthly figure. Tamil Nadu officials, including Tiruvallur Collector Kavitha, Avadi Corporation Commissioner Saranya, and TNMSC MD Amrith, reviewed dengue prevention measures in Avadi on Saturday. TNMSC chief inspected Zone 2 (Tirumullaivoyal), checked workers’ attendance, and evaluated field activities, then visited a dengue-affected home in Vaishnavi Nagar (2nd Cross Street). He also reviewed dengue prevention at Avadi Government Hospital, including the dengue ward, pharmacy, and laboratory. Officials urged continued dengue prevention efforts and steps to control other mosquito-borne diseases in Avadi Corporation areas. Attendees included Avadi Gov Hospital Deputy Director Porchelvi, City Health Officer Saraswathi, sanitation officers Moideen and Kumar, health inspectors, and field staff.

triage.headline_ja: アーヴァディでデング熱予防対策を当局がレビュー
triage.triage_reason: 地域での通常のデング熱対策活動に関する行政レビューの記事であり、異常な拡大や重症例急増の報告はなく、既存の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・タミルナードゥ州で季節的に発生する既知の媒介蚊感染症であり、本記事は地方行政による定例の予防策レビューを報じるもの。症例数の増加傾向はあるが、異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す記述はない。
