article.articleHeadline: Ilmuwan Dunia Waspadai "Mirror Life", Ancaman Wabah Tak Terkendali
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists Worldwide Warn of 'Mirror Life', the Threat of an Out-of-Control Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Mirror life, synthetic cells built with inverted chirality, could trigger an uncontrolled outbreak if released, warned at the Singapore Conference on Mirror Life. Earth life uses left-handed amino acids and right-handed sugars; mirror organisms would use opposite forms, potentially evading immune systems and bacteriophages, multiplying unchecked and disrupting ecosystems. While creation is not imminent, rapid advances in synthetic biology and AI heighten concern. The discussion references a 2024 Science paper positing mirror bacteria could survive in nutrient-rich, non-chiral environments such as soil, blood, and gut. George Church (Harvard Medical School) highlighted milestones: a “spud cell” from the University of Minnesota and lab techniques enabling proteins with nonstandard amino acids. US, UK, and Germany have voiced worries; the UN Secretary-General’s Scientific Advisory Board issued a risk summary in March; China has not stated a position. Indian researchers in Bengaluru stress vigilance, comparing risks to invasive cane toads.

triage.headline_ja: 世界の科学者が「ミラーライフ」に警鐘、制御不能なアウトブレイクの脅威
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、合成生物学における理論的・将来的リスク（鏡像生物）に関する科学者の警鐘・議論であり、現時点で実際の疾病アウトブレイクは発生していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、合成生物学分野における将来的リスク（鏡像生命体：Mirror Life）についての国際会議・専門家の警鐘を報じたもの。インドのベンガルール研究者のコメントが含まれるが、インド国内で実際の疾病発生があったわけではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: France to step up Ebola funding in Congo amid resurgence fears, minister says
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, France will increase support to eradicate Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, said Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot during a Bunia visit. He warned that Ebola could resurge quickly if vigilance wanes. France has allocated €13.4 million ($15.1 million) to Ebola efforts from January–July and will seek additional humanitarian funding in upcoming budget discussions. France’s response channels include humanitarian aid, medical research, and the PRISM programme launched in 2023. A national humanitarian conference in Paris is planned for 6 October to discuss Ebola responses. Barrot praised Congolese authorities, UN agencies, humanitarian groups, and healthcare workers for containing the outbreak and preventing spread to major urban centers. In Bunia, a laboratory-confirmed mpox case was identified in mid-September, underscoring ongoing vigilance against multiple pathogens.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、コンゴにおけるエボラ再燃懸念を受け資金支援を強化へ
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのエボラ流行再燃リスクがあり、フランス政府が資金・人道支援を強化する動きがあることから、社会的・政治的関心が高く、WPRO基準にも複数該当するためフルRRAに進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はフランスの資金支援表明が主題だが、実際の発生地はDRC（ブニア含む東部）。フランス自体は感染発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。Mpoxの確定例も言及されているが本記事の主眼はエボラ再燃懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Begusarai News: मौसम में बदलाव के बीच मच्छरों का प्रकोप बढ़ा, फॉगिंग व एंटी लार्वा छिड़काव धीमा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Begusarai News: Amid changes in the weather, the mosquito menace has risen, fogging and larviciding are slow.
article.articleSummary: Begusarai city, India, faces rising mosquito menace due to weather changes and heavy rainfall, with fogging and anti-larva spraying progressing slowly. The municipal corporation has 12 small fogging machines and 50 anti-larva sprayers; a large fogging machine is currently unavailable after a 2023 incident where a large machine and tempo burned and have not been replaced. An agency tasked from October 1 to conduct fogging, anti-larva spraying, and house-to-house cleaning has yet to start, weakening control. Tenifos and Dengue Special Malathion are used for larviciding. Waterlogged wards 38, 39, 42, 25 and the eastern Lohiyanagar area have stagnant water in drains and vacant plots, creating breeding grounds. Councillors urge immediate, ward-wide fogging and intensified anti-larva spraying to curb dengue, malaria, and other vector-borne diseases ahead of Durga Puja.

triage.headline_ja: ベグサライ・ニュース：気候変動の中で蚊の脅威が増大、燻蒸と幼虫駆除が遅延
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染者数や死亡例の報告はなく、蚊媒介性疾患（デング熱・マラリア）対策の遅延に関する行政対応の記事であり、現時点で具体的な感染拡大の証拠はないが、今後の流行拡大リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はベグサライ市における蚊対策（燻蒸・幼虫駆除）の遅延に関する行政・地域報道であり、具体的な感染者数や死亡者数のデータは含まれていない。デュルガー・プージャ前の対策強化を求める地元議員のコメントが中心。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgınında bilanço ağırlaşıyor: Can kaybı 4 bini aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), declared May 15 in Ituri province, has spread to seven provinces. Laboratory-confirmed cases reach 8,300 with 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries, yielding a case-fatality rate of 48.4% as of 3 October 2026. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant is involved, and health authorities report no approved treatment or vaccine. Ituri initially reported 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths before declaration. Background notes: Ebola first emerged in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and in Yambuku, DRC; the 2013–2017 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) infected about 30,000 people and caused over 11,000 deaths. The article underscores ongoing transmission and high mortality with limited countermeasures for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の死者数が増加:死者数は4000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ変異株）が7州に拡大し、致死率48.4%・死者4,000人超という深刻な事態であり、承認された治療薬・ワクチンもないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはスーダン、シエラレオネ、リベリア、ギニア、ブルンジが含まれるが、これらは1976年および2013-2017年の過去の流行に関する背景情報であり、現行の流行地域はDRCのみ。致死率48.4%・治療薬ワクチン未承認という高リスク要因から、至急のフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: France Increases Ebola Funding in Congo Amid Resurgence Fears
article.articleSummary: France will intensify support against Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, allocating €13.4 million for January–July and proposing more humanitarian funding in upcoming French budget discussions. In Bunia, French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot visited a region hit by the virus and warned that Ebola could resurge quickly if vigilance wanes. The effort leverages humanitarian aid, medical research and the PRISM programme launched in 2023. A national humanitarian conference in Paris on October 6 will discuss Ebola. Barrot praised Congolese authorities, UN agencies, humanitarian organisations and medical workers for containing the epidemic and preventing spread to major urban centres. He noted a laboratory-confirmed mpox case in Bunia in mid-September, but urged continued focus on eradicating Ebola where it emerges; no need for fear of spread elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、コンゴでのエボラ再燃懸念を受け資金支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのエボラ再燃への懸念が表明され、フランスが資金支援を増額する動きがあり、mpox確認例も併記されるなど公衆衛生上の継続的な注視が必要なため。
triage.notes: フランス外相がブニア（DRC）を訪問し、同地域での9月中旬のmpox確認例にも言及。エボラは封じ込められているが再燃リスクが懸念されている。フランス自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: 十一长假疫情扩大 青壮年猝死显著增加
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: During the National Day Golden Week, the outbreak widens; sudden deaths among young and middle-aged adults have risen significantly.
article.articleSummary: During the National Day Golden Week in early October 2026, China's COVID-19 outbreak widens as travel crowds fill hospitals. In Hebei's Shijiazhuang, a local pharmacist reports many infections; before the holiday, about half of a class were ill, signaling a post-holiday peak. Dr. Zhang in Hebei says PJ.2.1 is the fastest-growing, most virulent current COVID-19 variant, with BA.3.2 under WHO monitoring; both are highly mutated, with strong receptor binding and rapid replication, fueling numerous severe cases. High viral load can worsen within two days, with deaths reported among people in their 40s, especially those with underlying heart conditions—myocarditis, myocardial infarction, heart failure, and sudden cardiac death. Re-infection may elevate mortality risk. Some regions report influenza A/H3N2 circulating after COVID-19 cooling, increasing hospitalizations. In Harbin, a funeral director notes rising sudden deaths among young adults.

triage.headline_ja: 十一連休で疫病拡大、若壮年層の突然死が顕著に増加
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株(PJ.2.1/BA.3.2)による重症化・死亡例増加と若年層の心疾患関連死が報告され、国慶節連休による人流拡大で感染拡大リスクが高いため、フルRRAでの検証が必要。
triage.notes: 情報源(botanwang.com)は海外中国語メディアであり、中国政府の公式発表や査読済みデータとは異なる可能性がある。新変異株の名称(PJ.2.1, BA.3.2)や死亡数増加の具体的統計は未検証であり、WHO/中国CDCの公式発表との照合が必要。インフルエンザA(H3N2)との同時流行も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) mourns loss of Uganda Red Cross humanitarian in Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Ambulance driver Ismael Mulindwa of the Uganda Red Cross Society died from injuries sustained after an attack on 17 August 2026 while supporting the Ebola response in Aru, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. He died on 1 October 2026. The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) mourns his loss and extends condolences to his family, colleagues, and URCS. The incident underscores the risks faced by Red Cross and Red Crescent staff and volunteers in difficult and dangerous environments during humanitarian missions. The IFRC strongly condemns violence against humanitarian workers and calls for their protection and respect as they assist communities in need in the DRC Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字国際連盟（IFRC）、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）エボラ対応中に死亡したウガンダ赤十字の人道支援者を追悼
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で継続中のエボラ対応活動における人道支援者への攻撃・死亡事例であり、既存のエボラ流行が依然活動的かつ治安上のリスクにより対応が妨げられている点で、国際的拡大・管理可能性の観点から懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例報告ではなく、既存のDRCエボラ対応中における人道支援者（ウガンダ赤十字所属）の攻撃死亡事例に関するもの。治安情勢が対応活動を妨げている点が懸念材料。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Awareness programme on rabies held
article.articleSummary: Rabies awareness programme held in Puducherry, organized by Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Veterinary Education and Research (RIVER) in association with the National Rabies Control Programme and Puducherry State Health Mission, as part of World Rabies Day observance. The event emphasized a One Health approach, timely first aid after exposure, and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), along with animal vaccination to tackle rabies cases. Various competitions were conducted during the observance. Attendees included Director of Health and Family Welfare S. Sevvel and RIVER Dean K. Murugavel. The release highlights collaboration among veterinary education, health authorities, and public health agencies to promote awareness and preventive measures against rabies in Puducherry.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病に関する啓発プログラムが開催
triage.triage_reason: 世界狂犬病デーに関連した啓発イベントの報道であり、新規感染事例や公衆衛生上の異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発活動・予防策に関する一般的な広報であり、具体的な感染拡大や症例急増の報告はないため対象国リストへの計上は見送った。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni: des affiches placardées pour une sensibilisation permanente dans des écoles - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Posters posted for ongoing awareness in schools - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola awareness posters are posted in schools in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to curb transmission amid ongoing concerns. The Risk Communication and Community Engagement pillar (Crec) placed placards in institutions including Institut Mukulya, Lycée Mwandu, Kisungu, Kisolokele, Mapendo primaries, and Kanzuli-nzuli in Bungulu commune. Posters carry messages such as Stop Ebola and Ebola exists, plus guidance on handwashing and images illustrating symptoms and transmission. The initiative targets crowded primary schools during a period of free education, aiming to reduce exposure by reinforcing daily preventive practices. As of 3 October 2026, no Ebola cases have been confirmed in schools in Beni; rumors of suspected cases circulating online have not been substantiated, with authorities monitoring the situation. The effort seeks to strengthen prevention in schools and the wider community.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ：学校での継続的な啓発のためポスターが掲示される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラに関する学校での予防啓発活動の報告であり、確定症例の報告はなく、学校での疑い例の噂も未確認。既存の対応継続状況として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は北キブ州ベニにおけるエボラ予防啓発活動（学校でのポスター掲示）に関する内容。確定症例は報告されておらず、学校での疑い例の噂も未確認。既存のエボラ流行への対応継続の一環とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Каждый восьмой случай рака в мире связан с инфекциями. Больше всего случаев приходится на Helicobacter pylori и ВПЧ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One in eight cancer cases worldwide is linked to infections. The largest share of cases is due to Helicobacter pylori and HPV.
article.articleSummary: 2.3 million new cancer cases worldwide in 2024 were caused by infections, about 12% of all new cancers, according to IARC using 2024 GLOBOCAN data. The largest shares were linked to Helicobacter pylori (approximately 760,000 cases, mostly gastric cancer) and human papillomavirus (HPV) around 750,000 cases, driving nearly all cervical cancer and portions of anal, genital, and oropharyngeal cancers. About 360,000 cases were associated with hepatitis B virus (HBV), 260,000 with Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), and 160,000 with hepatitis C virus (HCV). These five infections account for the majority of infection-attributable cancers. EBV is newly linked to gastric cancer in this update. Infection itself is not contagious; infections raise cancer risk via chronic inflammation, cellular damage, or immune changes. East Asia bears the largest burden (~990,000 cases, 42%). Prevention includes HPV and HBV vaccination, HCV antiviral therapy, H. pylori testing and treatment, HIV management, safe injections, condom use, and HPV-related precancer screening.

triage.headline_ja: 世界の癌の8件に1件は感染症に関連。最も多いのはヘリコバクター・ピロリ菌とHPVによるもの
triage.triage_reason: IARC/GLOBOCANの統計データに基づく一般的な疫学解説記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定地域のアウトブレイクではなく、世界的な癌疫学統計（GLOBOCAN 2024データ）に関する科学報道。発生地域として上海・中国が付与されているが、記事内容に中国特有の事象は言及されていないため該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : un médecin survivant témoigne des difficultés de réintégration après guérison - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: a doctor who survived recounts the difficulties of reintegration after recovery - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Kisangani, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola survivor Dr. Innocent Bukanga, a government physician, details reintegration difficulties after recovering from Ebola virus disease (EVD). Discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) on 2 September, he remained without professional assignment or risk allowances until 27 September, facing stigma and rejection in various workplaces. He approached the provincial health division (DPS) to address his lack of posting and benefits, and was subsequently reassigned to the Kisangani CTE, where he reports improved circumstances. Bukanga contracted EVD through occupational exposure while caring for a patient from Nia-Nia in Ituri province, who was unaware of his infection. After fever, diarrhea, vomiting, and asthenia, he was initially treated for severe malaria, then admitted to Cinquantenaire Hospital in Kisangani, where EVD was laboratory-confirmed. Symptoms began about seven days post-exposure; he spent 12–13 days at the CTE before recovery. He urges communities to abandon stigma to aid social and professional reintegration.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニのエボラ：回復した医師が、治癒後の社会復帰の困難さを語る - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中とみられるエボラ流行に関連する記事だが、内容は既に回復した1症例（医療従事者）のスティグマ・社会復帰に関する人道的側面であり、新規症例やアウトブレイクの拡大を示す情報ではないため、フルRRAよりも続報の注視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は医療従事者が職業的曝露（Nia-Nia, Ituri州の患者ケア中）でEVDに感染し、キサンガニのCTEで治療・回復した後の社会復帰困難とスティグマについての体験談。新規感染拡大の情報は含まれないが、DRCでのエボラ流行自体は既知の重大な公衆衛生イベントであるため継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Negara ini Dilanda Wabah Ebola Terbesar, Korban Tewas Tembus 4.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This Country Hit by the Largest Ebola Outbreak, Death Toll Surpasses 4,000.
article.articleSummary: DRC is facing the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. As of Oct 2, 2026, government data show 4,018 deaths and 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, with more than 2,000 recoveries. The outbreak began in Ituri province and has spread to the eastern region, including North Kivu, while South Ubangi in the northwest was also declared affected after a traveler from the east died. Health authorities and the United Nations warn that transmission remains rapid in eastern Congo despite signs of slowing in some areas. MSF runs the Kitatumba Ebola treatment center in Butembo, North Kivu, with documented disinfection procedures and PPE use as part of the response. Ebola symptoms include fever, bleeding, and severe complications; containment requires specialized facilities and strict HCW protection.

triage.headline_ja: この国で過去最大のエボラ流行、死者4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大・最悪規模のエボラ流行（死者4,018人、確定症例8,300人）が7州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行で、イトゥリ州から始まり北キブ州・南ウバンギ州など複数州へ拡大。MSFが北キブ州ブテンボでエボラ治療センターを運営中。国連も警戒を発しており、国際的な支援が既に行われている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni: des kits de lavage des mains sollicités dans les écoles - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: handwashing kits requested in schools - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Beni, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, authorities are requesting handwashing kits to protect students and staff from Ebola in schools. On 3 October 2026, ACP reported visits to several schools where officials appealed for handwashing supplies to prevent Ebola contamination. Olivier Kakule, deputy head of Masongo Primary School in Mulekera commune, said that without kits, pupils and teachers are exposed; parents contributed 200 FC each to purchase two kits for 18 classrooms, but every classroom should have a kit for better protection. For the 2026-2027 school year, Beni's schools have adopted measures including regular handwashing as Ebola prevention. Ongoing resource shortages hinder obtaining kits for each classroom, underscoring the need for intervention by competent authorities and support from national and international partners in the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: ベニでのエボラ出血熱：学校で手洗いキットの要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCベニ地域でエボラ出血熱の予防策として学校への手洗いキット支援が要請されており、既存のエボラ流行が継続している可能性が高く、IHR基準の重大性・異常性に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行下の学校における予防策（手洗いキット不足）に関する内容であり、具体的な感染者数や死亡者数の記載はないが、既存のエボラ流行対応の一環と推測される。続報での症例数・地域拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mambasa : trois nouveaux guéris quittent le centre de traitement (Médecin- chef de zone) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mambasa: three newly recovered patients leave the treatment center (Zone Chief Medical Officer) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Three Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) patients were discharged from the Mambasa zone treatment center in Ituri Province, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo, on 3 October 2026 after timely care. Zone medical chief Dr Yunga Abedi credited early treatment and praised the response team, noting that recovery proves Ebola is not inevitably fatal when patients reach care promptly. Recovered individuals will assist community sensitization and bolster trust in responders. Health authorities urged rapid reporting of suspected cases to guide patients to treatment facilities. Despite ongoing challenges, progress includes near-completion of a new Ebola Treatment Center and the availability of a laboratory capable of delivering results within 48 hours, shortening diagnostic delays and speeding case linkage to care.

triage.headline_ja: マンバサのエボラ出血熱：新たに回復した3人の患者が治療センターを退所（地域医療責任者） - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州マンバサで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する続報であり、致死性疾患かつ国際的拡大・渡航制限リスクを伴うためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事自体は回復者退院という好転的な内容だが、DRCで継続中のエボラアウトブレイクの一環であり、公衆衛生上の重大性から継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mulher morre vítima de peste na Sibéria após acidente em laboratório. Autoridades russas colocaram 200 pessoas em isolamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman dies from plague in Siberia after laboratory accident. Russian authorities placed 200 people in isolation.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, a 28-year-old laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Institute of Plague Control in Siberia died of pneumonic plague after a tube containing Yersinia pestis broke during sampling. About 197 people with potential exposure were placed under medical observation; more than 100 were hospitalized, and the Shelekhov district hospital near Irkutsk was quarantined. Regional authorities opened a criminal probe into possible biosafety violations, with Governor Igor Kobzev coordinating with Russia’s public health agency. The case is described as a suspected plague, with pneumonic plague described by the WHO as the most virulent form, featuring rapid lung infection and person-to-person transmission, incubation up to 24 hours, and mortality near 100% if untreated (about 50% with treatment). China reported two suspected/confirmed pneumonic plague cases; Mongolia reported 17 cases (2019–2025) with seven deaths.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで研究所事故後にペストで女性死亡。ロシア当局は200人を隔離
triage.triage_reason: 研究所でのYersinia pestis漏出により肺ペストで死亡者が出ており、約200人が観察下に置かれ100人以上が入院するなど重大な公衆衛生事象である。中国でも疑い例・確認例が報告されており国際的拡大の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 主発生地はロシア（シベリア、イルクーツク）であり対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事中で中国における疑い/確認例への言及があるため中国のみ対象国として記載。モンゴルも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El ministro francés de Exteriores aborda con el presidente de RDC la respuesta al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The French Foreign Minister discusses with the President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo the response to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s eastern regions, declared May 15, remains severe. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot met in Kinshasa with President Félix Tshisekedi to coordinate the response; Barrot will visit Bunia in Ituri, the outbreak’s epicenter, and engage local authorities and NGOs. As of Oct 1, 8,376 confirmed cases and 4,042 deaths have been reported, with a global case-fatality rate of 48.3%. Recoveries total 2,182; 869 patients are hospitalized or in isolation. The outbreak affects 63 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ubangi del Sur. It is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak worldwide. The virus has also reached Uganda, where the WHO declared the end of its outbreak on Aug 26 after 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from the DRC) and two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: フランス外相、コンゴ民主共和国大統領とエボラ対応について協議
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%、死者4,042人に及ぶ世界第2位の規模のエボラ流行が継続中であり、国際的な拡大（ウガンダへの波及）も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの波及は既にWHOにより終息宣言（8月26日）済み。主要流行地はDRC東部7州63保健地区であり、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため記載せず。フランス外相の訪問は国際的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Francia intensificará la financiación del ébola en el Congo en medio de temores de resurgimiento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France will intensify funding for Ebola in the Congo amid fears of a resurgence.
article.articleSummary: France will intensify funding for Ebola response in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), focusing on Ituri province and Bunia, amid fears of a resurgence. Barrot warned that the 17th Ebola outbreak—the deadliest to date with more than 8,000 cases and about 4,000 deaths—could rebound quickly if surveillance declines. France plans additional humanitarian funding and to bolster medical research through PRISME (Platform for Global Health Research). From January to July 2026, Paris allocated €13.4 million to Ebola response; in July it delivered about 20 tonnes of prevention materials and medicines to Ituri. Barrot praised Congolese authorities, UN agencies, and health workers for containing the outbreak and preventing major urban spread. He noted an imported France case (a humanitarian worker returning from Ituri in June 2026) but said there is no need for alarm. The visit precedes Paris’s National Humanitarian Conference on Oct 6.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、再燃懸念の中でコンゴのエボラ対策資金を強化へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（8,000例超・死亡約4,000人）の第17次エボラ流行が継続中であり、仏への輸入症例も発生、再燃懸念から国際的な資金・人道支援強化が進められている。
triage.notes: フランスへの輸入症例が報告されているが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。主たる発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州・ブニア）。

article.articleHeadline: Nine-year-old girl with chronic illness in critical condition after influenza B infection
article.articleSummary: Influenza B infection in a nine-year-old girl in Hong Kong progressed to septic shock and severe pneumonia, placing her in the paediatric intensive care unit at Queen Elizabeth Hospital after fever on 30 September and cough/vomiting on 1 October; laboratory testing confirmed influenza B. The child had pre‑existing conditions, no travel history during incubation, and was not vaccinated for the 2026/27 season. Two household contacts had mild fever and URTI but recovered; investigations ongoing. Since late June, Hong Kong's influenza activity has been high, with 21 recorded severe paediatric influenza cases; 16 discharged, 2 stable, 2 in critical condition, and 1 death. The 2026/27 vaccination programme, including School Outreach, began 17 September with electronic consent via eHealth; around 100 schools arranged outreach, targeting mid-December completion. Officials warn symptoms can deteriorate rapidly and urge vaccination and prompt medical attention.

triage.headline_ja: 慢性疾患を持つ9歳女児、インフルエンザB感染後に重体に（香港）
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザBによる重症小児例（21例中1死亡・2重体）が報告され、公的機関がワクチン接種を呼びかけるなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区はChina (1814991)として集計。季節性インフルエンザの流行であり新興感染症ではないが、重症小児例の増加と行政対応の活発化が見られるためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : une marche de santé sensibilise les élèves et la communauté aux risques d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: a health walk raises awareness among students and the community about the risks of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, Oct 3, 2026 — A health walk focused on Ebola awareness was organized by the La Vérité 1 School Complex in Mangobo, Kisangani, in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Led by Power Noteyole, the event aims to reinforce preventive measures for Ebola virus disease (EVD). After an in-school briefing, students and teachers extended the outreach through door-to-door visits to parents and the broader community, with messages broadcast at busy markets and bus stops. Participants were urged to avoid handshakes and to consistently wash hands, use hydroalcoholic gel, and wear face masks. Moto-taxi drivers and market sellers were targeted to increase uptake of mask use and gel. The organizer urged other schools to provide handwashing kits or gel for students, teachers, and parents to help prevent the spread of Ebola. This initiative emphasizes barrier gestures as a path to ending Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ：生徒と地域社会がエボラのリスクについて意識を高める健康啓発ウォーク
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラ流行の発生報告ではなく、学校主催の予防啓発活動（ヘルスウォーク）に関する内容であり、実際の症例や流行の兆候は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの実際の発生報告ではなく、予防啓発（手洗い・マスク着用・握手回避等）を目的とした地域活動を伝えるもの。具体的な症例数や発生状況の記載はないため、トリアージ対象の感染症イベントとしての根拠は乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: France steps up Ebola support in Congo as fears of resurgence grow
article.articleSummary: France will intensify its backing to eliminate Ebola in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo as fears of resurgence grow. The DR Congo Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot, during a rare visit to Bunia where a confirmed infection was discovered in mid-September, announced €13.4 million in aid for Ebola efforts between January and July and signaled plans to seek further humanitarian aid and Ebola funding in upcoming budget discussions. France's response centers on humanitarian aid, medical research, and the PRISM programme, with a Paris conference planned for October 6 to discuss Ebola. Barrot warned that Ebola could resurge if complacency sets in, praising Congolese authorities, humanitarian organizations, and healthcare workers for preventing spread to major cities. The article notes the outbreak remains in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、再燃懸念高まる中コンゴのエボラ対策支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部のエボラ流行は死者4,000人超の大規模アウトブレイクであり、国際的な資金・人道支援が強化されている。公衆衛生上の深刻性と再燃リスクへの懸念からフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: フランスは支援提供国として登場するが、イベント発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。死者数4,000人超という既に大規模な流行であり、再燃（resurgence）への懸念が記事の主眼。

article.articleHeadline: Terjunkan 11 Tim, Dinas Peternakan Kabupaten TTU Gencar Vaksinasi SE dan Hog Cholera
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TTU Regency Department of Animal Husbandry Deploys 11 Teams to Intensify Vaccination Against SE and Hog Cholera
article.articleSummary: Timor Tengah Utara Regency's Department of Animal Husbandry in East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), Indonesia, mobilized 11 vaccination teams to intensify protection against Hog Cholera (Classical Swine Fever) and SE in cattle and pigs across TTU. Since January 2026 vaccine stock was limited, but recently Hog Cholera and SE vaccines have arrived. The program will run in parallel with village-level HPR vaccination. The Directorate General of Animal Husbandry supplied the vaccines to TTU. Officials cite field data suggesting swine vaccinated against Hog Cholera showed greater resilience to ASF outbreaks. From January through May 2026, no ASF reports were received in TTU. Farmers are urged to reinforce biosecurity: maintain sanitation, restrict external visitors from pig housing (10 meters away), and if pigs die, do not slaughter or eat the meat but bury the carcasses.

triage.headline_ja: TTU県畜産局、11チームを投入し豚コレラ(Hog Cholera)およびSEワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 豚コレラ・ASFは動物疾病であり人獣共通感染症ではなく、公衆衛生への直接的影響はない。内容もワクチン接種活動の通常業務報告であり、ASF発生報告自体もない。
triage.notes: 対象疾患はヒトに感染しない家畜疾病（Classical Swine Fever, African Swine Fever）であり、公衆衛生リスクの観点からは対象外。地方自治体の通常のワクチン接種活動の報道。

article.articleHeadline: Crisis por el ébola se agrava en Congo con más de 4.000 personas fallecidas | TN8
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola crisis worsens in Congo with more than 4,000 people dead | TN8.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, northeast) has caused 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases (case fatality 48.4%), with over 2,000 recoveries. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was declared on May 15, 2026 in Ituri. Since then, transmission has spread to 63 health zones across seven provinces, straining surveillance, diagnosis, and care. Bunia, the capital of Ituri, faces staffing shortages as health workers protest overdue salaries, hindering monitoring of exposed individuals. The World Health Organization warns that geographic spread, insecurity, and limited access to communities complicate the response, though surveillance continues to detect alerts, investigate suspected cases, and trace contacts to interrupt transmission chains. This is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo history and the second-largest globally, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ危機悪化、死者4,000人超える
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行で死者4,000人超、7州63保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 致死率48.4%と非常に高く、医療従事者の給与未払いによるストライキが監視・対応能力を低下させている。地理的拡大と治安悪化がWHOにより懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: बिना जांचे नहीं चढ़ेगा खून: MP के 5 सरकारी मेडिकल कॉलेजों में शुरू होगी NAT टेस्टिंग,15 दिन में संक्रमण को पकड़ लेगी मशीन
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Blood Won’t Be Drawn Without Testing: NAT Testing to Begin at 5 Government Medical Colleges in MP, and the Machine Will Detect Infection Within 15 Days.
article.articleSummary: Nucleic Acid Testing (NAT) will be deployed at five major government medical colleges in Madhya Pradesh to reduce transfusion-associated infection risk. Indore, Bhopal, Gwalior, Jabalpur, and Rewa will host NAT facilities capable of early detection of Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and HIV. The rollout is scheduled to start by the end of October 2026, with the machines reportedly able to detect these infections within 15 days, enabling safer blood transfusions through earlier laboratory confirmation. This public health measure targets strengthening blood safety at the state's key medical centers.

triage.headline_ja: 検査なしでは輸血せず：MP州の5つの州立医科大学でNAT検査を開始、機械が15日で感染を検出
triage.triage_reason: これは輸血の安全性を強化するための公衆衛生対策（NAT検査導入）に関する報道であり、新規感染症の発生やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド・マディヤ・プラデーシュ州における血液検査体制強化（NAT導入）に関する政策的な報道であり、疾病アウトブレイクの発生報告ではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生国は特定されない（既存の医療インフラ改善施策）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mambasa : les leaders religieux s'engagent à renforcer la sensibilisation - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mambasa: religious leaders commit to strengthening awareness-raising - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Mambasa: religious leaders from Lwemba, Biakato, Maiwano and Teturi in Mambasa Territory, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, have pledged to strengthen awareness-raising on Ebola prevention. The commitment followed a Saturday meeting with Ebola response teams. Prophet Barthélémy Aluta, head of the 45th Pentecostal Evangelical Community (CEP), said pastors will intensify prevention messaging across church structures to better educate communities and protect worshippers. He stressed that, just as congregations heed sermons on faith, they should heed messages on protection against Ebola. Religious leaders reaffirmed their determination to contribute to the Ebola response through church-based outreach, urging adherents to pay particular attention to prevention messages broadcast within churches. The article notes no numerical outbreak data, but frames the effort within the ongoing Ebola response in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: マンバサのエボラ出血熱：宗教指導者らが啓発活動強化を約束
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱対応に関する記事であり、疾患自体の重篤性・ヒト-ヒト感染リスクが高いためフルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例データを含まず、宗教指導者による啓発活動の継続的取り組みを報じるもの。既存のエボラ対応の一環であり、続報で感染状況・規模の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 1 in 8 Cancer Cases Worldwide Are Linked to Infections
article.articleSummary: In 2024, about 2.3 million new cancer cases worldwide were linked to infections, roughly 12% of all cancers. The five infections accounted for most cases: Helicobacter pylori ≈760,000 (4%), human papillomavirus ≈750,000 (4%), hepatitis B ≈360,000, Epstein-Barr virus ≈260,000, and hepatitis C ≈160,000. East Asia bore the largest burden with ≈990,000 infection-related cancers (42% of the global total), and more than three-quarters of cases occurred in low- and middle-income countries. Prevention opportunities include HPV and hepatitis B vaccination, HIV testing and treatment, H. pylori testing and treatment, and hepatitis B and C management, along with safer injection practices, condoms/HIV PrEP, and screening for precancerous cervical and anal changes linked to HPV. EBV has no vaccine or approved antiviral; HIV can drive AIDS-related cancers. Stronger infection control could avert many cancers.

triage.headline_ja: 世界のがん症例の8人に1人は感染症が関連
triage.triage_reason: 特定の地域での急性アウトブレイクではなく、グローバルながん疫学に関する一般的な研究報告であり、IHR・WPRO基準への該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事は特定国での感染症アウトブレイクではなく、世界的ながんと感染症の関連に関する統計報告。上海・中国は発生地域として付与されているが、記事内容はグローバルな疫学データであり特定地域の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ಸಿಲಿಕಾನ್ ಸಿಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹವಾಮಾನ ವೈಪರೀತ್ಯ: ವೈರಲ್ ಜ್ವರಕ್ಕೆ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬಿದ್ದ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿಗರು, ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ರೋಗಿಗಳ ದಂಡು!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Weather fluctuations in Silicon City: Bengaluru residents alarmed by viral fever, hospitals see a surge of patients!
article.articleSummary: Bengaluru, Karnataka, on 3 October 2026, faces a surge in viral infections due to fluctuating weather (sun followed by rain). Hospitals report rising cases among both adults and children, with major facilities such as KC General, Victoria, and C.V. Raman Nagar Hospitals overwhelmed. One-week tally: vomiting and abdominal pain 3,297 cases; SARI (Severe Acute Respiratory Infection) 268; Influenza 274; viral fever 94; dengue 242; malaria 128. Health authorities urge adequate treatment across public and private hospitals and advise residents to stay hydrated, boil water, and seek prompt medical care on symptom onset. While weather changes are natural, neglect could threaten health, underscoring the need for vigilant public health monitoring in Bengaluru during Karnataka’s outbreak period.

triage.headline_ja: シリコンシティで天候急変：ウイルス性発熱にベンガルール市民が動揺、病院は患者であふれる
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）が複数該当し、住民・当局の関心も高いため、続報確認とフルRRAへの移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 季節性の気候変動に伴う複合感染症（インフルエンザ、デング熱、マラリア、SARI等）の増加であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、地域医療機関の負荷増大が報告されている。続報にて重症度・死亡例の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Fallecidos por ébola en RDC supera las 4 mil personas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in the DRC exceed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths; case fatality rate 48.4%. As of 2026-10-03, 842 symptomatic patients are hospitalized, while epidemiological teams are tracing 80.6% of contacts to interrupt transmission. The outbreak began in Ituri Province in northeastern DRC and is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no licensed vaccine or approved specific therapy for this strain. Laboratory-confirmed cases continue to be reported, while several treatments and vaccines remain in trial phases. The DRC is experiencing its worst, most deadly Ebola outbreak in history, with ongoing efforts to monitor and contain the spread. Early infection can present with mild symptoms, potentially delaying detection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱による死者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（致死率48.4%）であり、ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる史上最悪規模の流行で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率48.4%、症例8,300件・死者4,018人、承認済みワクチン・治療法なしのBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による、DRC史上最悪規模のアウトブレイク。国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola salgınında can kaybı 4 bini aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll in the Ebola outbreak in Congo has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Death toll in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 4,018 deaths, with 8,300 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,162 recoveries; case fatality rate 48.4%. The seven-province outbreak includes Ituri in the eastern region, which reported 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths before the outbreak was declared on May 15. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant identified in May has no approved treatment or vaccine. Ebola virus disease—first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC—was named after the Ebola River near a village in the DRC. As of October 3, 2026, health authorities continue to monitor ongoing transmission and outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行による死者数が4,000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: DRCで死者4,018人、確定症例8,300人、致死率48.4%という大規模なエボラ流行が7州に拡大しており、承認されたワクチン・治療法がないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: スーダン（Nzara）とブルンジ（Muyinga州）はエボラウイルスの1976年発見の歴史的文脈で言及されているのみで、現在の流行発生地ではないため除外した。現在の流行はDRC国内の7州（イトゥリ州含む）に限定されている。

article.articleHeadline: وزير الخارجية الفرنسي في زيارة إلى الكونغو: نعتزم زيادة التمويل المخصص لمكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: French Foreign Minister on a visit to the Congo: We intend to increase the funding allocated to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: France will boost funding to combat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, as Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot visited Bunia in the northeast, where a laboratory-confirmed monkeypox case was detected in mid-September. France has allocated €13.4 million (about $15.1 million) to Ebola efforts for January–July and plans to propose additional humanitarian funding in upcoming budget discussions, including support through the PRISM program. A national humanitarian conference in Paris is scheduled for 6 October to address Ebola. Barrot warned that Ebola could resurge quickly if surveillance lapses and praised Congolese authorities, UN agencies, humanitarian groups, and healthcare workers for containment and preventing spread to major urban centers. In response to questions about a reported case in France, he emphasized there is no need for fear and that the outbreak must be fought where it appears.

triage.headline_ja: フランス外相、コンゴ訪問：エボラ対策向け資金拠出を拡大する方針
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ流行に対し国際支援・資金拠出が表明されており、WPRO基準（重症度・継続曝露・流行性・対応可能性）に複数該当し社会的・政治的関心も高いため、フルRRA対象として確認する。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のDRCエボラ流行（および北東部Buniaでの既確認Mpox症例）に対するフランスの外交的・資金的支援表明が主題であり、新規発生シグナルではなく既存アウトブレイクへの対応フォローアップ記事である点に留意。フランス国内での報告例についても『懸念不要』との発言のみで詳細不明。

article.articleHeadline: Француска појачава подршку борби против еболе у Конгу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France steps up its support for the fight against Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 3 October 2026, France announced it would intensify support for Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), following warnings that the virus could spread quickly if vigilance wanes. French Foreign Minister Jean Baro praised Congolese authorities, UN agencies, humanitarian groups, and medical workers for containing the outbreak and preventing spread to larger urban centers inside the DRC and beyond. France has allocated 13.4 million euros for Ebola control from January to July and will seek additional humanitarian funds in upcoming budget deliberations. A National Humanitarian Conference in Paris on 6 October will address Ebola as part of broader relief efforts. The article notes that one Ebola case was reported in France, underscoring concerns about cross-border transmission. A treatment center for Ebola patients is in Beni, DRC.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、コンゴでのエボラ対策支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が続いており、フランスへの症例報告（越境伝播）や国際支援の動きがあり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: フランス国内で1例報告されたとの記述があるが詳細（感染経路・確定診断状況）は不明。ベニ（DRC）の治療センターが言及されている。パリでの人道会議は支援活動の一環でありDRCが主な発生地域。

article.articleHeadline: 九歲長期病患女童感染乙型流感 併發敗血性休克及嚴重肺炎情況危殆 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nine-year-old girl with a chronic illness infected with influenza B, complicated by septic shock and severe pneumonia, in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: Nine-year-old girl with a chronic illness in Hong Kong is diagnosed with Influenza B and is in critical condition after developing septic shock and severe pneumonia. She did not receive the 2026/27 seasonal influenza vaccine. There is no travel history during the incubation period. On Sept 30 she developed fever; on Oct 1 she developed cough and vomiting, sought care at a private clinic, then was transferred to the emergency department and admitted to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at Queen Elizabeth Hospital. Respiratory sample tested positive for Influenza B. Two household contacts had mild symptoms but recovered. The Centre for Health Protection is continuing the investigation; initial findings indicate no travel abroad during the incubation period. Officials urge high-risk individuals to receive the seasonal flu vaccine promptly and to maintain good personal and environmental hygiene to prevent influenza and other respiratory infections.

triage.headline_ja: 基礎疾患のある9歳女児がB型インフルエンザに感染、敗血性ショックと重症肺炎を併発し危篤
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザBの単発重症例であり、家族内接触者は軽症で回復。異常な病原体変異や広範な拡大の兆候はなく、季節性疾患の個別重症例として扱うべき事案。
triage.notes: 香港の個別重症例報告。季節性インフルエンザBによるもので、基礎疾患を有する患者の重症化事例。濃厚接触者は軽症で回復しており、ヒト-ヒト感染の持続的拡大やアウトブレイクの兆候はない。衛生当局（CHP）が調査継続中だが、通常の季節性サーベイランスの範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Francuska pojačava podršku borbi protiv ebole u Kongu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France intensifies its support for the fight against Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: France intensifies support for Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as Foreign Minister Jean Barro visits the Bunia region, warning the virus could spread rapidly if vigilance wanes. He commends Congolese authorities, UN agencies, humanitarian groups, and health workers for containing the outbreak and preventing spread to larger urban centers inside and outside the DRC. Barro asserts no need for fear but stresses addressing the epidemic where it arises. France has allocated 13.4 million euros for Ebola efforts from January to July and will seek additional humanitarian funding in upcoming budget debates. A national humanitarian conference in Paris on October 6 will discuss Ebola alongside other aid issues. The article notes one imported case in France and underscores ongoing international support to prevent resurgence.”}{

triage.headline_ja: フランスがコンゴのエボラ対策支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準における重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、フランスへの輸入例が報告されるなど国際的拡大の兆候があるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: フランスの外相がコンゴ(ブニア地域)を訪問し資金援助を表明。フランス国内に輸入症例が1件あるが、主な発生地はDRCであるためFranceは対象国リストに含まれず除外。パリでの人道会議開催も社会的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στην Ευρώπη: Τέσσερα πλέον τα εισαγόμενα κρούσματα - Η εκτίμηση για τον πληθυσμό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Europe: Four imported cases now — The population estimate.
article.articleSummary: Four imported Ebola cases have been detected in Europe linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. The latest case involves a health-care worker in DRC diagnosed on 29 September and subsequently transported to the Netherlands for specialized treatment. Despite these importations, the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) says the risk to the general population remains very low. Previous imported cases also involved medical or humanitarian workers in areas of active transmission. European countries maintain strict protocols for patient transport and infection control, and when these measures are followed, further transmission is considered unlikely. EU/EEA states are urged to stay vigilant for additional imported cases, prioritizing early recognition of suspected cases, immediate isolation, strict protection measures, and appropriate laboratory investigations to preserve preparedness without causing undue public alarm.

triage.headline_ja: 欧州でエボラ出血熱、輸入症例が4例に — 人口への影響評価

article.articleHeadline: Plague never went away. Death of a 'lab technician' in Siberia is a reminder of what it does and the panic it causes
article.articleSummary: Death in Russia’s Irkutsk region from plague is reported; a 28-year-old laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute may have contracted pneumonic plague after a test-tube incident, with about 200 contacts quarantined. Authorities have not yet confirmed details or route of infection. Plague arises from Yersinia pestis; transmission occurs via flea bite, contact with infected tissue, or inhalation of respiratory droplets. It has three forms: bubonic, septicaemic, and pneumonic—the latter is the only form that spreads between people by air. Pneumonic plague is highly lethal if untreated; antibiotics are effective when started early. Public health response focuses on identifying and observing contacts rather than mass restrictions. Plague remains endemic globally, notably in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Madagascar, and Peru (3,248 cases and 584 deaths reported 2010–2015). Reservoirs exist in marmots in southern Siberia and Mongolia, explaining occasional Siberian cases; three historic pandemics originated in different regions.

article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague is suspected after a woman in her 20s died in Russia’s Irkutsk region near the Mongolia border. The patient, who worked at a laboratory, was admitted Tuesday with severe pneumonia and placed on a ventilator; she died Thursday. About 200 people are in quarantine, including roughly 100 hospital staff and another 100 who may have had contact with her. Media reports offer competing exposure theories: she may have accidentally crushed a vial containing live bacteria while collecting samples, or contracted the infection on a work trip to Buryatia or Thailand. The governor of neighboring Buryatia, Aleksei Tsydenov, said the case is likely plague but later denied a regional outbreak, citing no current cases and dormant pest reservoirs there. Official sources describe an unknown dangerous infection; epidemiologists say there is no outbreak and that authorities know how to treat it.

article.articleHeadline: Hidden Microbes in Tamale's Wells Reveal a Growing Water Safety Crisis
article.articleSummary: Tamale metropolis, Northern Ghana, relies on hand-dug wells and boreholes whose groundwater shows widespread faecal contamination, exceeding safety standards. A 2022/23 lean-season study of twenty sites (ten wells, ten boreholes) found most sources unsafe for drinking. Using APHA membrane filtration, well samples showed total coliforms 0–32,200 CFU/100 mL (median 379), faecal coliforms up to 18,000 CFU/100 mL, and E. coli in half the wells (up to 16,000 CFU/100 mL); 70% of wells tested positive for total and faecal coliforms. Boreholes fared better but remained risky: half exceeded total coliform limits; 20% had faecal coliforms >200 CFU/100 mL; median total coliform 600 CFU/100 mL; no E. coli above guideline. Turbidity was high for both sources (medians 78 NTU wells, 119 NTU boreholes). Antibiotic testing of E. coli isolates showed resistance to six of eight agents (including cephalosporins and augmentin) but susceptibility to ciprofloxacin/ofloxacin, highlighting treatment challenges amid catchment-wide sanitation gaps and elevated diarrhoeal-disease risk.

article.articleHeadline: France pledges more support to fight DRC Ebola outbreak as deaths top 4,000 - AOL
article.articleSummary: DRC's eastern Ebola outbreak has 8,376 cases and 4,042 deaths since the May 15 declaration, with Bunia in Ituri province at the epicentre. France pledged €13.4 million for Ebola from January–July and plans more humanitarian funding ahead of a Paris conference on 6 October where Ebola features prominently; French official Barrot visited Bunia urging prevention of resurgences. The outbreak risks surpassing West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll of ~11,000 deaths. New confirmed cases have declined from ~850/week and 470 deaths/week in mid-July to ~490 cases and 230 deaths per week in September, but spread remains uneven. MSF highlights worsening transmission in North Kivu, accounting for 40% of new cases since late August. Health minister Kamba says the epidemic has peaked and 19 of 63 zones have had no cases for at least three weeks. An imported case: a doctor who returned from a DRC mission tested positive in France on 23 June and recovered.

article.articleHeadline: ಕುಷ್ಠರೋಗ ಮುಕ್ತ ಭಾರತದ ಗುರಿಗೆ ಹಿನ್ನಡೆ?; 3,823 ಮಕ್ಕಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳು ಪತ್ತೆ | Setback to the goal of a leprosy-free India? New cases detected in 3,823 children.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Setback to the goal of a leprosy-free India? New cases detected in 3,823 children.
article.articleSummary: India recorded 3,832 new pediatric leprosy cases in 2025-26, with 37 children presenting Grade-2 disability at diagnosis, according to the National Leprosy Elimination Programme (NLEP) annual report. The target to limit pediatric cases to under 2,000 and to achieve zero Grade-2 disability in children is far from met, with pediatric cases 91.6% above the goal. Although overall new cases declined from the 2014-17 peak of over 11,000 annually, children continue to be diagnosed with leprosy and some already have disabilities. The WHO’s 2025 report ranks India first globally with 91,783 total new leprosy cases in 2025-26, and 3,832 pediatric cases—the highest in children worldwide. The states with the highest transmission are Chhattisgarh (23 districts), Jharkhand (21), Maharashtra (18), Odisha (18), and Madhya Pradesh (10). Weak case-detection methods are cited as a reason for ongoing pediatric cases.

article.articleHeadline: Perchè si studia la peste in Siberia. Quella polmonare è la più aggressiva: sintomi e come si cura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why the plague is studied in Siberia. The pneumonic form is the most aggressive: symptoms and how it is treated.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, persists in natural foci in southern Siberia, with a biosafety level 3 lab in Irkutsk linked to a recent contagion. The bacterium cycles among wild rodents (marmots, voles, and rats) and is transmitted by fleas; Siberia, Mongolia, Central Asian steppes, and northern China host reservoirs. The pneumonic form is the most aggressive and highly transmissible via aerosols, enabling direct human-to-human spread; incubation is typically 24–72 hours. Initial symptoms are abrupt: high fever, severe chills, intense headache, and rapid weakness, followed within hours by lung involvement, productive cough with bloody sputum, chest pain, and respiratory failure. Without early antibiotics (streptomycin, doxycycline, or fluoroquinolones), pneumonic plague is almost always fatal within about 24 hours of symptoms. Isolation is the primary control measure; Russia's Rospotrebnadzor monitors natural reservoirs. A 28-year-old researcher died in Irkutsk from pneumonic plague.
