article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 8,000 confirmed cases this week, with WHO stressing oxygen access and early care. Facing funding pressures, the Africa Leaders Malaria Alliance warns of a 30% cut as vaccination campaigns target children missed by services. Nigeria–Niger coordinate vaccination and surveillance; Uganda outlines a measles–rubella campaign after 66 measles outbreaks in 2025; Ethiopia’s second oral polio campaign reached 1.4 million children (102% coverage). Nigeria–Niger effort reached 94% of target children for polio and routine immunizations. Kenya aims for 50% domestic production by 2030; 13 pharma firms started. Ethiopia strengthens laboratories; Angola and Sierra Leone outline 2026–2030 vaccination priorities (malaria vaccine, HPV) and review vaccines for measles, malaria and pneumococcal. A $1 test screens HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B for pregnant women, with markets in Nigeria, Ethiopia, Uganda, Kenya, Mozambique and South Africa. Ghana conducts Africa CDC hepatitis assessment and launches Pink October for breast cancer.

triage.headline_ja: 週次保健アップデート：ナイジェリアとニジェールがワクチン接種を連携、ウガンダは麻疹対策キャンペーンを準備
triage.triage_reason: DRCのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが8,000例を超え、WHOが酸素供給や早期治療の必要性を強調しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ資金不足による対応能力の懸念もあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国の週次保健トピックをまとめたもので、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（エボラ、8,000例超、資金圧力あり）とGhana（Africa CDCによる肝炎評価、Pink October乳がん啓発）のみ。DRCのエボラ拡大規模が最も重大な懸念事項。ナイジェリア、ニジェール、ウガンダ、エチオピア、ケニア、アンゴラ、シエラレオネ、南アフリカ、モザンビークは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: وزير الخارجية الفرنسيّ في الكونغو الديموقراطية حيث يتفشى إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: French Foreign Minister in the Democratic Republic of the Congo where Ebola is spreading.
article.articleSummary: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Baro arrived in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, at the epicenter of the country’s worst Ebola outbreak in history—the 17th outbreak wave described as the deadliest to date. The visit aims to demonstrate France’s support to local authorities and humanitarian workers combatting the epidemic and to reaffirm Paris’ intent to expand participation with international partners. Baro’s trip is noted as the first European minister visit since the current outbreak began. The report does not provide specific case or death figures. Key details: Ebola virus disease, Bunia/Ituri in eastern DRC, ongoing outbreak with international response and ongoing containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: フランス外相、エボラ出血熱が流行するコンゴ民主共和国を訪問
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける過去最悪とされるエボラ出血熱の第17波流行であり、国際的な支援・関心が高いことからフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数・死亡数を示していないが、過去最悪の流行とされ、フランス外相の訪問など国際的関心の高さが示されている。フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: У Конго тестують препарат, який може запобігати зараженню Еболою
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, a drug is being tested that could prevent Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is testing obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis for Ebola after contact with infected individuals. More than 250 people in Ituri province have enrolled in a Gilead-sponsored trial, which aims to reach nearly 1,000 participants. The study, launched in July in Ituri—the epicenter of the current outbreak—includes adults and children from age 12 who had contact with a confirmed case in the past five days but show no symptoms. In a randomized design, half receive obeldesivir and half receive a placebo, with daily monitoring for 21 days and a follow-up survey at 42 days. If symptoms develop, patients receive supportive care. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved antivirals or vaccines exist. Congo vaccinates health workers with Ervebo, though efficacy against Bundibugyo is still being studied.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ感染を予防できる可能性のある薬剤を試験中
triage.triage_reason: DRC・Ituriで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに関する内容であり、承認された治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないことから公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ治療薬（obeldesivir）の曝露後予防治験に関する内容であり、現在進行中のブンディブギョ株によるエボラアウトブレイク（Ituri州）が背景にある。承認された抗ウイルス薬・ワクチンが存在しないため、既存のアウトブレイクに対するフルリスク評価の継続・更新が必要。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго тестируют препарат, который может предотвращать заражение Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A drug that could prevent Ebola infection is being tested in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) post-exposure prophylaxis trial is underway in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province amid the country’s deadliest outbreak. More than 250 participants, aged 12 and up, who had contact with a confirmed Ebola case within the past five days are enrolled in a randomized, placebo-controlled study of obeldesivir from Gilead, which began in July in Ituri, and aims to enroll about 1,000 participants. Participants receive obeldesivir or placebo and are monitored daily for 21 days, with a 42-day follow-up. If symptoms develop, they receive supportive care. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved antivirals or vaccines exist. Health authorities are vaccinating healthcare workers with Ervebo, though efficacy against Bundibugyo is still being studied. If effective, obeldesivir could help interrupt transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染を予防する可能性のある薬剤の治験が実施中
triage.triage_reason: DRCで「同国史上最も致死的」とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが継続中であり、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンが存在しない状況下での治験実施という公衆衛生上重要な情報であるため、フルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ（イツリ州）における既存のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクを背景にした治験ニュース。アウトブレイク自体が「同国史上最も致死的」と表現されており、承認済み抗ウイルス薬・ワクチンが存在しない点が重大。続報でアウトブレイクの規模・死亡率・国際的対応状況を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: V DR Kongo zaradi izbruha ebole umrlo več kot 4000 ljudi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, an Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000 people.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, officially confirmed mid-May, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain), affecting Ituri province in the northeast and North Kivu in the east. The first infection case attributed to Bundibugyo was recorded in Ituri. Ongoing violence and distrust hinder response: clashes by local militias in Ituri have displaced more than 5,000 people, and an Ebola treatment center was burned; soldiers entered the area, triggering mass exodus. In North Kivu, an attack on a health facility killed a contracted worker responsible for case finding. The United States has offered about $267 million to help contain the outbreak. Containment and prevention efforts rely on vaccines and therapeutics; several candidates for Bundibugyo are under study. In health workers, first doses of the Ervebo vaccine, previously effective against Zaire ebolavirus, have been used in a clinical trial.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行により4000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 死者4000人超の大規模流行で、Bundibugyo株による異常事態、治安悪化による対応困難、米国の大規模支援（2.67億ドル）が行われておりIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行で、治安悪化（民兵衝突、治療センター焼失、医療従事者殺害）が対応を阻害している点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Минздрав ДР Конго заявил о прохождении пика вспышки лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ministry of Health says the peak of the Ebola outbreak has passed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba says the peak has passed, with responders gaining control. Nineteen of 63 health zones have not reported new cases for over three weeks, signaling progress. The outbreak remains severe: 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths, a 48.4% case-fatality rate. Currently 842 patients are under hospital observation. More than half of deaths occur outside hospitals, sustaining transmission through home funerals and caregiving. Began May 15 in the DRC and neighboring Uganda; it has affected 7 of 26 provinces. Uganda’s outbreak was declared over in July by the WHO. This is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in Africa’s history and the 17th outbreak in the DRC since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国保健省、エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクのピークが過ぎたと発表
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%、8,300症例・4,018死亡という深刻な既存エボラアウトブレイクの最新状況報告であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため継続的なフルリスク評価対象とすべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるがWHOにより7月に終息宣言済みで対象国リストにも非該当のため除外。本件は既知の進行中アウトブレイクの続報だが、致死率・死者数の規模からアフリカ史上2番目に深刻な流行とされ、継続的な監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kannauj News: किशनपुर में बुखार का कहर, महिला की मौत से मचा हड़कंप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kannauj News: Fever wreaks havoc in Kishanpur, panic after a woman's death.
article.articleSummary: Fever outbreak in Kishanpur village, Talgram, Kannauj district, Uttar Pradesh, India, with about 100 residents affected. A 55-year-old woman, Ramlali, wife of Siyarama, died after fever in a Kanpur private hospital on Friday; she was treated following referral from Talgram CHC and later medical college in Tirwa. Her death sparked health authorities to act. Reports say many villagers are seeking care in private hospitals or self-medicating at home. Health department teams conducted a camp, screened 56 people and collected 15 blood samples for testing. Preliminary assessments found no malaria-like symptoms among the examined patients. Official case counts or outbreak status not yet released. Infection source remains undetermined; malaria inspector involved. Health officers listed include ACMO Dr. Vijay Kumar Shukla and others; the situation is being monitored with ongoing screening.

triage.headline_ja: カンナウジニュース: キシャンプルで発熱が猛威、女性の死亡でパニック広がる
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州の一村落で原因不明の発熱が発生し1名死亡、約100人に影響が出ているが、マラリア様症状は否定され原因特定前のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 当初マラリア疑いとして報道されたが、予備検査では56名中マラリア様症状は確認されず、感染源は未特定。地元保健当局が血液検体採取・スクリーニングを継続中であり、原因判明まで経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Manipur Governor Calls for Stronger TB Detection in Remote Areas
article.articleSummary: Manipur Governor Ajay Kumar Bhalla called for stronger tuberculosis detection in remote and difficult-to-reach areas, citing that reported indicators may understate true prevalence. At Imphal, he announced intensified case finding as NTPC, a Nikshay Mitra, distributed six months of nutritional baskets to about 1,800 TB patients and their caregivers under its CSR-driven TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan. The governor also handed AI-enabled handheld X-ray machines to health officials to strengthen screening and early detection across districts, urging regular monitoring of use and outcomes. The initiative, supported by NTPC with around Rs 2.9 crore, aims to bolster treatment completion and patient support. NTPC Chairman Gurdeep Singh reaffirmed commitment; Chief Secretary Rajeev Singh Thakur welcomed the partnership. The drive emphasizes coordinated public-private efforts to move toward a TB-free Manipur and India under the National TB Elimination Programme.

triage.headline_ja: マニプール州知事、遠隔地での結核検出強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 結核撲滅に向けた通常の政策的・支援活動の報道であり、異常な公衆衛生上の脅威や緊急性を示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の流行病であり新規異常事象ではない。州政府とNTPCによる検出強化・患者支援の取り組みを伝える通常の保健政策報道。

article.articleHeadline: Cutar Ebola ta hallaka sama da mutane dubu 4 a Congo - Hukumomi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000 people in Congo - Authorities
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 4,018 people and infected 8,103, with 2,162 recoveries, as of October 3, 2026. The outbreak, officially declared in mid-May, began in Ituri province in the northeast and has since spread to seven northern and eastern provinces. Public health teams face setbacks due to ongoing violence and distrust of authorities, hindering containment, contact tracing, and safe burial practices. Transmission remains sustained in conflict-affected areas, complicating vaccination and response efforts and threatening regional public health. The figures reflect reported confirmed cases and outcomes by Congolese authorities, highlighting the challenge of outbreak control amid insecurity and population displacement across multiple regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行、4000人以上が死亡 - 当局発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死者4000人超・感染者8000人超と公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、複数州への拡大と紛争による対応困難からIHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 致死率が約50%と極めて高く、紛争地域での治安悪化により封じ込め・接触者追跡・安全な埋葬が妨げられている。7つの州に拡大しており地域的な公衆衛生上の脅威となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Минздрав ДР Конго сделал оптимистичное заявление о лихорадке Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health of the Democratic Republic of the Congo made an optimistic statement about Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) – Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said in Kinshasa that the peak has passed. Since the May 15 start, 7 of 26 provinces have been affected, with 8,300 cases and 4,018 deaths (case fatality 48.4%). Currently 842 individuals with Ebola symptoms are hospitalized or in isolation. In 19 of 63 health zones, new infections have been absent for at least three weeks. Authorities warn that more than half of deaths occur outside health facilities, raising transmission risks tied to home care and funeral practices; contact tracing is at 80.6%. The outbreak is Africa’s second-highest death toll among observed Ebola outbreaks. Parallel activity in Uganda ended July 28, with the World Health Organization confirming this on August 25. As of 3 October 2026, the situation shows deceleration in new cases but sustained transmission risk remains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国保健省、エボラ出血熱についての楽観的声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,300症例・致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、国際的拡大・重大な公衆衛生影響の懸念があるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの並行発生はWHOにより7月28日終息が確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでは依然として家庭内看護・葬儀慣行による感染リスクが残存している。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : 227 millions USD mobilisés pour le premier plan de riposte contre la MVE17
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: $227 million mobilized for the first response plan against Ebola virus disease (MVE17).
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) under the first response plan MVE17 has mobilized about $227 million, with roughly $99 million still unused by partners, per a Oct 2 Kinshasa press briefing by Health Minister Samuel Kamba. Epidemic indicators show a general decline after the July peak: the national effective reproduction number (Rt) fell from 1.15 on Aug 1 to 0.97, and test positivity dropped while testing volume rose. Of 63 health zones affected, 19 have reached 21 days without a new case, including 11 with no new cases for more than 42 days. Contact tracing improved from ~28% in May to 82% by Sep 28. Transmission remains active in households in Ituri and North Kivu; surveillance and response continue there. Resource management is a priority: out of 97 partners, about 25% have justified resources; accreditation requiring declaration of funds, provenance, and allocation will limit on-site interventions. Next steps: interrupt transmission chains, strengthen surveillance and contact follow-up; ensure resource transparency and accountability.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ出血熱（MVE17）対応のための第一次対応計画に2億2700万ドルが動員
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する進捗報告だが、Ituri・North Kivuで家庭内伝播が継続しており、国際的な資金・支援が引き続き必要とされているため、フルリスク評価での経過確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 既知のエボラアウトブレイク（MVE17）に関する進捗・資金動員報告。全体的な指標（Rt低下、陽性率低下）は改善傾向だが、IturiとNorth Kivuでの家庭内伝播は継続中であり、資源管理（パートナーの25%のみ資金正当化済み）に課題あり。新規発生ではなく継続中の対応計画のアップデート記事。

article.articleHeadline: У Конго випробовують препарат, який може запобігати зараженню Еболою
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, a drug that could prevent Ebola infection is being tested.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the EBO-PEP post-exposure prophylaxis trial tests obeldesivir to prevent Ebola after exposure. In eastern Ituri Province, where the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is centered, over 250 people have enrolled of a planned ~1,000 participants aged 12 and up who had contact with a confirmed case within the last five days but are asymptomatic. Participants are randomized to receive obeldesivir or placebo, with daily monitoring for 21 days and a 42-day final survey. If effective, the drug could be used to prevent disease after exposure and interrupt transmission chains. There are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo virus; health workers are vaccinated with Ervebo, which has shown efficacy in outbreaks caused by other strains. Practical challenges include long travel distances to centers and dropout after relatives’ deaths from Ebola; the trial began in July in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染を予防できる可能性のある薬剤の治験が実施されている
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で進行中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行に関する事後曝露予防薬の治験であり、Ebolaという重篤な感染症の国際的に懸念される継続事例であるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスの既存流行に対する治験(obeldesivir）に関する続報であり、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が懸念材料。新規発生ではなく既知の流行拡大・対応状況の更新情報である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Testira se eksperimentalni lek protiv najteže epidemije: Ovo su detalji
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An experimental drug is being tested against the worst epidemic: Here are the details.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is grappling with the worst Ebola epidemic caused by Bundibugyo virus, with more than 8,300 cases and about 4,000 deaths since mid-May, spanning seven provinces and outpacing response efforts. An experimental antiviral, obeldesivir from Gilead, is being tested as post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) in the EBO-PEP trial coordinated by ALIMA. The study aims to enroll around 1,000 adults and children over 12 who had contact with a confirmed case within the previous five days but are not yet symptomatic; half receive placebo. Participants are followed daily for 21 days, with a final 42-day contact. If effective, the drug could help interrupt transmission by protecting exposed individuals before symptoms appear, differing from vaccines or treatments that target ill patients. The trial involves Congo's National Institute for Biomedical Research and the ANRS, while Ervebo vaccination is used for health workers with uncertain cross-protection.

triage.headline_ja: 最悪の感染症に対する実験的治療薬が試験中：詳細はこちら
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でBundibugyoウイルスによる過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（8,300例以上、死亡約4,000人、7州に拡大）が継続しており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と推定され、対応能力を上回る規模。実験的治療薬の国際治験が進行中であり、国際的な支援・関心が高い案件。

article.articleHeadline: Russische laborante (28) overlijdt nadat reageerbuis met pestbacteriën breekt, 200 mensen in quarantaine | VRT NWS Nieuws
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian lab technician (28) dies after a test tube containing plague bacteria breaks, 200 people in quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Plague (Yersinia pestis) incident: A Russian lab technician, 28, died after a test tube containing plague bacteria broke, prompting quarantine for about 200 people. Historically, plague spread via ships to the Mediterranean and rapidly across Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa, killing an estimated 75–200 million people between 1347 and 1353 and marking the start of a roughly 500-year epidemic. Early symptoms included swollen lymph nodes and black spots, with deaths typically within three days of onset. In the modern era, about 1,000 plague infections are reported worldwide each year, with ongoing cases in Madagascar and the Democratic Republic of Congo, largely in remote areas. A notable 2017 Madagascar outbreak extended to the capital, causing hundreds of fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの検査技師（28歳）、ペスト菌の入った試験管が破損して死亡、200人が検疫隔離
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの研究室での単発的な事故による感染であり、対象国（DRC等）は過去の流行地として背景説明に触れられているだけで、本事例の発生地ではない。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも低く、対象地域に関連するシグナルとはならない。
triage.notes: 本事例はロシアの研究室での事故によるペスト菌暴露であり、対象国リストに含まれる地域（DRC等）は過去・現在の流行地としての一般的な背景情報としてのみ言及されている。実際の発生地はロシアであり対象国外のため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго пройден пик вспышки лихорадки Эбола - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, the peak of the Ebola outbreak has passed.
article.articleSummary: Peak of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has passed, Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba told RFI. As of 3 October 2026, the ministry says the epidemic is now under control, with 19 of 63 health zones reporting no new Ebola fever cases for at least three weeks. Total figures cited: 8,300 infections and 4,018 deaths. The outbreak began in late spring in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The government notes it can act proactively rather than merely monitor progression. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor has tightened sanitary-quarantine controls at border checkpoints, reflecting heightened precaution for imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱流行のピークを越える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%に達する大規模エボラ流行（感染8,300人・死亡4,018人）で、ウガンダへの拡大やロシアの国境検疫強化など国際的影響が確認されるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダやロシアも発生地域として挙げられているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの流行状況であり、ウガンダは対象国リスト外、ロシアは国境管理強化のみで発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Chuva e calor podem favorecer a proliferação do Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain and heat may favor the proliferation of Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: 2026-10-03: São Carlos, Brazil, faces increased risk of Aedes aegypti proliferation as above-average temperatures and rainfall are forecast, potentially boosting transmission of Dengue, Zika, Chikungunya, and Yellow Fever in the DRS-Araraquara region. SES-SP directs the Municipal Health Secretariat to strengthen surveillance and prevention. El Niño projections indicate a greater than 90% probability of very strong intensity by November, with heat nationwide and above-average rainfall in parts of Sao Paulo. Despite the warning, Dengue cases in 2026 remain markedly low—up to week 38, 432 cases versus 20,429 in 2025, a 97.9% reduction. Authorities will monitor weekly indicators and can expand measures; Ovitrampas and Wolbachia deployment are planned. Community participation is essential since most breeding sites are inside or around homes. Prevention emphasizes eliminating water-holding containers, weekly home checks, closed reservoirs, clean gutters, bottles stored upright, tires and other containers disposed, and weekly water changes for aquatic plants. Dengue symptoms include fever above 38 C with headache, body pains, retro-orbital pain, and rash; seek care for alarm signs.

triage.headline_ja: 雨と暑さがネッタイシマカの繁殖を助長する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 気象条件に基づく予防的な注意喚起であり、デング熱症例は前年比97.9%減少しており、異常な流行や重篤な公衆衛生上の懸念は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的・気象要因によるベクター媒介感染症リスクへの予防的注意喚起であり、実際の症例数は大幅減少（432件 vs 20,429件）。地方保健当局による通常のサーベイランス強化の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Минздрав ДР Конго: Пик эпидемии Эболы уже позади
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC Ministry of Health: The Ebola epidemic peak is already behind us
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports the Ebola virus disease outbreak is now under control, with the peak behind us. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said authorities are acting proactively rather than just monitoring. In 19 of 63 health zones where Ebola patients have been identified, new hemorrhagic fever cases have not been registered for at least three weeks. As of the latest Ministry data, Ebola deaths total 4,018 with 8,300 cases, a case fatality rate of 48.4%. Hospital and medical isolation facilities currently house 842 patients with Ebola symptoms. The briefing provides no details on imported or exported cases. These figures suggest a turning point in the outbreak and indicate a sustained decline in transmission since the peak, as of 3 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRC保健省:エボラ出血熱の流行はピークを過ぎた
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱流行は累計8,300例・死亡4,018例、致死率48.4%と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRC保健省による公式発表で、ピークは過ぎたとされるが依然842人が入院中であり、感染流行は継続中。輸入・輸出症例についての詳細は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: У Конгу тестирају експериментални лек против најтеже епидемије еболе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Congo, an experimental drug is being tested against the worst Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo faces an Ebola outbreak with at least 8,300 cases and about 4,000 deaths across seven provinces. An experimental antiviral, obeldesivir, is being tested as post-exposure prophylaxis in the EBO-PEP trial, led by ALIMA, aiming to enroll roughly 1,000 asymptomatic contacts aged 12+ who had exposure within the past five days; half will receive placebo. Participants are followed daily for 21 days, with a final 42-day check; those who develop symptoms receive supportive therapy. If effective, the drug could interrupt transmission sooner than vaccines. The study partners include Congo's National Institute for Biomedical Research and France's ANRS for Emerging Infectious Diseases. Congo is also vaccinating health workers with Ervebo, which may offer protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, though further study is needed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで、エボラ出血熱の最悪の流行に対する実験的治療薬の試験が行われている
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,300例・4,000人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が7州に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: フランスは治験パートナー（ANRS）としての関与のみで、発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。致死率が高く(約48%)、国際的な治験・支援が進行中であり、継続的な監視と評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola : Jean-Noël Barrot appelle à maintenir la vigilance à Bunia - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response: Jean-Noël Barrot calls for continued vigilance in Bunia - LePotentiel.
article.articleSummary: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot visited Bunia, Ituri Province, DR Congo, on 3 October 2026 to urge continued vigilance against Ebola amid the 17th outbreak recorded in the country. He reiterated France’s support to Congolese authorities, UN agencies, humanitarian partners, and health workers as officials pursue containment and prevent a resurgence of virus transmission in the East. Barrot highlighted the need to sustain prevention measures and address factors driving spread. The visit signals international backing as authorities in Ituri strive to curb the outbreak amid health, humanitarian, and security challenges. France has allocated about €13.4 million to Ebola response from January–July 2026 and plans to propose further humanitarian funding increases during forthcoming budget discussions to strengthen ongoing efforts to eradicate Ebola in East DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応：ジャン=ノエル・バロ外相、ブニアでの警戒継続を呼びかけ - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける第17次エボラアウトブレイクに関する継続中の対応状況であり、国際的関心・支援が明確に示されているため、重症度や拡大リスクの観点からフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: フランスはエボラ対応支援として2026年1-7月に約1340万ユーロを拠出済みで、追加の人道支援資金増額を検討中。第17次アウトブレイクであることから既知の疾患だが、再燃防止と封じ込めが課題として継続している。

article.articleHeadline: João Pessoa intensifica combate ao Aedes aegypti diante de riscos climáticos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: João Pessoa intensifies the fight against Aedes aegypti in the face of climate risks.
article.articleSummary: João Pessoa, Paraíba, Brazil, is intensifying the fight against Aedes aegypti amid El Niño–driven heat and irregular rainfall, placing the coastal city on maximum alert for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission. The Municipal Health Secretariat expanded vector surveillance and control across the capital, emphasizing integrated, intersectoral action. Environmental Surveillance prioritizes health education in schools, from creches to universities, turning students into community multipliers who identify and eliminate standing water. Field operations are supported by Primary Health Care teams and Community Health Agents who map risk areas and potential containers. When suspected or confirmed cases are notified, teams conduct searches around the patient’s home and workplace to interrupt transmission. Cooperation with Emlur and Seinfra addresses vacant lots and abandoned properties. Residents should seal water tanks, remove tires and bottles, and keep gutters clean. Reports: (83) 3213-7781/7782; Disk Dengue 98825-0549.

triage.headline_ja: ジョアン・ペソア市、気候変動リスクに直面しネッタイシマカ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の自治体レベルの予防的ベクター対策活動を報じる内容であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増を示す情報はなく、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性・気候要因によるデング熱等の媒介蚊対策の通常業務を報じたもので、具体的な症例数や死亡者数の急増、異常なクラスターの情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: У ДР Конго тестують препарат, що може запобігати Еболі після контакту з хворим
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, a drug is being tested that could prevent Ebola after exposure to an infected person.
article.articleSummary: Obeldesivir is being tested in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as post-exposure prophylaxis against Ebola caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Over 250 volunteers have enrolled, with a goal of about 1,000 participants including healthcare workers and relatives of confirmed cases. The trial began in July and enrolls adults and children aged 12+ who had contact with a confirmed case within the prior five days but are asymptomatic. Participants are randomized 1:1 to receive Obeldesivir or placebo, with daily monitoring for 21 days and a follow-up at 42 days. If symptoms develop, supportive care is provided. Researchers hope effective prophylaxis could interrupt transmission chains if proven. Context includes WHO warnings of significant bed shortages for Ebola patients in DR Congo. Ebola spreads via direct contact and body fluids, causing fever, diarrhea, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で、エボラ感染者との接触後の発症を防ぐ可能性のある薬剤の治験が行われている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の継続的な流行を背景に、WHOが病床不足を警告しており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的関心の高い事案であるためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は治験に関する内容だが、背景としてエボラ流行とWHOによる病床不足警告が言及されており、エボラ自体は国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であるためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Gov't doctor urges HIV screening as recorded cases surge
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-03, 232 HIV cases have been confirmed since 2022, with 92 currently on treatment at Amai Pakpak Medical Center (APMC) AIDS treatment hub in Iligan City, Marawi City, Lanao del Sur. APMC, a government-run facility, resumed HIV services in 2022 after a temporary suspension. At-risk individuals are encouraged to undergo screening; testing involves a blood sample and is preceded by counseling, with privacy protections and no requirement to line up for medicines. Some patients are referred from outside Lanao del Sur, including Metro Manila. Among the 232 cases, 64 were students; most patients are aged 20–29, with 12 under 20 and the youngest 15. Most confirmed cases involve men who have sex with men; pregnant women are encouraged to test to prevent mother-to-child transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 政府医師、HIV症例の急増を受けて検査を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、地域的な症例増加の報告に留まる。急性の公衆衛生危機や国際的拡大のリスクは認められず、通常の保健医療対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: HIVは性感染症として継続的な公衆衛生課題であり、Bluedotの急性感染症イベント探知の枠組みでは通常シグナルとして扱わない。地域の医療機関による啓発・検査推奨の記事であり、緊急対応を要する事案ではない。

article.articleHeadline: فرنسا تتعهد بتعزيز دعمها لمكافحة تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France pledges to bolster its support in the fight against the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, Ebola remains a major outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 8,376 confirmed infections since 15 May and more than 4,000 deaths, according to Congolese health authorities. The epicenter includes Bunia in Ituri Province. France's Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot visited Bunia and announced Paris will propose additional humanitarian funding for the Ebola response in the upcoming French budget discussions. France had previously allocated €13.4 million for Ebola control in DRC from January to July this year. Barrot warned of a possible resurgence and emphasized the need to prevent new waves of transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行対策支援強化を表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,376例・4,000人超の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、国際社会（フランス）が支援を表明するなど社会的・政治的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模流行の継続報道であり、フランスによる支援表明が主題。フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية: نويل بارو يزور منطقة تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo: Noel Baro visits the Ebola outbreak area.
article.articleSummary: On 3 October 2026, French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barro toured Ituri Province in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epicenter of the most deadly Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. The current wave—the seventeenth—has infected about 8,300 people, with 4,018 deaths and 2,162 recoveries, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.4%. Barro visited Bunia, Ituri’s capital, the first European minister to visit since the outbreak began, to assess Ebola treatment centers, their equipment, and surveillance capabilities, and to hear briefings from center managers. France has allocated 13.4 million euros from January through July to aid the response, supporting local authorities and humanitarian workers as the outbreak has spread from Ituri to seven provinces. The article notes the outbreak’s persistence and ongoing international collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ノエル・バロ氏がエボラ流行地域を訪問
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（第17波、感染者約8,300人、死者4,018人、致死率48.4%）が7州に拡大し、国際的な外交・支援対応が行われているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: フランス外相の訪問はDRCへの国際支援・関心の表れであり、フランス自体は感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Norovirus On Prowl; Hosps, OPDs Start Getting Cases
article.articleSummary: Norovirus outbreaks are spreading in Kolkata, with cases reported in at least three hospitals and many OPD patients presenting with dehydration, vomiting, severe gastroenteritis, abdominal cramps and weakness. Norovirus typically causes rapid onset of symptoms within 12–48 hours after exposure and is highly contagious, often spreading via food; outbreaks historically peak in winter. Manipal Hospital Dhakuria has admitted four patients in two weeks, including two in ICU for severe dehydration and kidney involvement; all recovered after IV fluids. BP Poddar Hospital has three admissions and about 47 OPD visits with similar presentations; two elderly patients required IV fluid correction, and pre-existing renal impairment may worsen outcomes. Peerless Hospital has treated 12 norovirus patients, including two children; Charnock Hospital reported several such patients over the last week, with two–three admissions featuring diarrhea, high fever, dehydration and influenza-like symptoms. Ongoing spread across the city underscores need for infection control.

triage.headline_ja: ノロウイルスが蔓延中：病院・外来で患者増加
triage.triage_reason: コルカタ市内の複数病院でノロウイルス感染症例が増加し重症例（ICU入院）も見られるが、季節性の既知感染症で国際的拡大リスクは低く、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: ノロウイルスは季節性で既知の感染症であり、冬季にピークを迎えることが記事内でも言及されている。複数病院からの報告があり市内で拡大傾向だが、現時点では地域内の公衆衛生対応で管理可能とみられる。続報（症例数の推移、原因食品の特定など）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : lancement d'un tournoi de paix pour renforcer la cohésion et sensibiliser contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Launch of a Peace Tournament to Strengthen Cohesion and Raise Awareness About Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Officially launched on October 3, 2026 in Kisangani, a Peace Tournament in Tshopo aims to strengthen social cohesion and raise awareness about Ebola Virus Disease (EVD). The football event unites youth while reinforcing ongoing public health messaging amid the Ebola response. Governor Paulin Lendongolia Lebabonga urged participants and spectators to act responsibly and strictly observe preventive measures to protect themselves and others. Officials view football as a vehicle for health education and for promoting unity across Kisangani’s communities. The initiative comes as Ebola control efforts continue in Tshopo, with authorities urging residents to stay vigilant and follow sanitary recommendations to limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：結束強化とエボラ啓発のための平和トーナメント開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラ対応の一環として実施された啓発目的のサッカー大会についての報道であり、新規感染拡大や異常事態の発生を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はチョポ州（キサンガニ）での既存のエボラ対応活動に関連する啓発イベントについてのもので、新規症例数や感染拡大に関する具体的情報は記載されていない。エボラ対応自体が継続中であることを示す背景情報として参考程度。

article.articleHeadline: كيف قاد البعوض العلماء إلى اكتشاف سر الملاريا؟ | مصراوي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How the mosquito led scientists to uncover the secret of malaria? | Masrawy
article.articleSummary: Malaria, caused by Plasmodium and transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes, is reframed from a solely clinical disease to a public-health and urban-environment issue. The discovery that Anopheles mosquitoes carry the parasite shifted disease control from treating patients to reducing mosquito breeding by targeting stagnant water, drainage, sanitation, and housing design. As reported in The Hindu (India) and summarized by Masrawy, the focus expanded beyond hospitals to vector-control programs and city planning in malaria-endemic regions, underscoring the need to consider human environments in prevention. The narrative highlights collaboration among medicine, engineering, and public health to suppress transmission through protective measures inside homes, community surveillance of water accumulation, and environmental management. Ongoing malaria control today still relies on diagnosis, treatment, bite protection, vector control, and environmental improvements in high-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊はいかにして科学者たちをマラリアの秘密の発見へと導いたか | Masrawy
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例や異常な流行を報じるものではなく、マラリア媒介蚊の発見史と環境管理による予防策を解説する一般的・教育的な記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は歴史的・科学的解説記事であり、特定の国での具体的な発生・流行報告ではないため、インドが言及されているが地理的発生事象としては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Више од 250 људи у испитивању лека који би могао да спречи еболу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 250 people in a drug trial that could prevent Ebola.
article.articleSummary: More than 250 people are enrolled in a clinical trial of obeldesivir, an experimental antiviral from Gilead, to prevent Ebola among individuals recently exposed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s current outbreak. The EBO-PEP trial, coordinated by ALIMA, began in July and aims to enroll about 1,000 adults and children over 12 who had contact with a confirmed case within five days but are asymptomatic. The drug is administered as post-exposure prophylaxis; participants are randomized to receive obeldesivir or placebo and followed daily for 21 days, with a final contact at 42 days. If symptoms develop, supportive therapy is provided. The study, conducted in Ituri Province, includes health workers and relatives of patients. Ervebo vaccination is being offered to health workers, though its protection against Bundibugyo remains under investigation. As of Sept 14, 204 participants had been enrolled; recruitment continues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱を予防できる可能性のある薬剤の治験に250人以上が参加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）に関連し、曝露後予防薬の治験が進行中であることが報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 本記事はイトゥリ州における既存のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）に対する曝露後予防薬（obeldesivir）の治験進捗報告であり、新規シグナルというより既知のアウトブレイクの継続的動向として扱うべき。ただしエボラの性質上、重症度・国際的懸念は高く、フルリスク評価の対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : sept écoles dotées en équipements de prévention - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: Seven Schools Equipped with Infection-Prevention Equipment - ACP
article.articleSummary: On Oct 3, 2026, seven schools in Bunia, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, were equipped with Ebola infection-prevention tools: ten handwashing basins, ten bars of soap, and one thermoflash per school. Beneficiary sites include CS Bamuhiga, Institut Kabarole, EP Efata, EP Saïo Mohammed, Institut Saïo Mohammed, and Complexe Anerose. Local councilor Olivier Nguna reported a field assessment found high student numbers—500 to 1,000 per school—and insufficient facilities, prompting the distribution. Early observations show improved handwashing access before classes. The initiative emphasizes ongoing sensitization in schools and communities; funding remains limited, with appeals for support from NGOs, government, and response teams to expand to additional schools and Ituri communities.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでのエボラ対策：学校7校に予防用資機材を配備
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く公衆衛生上の影響が大きい疾患であり、学校における予防対策の継続的実施と資金不足・外部支援要請が示されているため、進行中のアウトブレイク対応としてフルリスク評価への移行を検討する。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例報告ではなく、既存のエボラ流行下での学校向け予防資機材配布に関する内容。資金不足とNGO・政府・対応チームへの支援要請が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: У Конго тестують новий препарат проти Еболи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new drug is being tested in Congo against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, more than 250 people have enrolled in a trial of obeldesivir to prevent Ebola after exposure. The study, launched in July in Ituri Province amid the current Bundibugyo outbreak, aims to enroll about 1,000 participants, including healthcare workers and relatives of infected individuals. Adults and children aged 12 and older who have five days of contact with a confirmed case but are asymptomatic receive obeldesivir; half are randomized to placebo. Participants are followed daily for 21 days. Researchers hope the antiviral could interrupt transmission chains if effective. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved specific therapies or vaccines exist; Ervebo is used to vaccinate frontline workers, though its effectiveness against this strain is under study. More than 3,000 deaths have occurred, and Congo has received over 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱に対する新薬の治験が行われている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（死者3000人超）に関する治験報告であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は新規治療薬(obeldesivir)の治験に関する内容だが、背景にあるブンディブギョ株エボラアウトブレイクは既に大規模（死者3000人超）であり、継続的なモニタリングが必要。既存のRRA対象イベントの可能性が高く、重複確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго тестируют новый препарат против Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, a new drug to treat Ebola is being tested.
article.articleSummary: Over 250 people in the Democratic Republic of Congo have joined a trial of obeldesivir, an experimental post-exposure prophylaxis intended to prevent Ebola after contact with an infected person. Initiated in July in Ituri province amid the ongoing outbreak, the study aims to enroll about 1,000 participants, including healthcare workers and relatives of patients. Adults and children aged 12 and older who had contact within five days with a confirmed case but are asymptomatic receive either obeldesivir or placebo for 21 days, with daily monitoring. Researchers hope the drug can interrupt transmission chains if effective. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no specific drugs or vaccines are approved; Ervebo is used for vaccination but its effectiveness against this strain is still being studied. More than 3,000 deaths have been reported in Congo’s largest Ebola outbreak; Congo has received over 16,000 vaccine doses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱治療のための新薬が試験されている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（死者3000人超）が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はEbola治療薬（obeldesivir）の臨床試験に関する続報だが、背景にあるコンゴ・イトゥリ州でのエボラ・ブンディブギョ株による大規模アウトブレイク（死者3000人超）自体が重大な公衆衛生事象であるためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Explodes in Africa Much Faster Than Infamous 2010s Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with 8,000+ confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths (case fatality rate 48%). The outbreak is the second-largest on record, expanding at a pace rivaling the West Africa crisis of the early 2010s. The May start surpassed 1,000 confirmed cases within 40 days, much faster than the 2018 DRC outbreak (235 days). The U.S. has committed over $1 billion for response, with more than 500 CDC staff (over 120 deployed) handling surveillance, contact tracing, testing, infection prevention, border health, clinical guidance, and community engagement. From May 21–Sept 21, CDC screened over 15,000 travelers at Dulles, JFK, and Atlanta under Title 42, due to a 21-day incubation. Gavi funds ~US$50M for experimental vaccines; the BRAVO study involved 20,000 frontline doctors with Ervebo, and 70,000 Ervebo doses were delegated to Congolese authorities, though effectiveness against Bundibugyo is unproven.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、2010年代の悪名高い流行よりも急速にアフリカで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が8,000人超の症例・CFR48%に達し、史上2番目の規模で急速拡大中。IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当し、米国も渡航者スクリーニングを実施するなど国際的関心・対応が顕在化している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGeorgia州、Virginia州、Atlanta、Dulles、New York、United States、Angolaが含まれているが、これらは渡航者スクリーニングや資金拠出の文脈であり、実際の感染発生地はDRCのみ。Angolaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de chikungunya disparam no país e exigem prevenção contra o Aedes aegypti | Portal Band
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya cases surge nationwide and call for prevention against Aedes aegypti | Portal Band
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, chikungunya in Bahia has surged 365% this year, quadrupling; nationwide, Brazil reports over 66,000 probable chikungunya infections per the Ministry of Health. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti. The outlook worsens with the anticipated super El Niño in the second half of the year, causing alternating heavy rainfall and intense sun that promote standing water and litter, facilitating vector proliferation. Infectious disease specialist Claudilson Bastos warns El Niño may also aid urban mosquito invasion amid deforestation. The Health Ministry notes potential rises in other Aedes-borne arboviruses, including dengue and Zika. A new preventive front includes a pilot vaccination campaign in about ten priority cities across São Paulo, Sergipe, Ceará and Minas Gerais, with roughly 48,000 doses in the initial phase. Ongoing prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water and regular use of repellents to guard against chikungunya, dengue, and Zika.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル全土でチクングンヤ熱の症例が急増、ネッタイシマカへの対策が急務に | Portal Band
triage.triage_reason: バイーア州で365%増、全国で6万6千件超のチクングンヤ疑い例が報告され、エルニーニョによる媒介蚊増殖の懸念もあり、流行性・持続曝露の観点から社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内（バイーア州、サンパウロ州、セルジペ州、セアラ州等）に限定した報道で、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は見られない。デング熱・ジカ熱も同時流行の懸念があるが、本記事の主題はチクングンヤ熱の国内急増。

article.articleHeadline: فرنسا تعزز دعمها لمكافحة إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: France steps up its support for the fight against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: France pledges additional humanitarian funding to Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as infections surge in the east. Visiting Bunia in Ituri Province, Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said Paris will provide further humanitarian financing for Ebola control, to be considered in the forthcoming French budget. Since the outbreak began on 15 May, DRC health authorities report 8,376 Ebola cases and over 4,000 deaths, underscoring the severe regional impact. France has previously allocated €13.4 million between January and July 2026 for Ebola response. Barrot warned that resurgence is possible and emphasized the urgent need to prevent new waves. The new French support aims to bolster efforts to contain the outbreak and save lives in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ対策への支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行は8,376症例・4,000人以上の死者という重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際支援（フランスの資金提供）も行われていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: フランスは資金提供国であり発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。既存の大規模エボラ流行（5月15日発生、致死率約48%）に対する国際支援の継続・強化を示す記事。

article.articleHeadline: Vet team formed to treat LSD-hit cattle in Hisar facility
article.articleSummary: Lumpy skin disease (LSD) has prompted containment in Hisar, where a six-member veterinary team was formed to examine and treat cattle at a temporary isolation centre near Radha Swami Ashram on Kamry Road. The team, comprising Dr Naveen, Dr Sanjay, Dr Meetu, Dr Balwant, Dr Gurmel and Dr Anoop, would visit the centre every morning and evening for the next seven days and collect samples for testing. The facility houses 23 LSD-infected cattle, of which seven have died, according to the deputy director of animal husbandry. Operators were advised not to bring more LSD-infected animals from other locations, and livestock owners were urged to vaccinate unvaccinated cattle and avoid damp surroundings. Mosquito nets and smoke-based mosquito control are recommended during morning and evening hours. Owners should report symptoms promptly and avoid moving infected cattle. Organisers say the facility still requires medicines, green fodder, jaggery, turmeric powder, ajwain, desi ghee and porridge, and seek support to construct a shed.

triage.headline_ja: ヒサールの施設でLSD感染牛を治療するため獣医チームが結成される
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病は牛のみに影響する動物疾病であり、ヒト感染リスクがなく公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。地域的な家畜対応事案として既に対応が進んでいる。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病はヒトに感染しない牛の感染症であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての優先度は低い。農業・畜産分野の問題として対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en la RDC supera las 4 mil muertes: qué se sabe del virus y por qué este brote preocupa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC has surpassed 4,000 deaths: what is known about the virus and why this outbreak is worrying.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is caused by Bundibugyo virus, with 8,300 confirmed cases and 4,018 deaths (case fatality ~48.4%), surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. Declared May 15, 2026 in Ituri province after Bundibugyo virus disease cases were identified, initially in Mongbwalu. By Sept 25, transmission had spread to 63 health zones across seven provinces: Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud-Ubangi and Tshopo. WHO notes the surge amid insecurity, displacement, and limited health access. Bundibugyo, a less-studied Orthoebolavirus, has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; current response is supportive care. As of Sept 23, WHO reported 7,890 cases and 3,799 deaths. Vaccines like Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus) are being explored in trials for potential cross-protection, but efficacy against Bundibugyo is unproven. Transmission requires contact with infected bodily fluids; early symptoms mimic malaria, typhoid, and meningitis; lab confirmation is essential.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ、死者4000人超:このウイルスについて知られていること、今回の流行が懸念される理由
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行で、8,300例・4,018人死亡、致死率約48%、7州63保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認・治療法未確立のブンディブギョ株による大規模流行であり、治安不安・住民避難・医療アクセス制限が感染拡大を助長している点がWHOにより指摘されている。既存ワクチン(Ervebo)の交差防御効果は未確認。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Trial Tests Ebola Prevention Pill Among High-Risk Contacts
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ituri province (Rwampara) hosts the EBO-PEP trial evaluating obeldesivir, an oral antiviral by Gilead, as post-exposure prophylaxis against Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of Oct 3, 2026, more than 250 participants have enrolled; first participant on July 16; a Sept 18 update counted over 200. The study aims to enroll nearly 1,000 adults and children over 12 who had high-risk contact with a confirmed case within five days and are asymptomatic. In a randomized design, about half receive a placebo; the other half receive obeldesivir to determine if infection can be prevented after exposure. Participants are followed daily for 21 days, with a final visit at 42 days. Coordinating sponsor ALIMA and co-sponsor ANRS Emerging Infectious Diseases note the trial amid pressures on Congo’s Ebola care capacity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ予防薬の治験、高リスク接触者を対象に実施
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で継続中のエボラ（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）アウトブレイクに対する曝露後予防薬治験の報告であり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）の複数該当とWPRO基準の多数該当により、進行中のアウトブレイクの深刻度を踏まえフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに対する治験（EBO-PEP試験、Gilead社の obeldesivir）の進捗報告であり、新規感染拡大の一次報告ではない。発生地域にルワンダ（Kigali Province）が含まれるが、記事サマリーには言及がなく、現時点ではDRC（イツリ州）のみを確認地域とした。続報でルワンダへの拡大有無を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Pneumonic plague outbreak warning over suspected death of lab worker, 28, triggering anti-epidemic measures
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague suspected after 28-year-old Daria Shipilova, a lab technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute in Siberia, dies in Shelekhov near Irkutsk on Oct 2. Authorities deploy full anti-epidemic measures. 197 potential contacts identified; 189 hospitalised for observation and preventive measures. Shelekhov hospital placed under quarantine; lab tests suspended; no new admissions or discharges. The death is attributed to pneumonic plague, a form that infects the lungs and can spread via respiratory droplets; rapid progression can be fatal. Possible infection sources under investigation: a broken test tube containing plague pathogen in the lab, per local media, or exposure after returning from Thailand, per other reports. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and is typically treatable with antibiotics if detected early.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペスト流行警戒:28歳の検査技師の死亡疑いを受け、ロシアで防疫措置発動
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員が肺ペストで死亡した疑いがあり、189人が入院観察下に置かれ病院が隔離されるなど、重大な公衆衛生対応が取られているため。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイは感染源の可能性として言及されているが、実際の発生地・死亡例はロシア国内であるため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola Salgınında Can Kaybı 4 Bini Aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from the Ebola outbreak in Congo surpasses 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) reaches 4,018 with 8,300 confirmed cases and over 2,000 recoveries as of October 2, 2026. The outbreak remains active across North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Ituri, Tshopo, and South Ubangi, though WHO reported a decline in Ituri last month. North Kivu accounted for about 40% of new cases in September, up from 24% at end-August, with new focal points complicating control. One MSF staff member tested positive and traveled to the Netherlands for treatment. No approved therapy exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, though WHO vaccine development continues and an August-targeted vaccination program for health workers has begun. Conflict, poor roads, and damaged infrastructure, plus mistrust and armed-group clashes, hinder access and response. Background: 2018–2020 Congo outbreak caused 2,299 deaths; 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak infected >28,600 with >11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行、死者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は死者4,018人・感染者8,300人超に達し、複数州に拡大、MSF職員の国際移動による越境感染リスクも発生しており、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にNetherlandsとAngolaが含まれるが、記事の主題はDRC国内の流行拡大であり、オランダはMSF職員の治療目的の渡航先、アンゴラは明記なしのためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Trichy corporation to create door-to-door dengue awareness
article.articleSummary: Trichy corporation organized an advisory meeting to train mosquito control workers and raise public awareness about dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases ahead of the northeast monsoon. District epidemiologist Dr P Mathivanan and district malaria officer Dr P Murugesan led the training, stressing intensified fever surveillance, preventive measures, and special attention to vacant plots, locked houses, and construction sites. Workers will conduct door-to-door visits of homes, commercial complexes, and construction sites to identify and destroy breeding sources such as containers, tyres, and coconut shells. Larvicides will be sprayed in water bodies, and fogging operations intensified on a rotational basis. The program also prioritizes preventing scrub typhus and leptospirosis. Prizes were distributed to top-performing mosquito control workers. The meeting was chaired by city health officer Dr M Karthikeyan.

triage.headline_ja: Trichy市、デング熱に関する戸別啓発活動を実施へ
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン前の通常の蚊媒介性疾患対策・啓発活動に関する記事であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性の予防的啓発活動であり、具体的な症例数や異常な増加の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Timely treatment key to TB-Mukt Bharat: Experts - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: At the 81st NATCON 2026 in Patiala, Government Medical College, leading Indian TB and chest-disease specialists urged early diagnosis, newer medicines, and precision-based care to achieve a TB-Mukt Bharat. Delegates from AIIMS New Delhi, PGIMER Chandigarh, and PGIMS Rohtak highlighted advances in TB testing/management and interstitial lung diseases (ILD) diagnostics, stressing prompt treatment and tackling drug-resistant TB. Public awareness was emphasized; individuals with persistent cough, prolonged fever, or unexplained weight loss should seek evaluation promptly. Notable experts included Rohit Bhatia (AIIMS), and pulmonologists Ashutosh N Aggarwal, Sahajal Dhooria (PGIMER), and Dhruva Chaudhary (PGIMS Rohtak). Three senior doctors—Ajith Kumar, Uma Devi, and Rohit Bhatia—were honored with orations. Dr Bhatia spoke on tubercular meningitis, calling for regimen reviews to reduce mortality and long-term complications, alongside broader improvements in early TB detection and patient care.

triage.headline_ja: TB-Mukt Bharat実現の鍵は迅速な治療：専門家らが指摘
triage.triage_reason: 学会（NATCON 2026）における専門家の啓発的発言であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象の報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は結核対策に関する学会発表の内容であり、新規発生や異常事象の報告ではないためDISMISSと判定。結核は既知の流行病であり地域特定の緊急性もない。
