article.articleHeadline: Fever Turns the Tables on Sleeping Sickness Parasites, Study Finds
article.articleSummary: Trypanosoma brucei, the parasite behind African sleeping sickness, is sensitive to fever; in C57BL/6J mice, parasitaemia rises around day 3 post-infection, with fever (days 4–5) coinciding with the rise of the short, transmission-ready stumpy form. Stumpy cells peak at ~75% of parasites, then collapse by day 7 as temperatures normalize. In vitro, stumpy cells survive at tsetse-mimicking 27°C but die rapidly at 39°C; slender forms tolerate heat better. Fever dramatically enhances clearance when combined with antibodies: day-21 plasma plus heat eradicates >99.5% of stumpy cells within 24 h, versus 15–18% survival with either alone. Heat triggers apoptosis-like events via mitochondrial pathways, including upregulation of Metacasp-3, mitochondrial damage, and oxidative stress; >43% show mitochondrial perturbation after 24 h at 37°C, rising to >95% at 39°C. The work, from Sun Yat-sen University and University of Salford, refines view of host fever as a driver of remission during early infection.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱が眠り病の寄生虫に逆転を仕掛ける、研究で判明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマウスモデルを用いた基礎研究（発熱とトリパノソーマ原虫の相互作用メカニズム）の紹介であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク事例ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は中山大学とサルフォード大学による基礎研究の内容紹介であり、実際の感染症発生地域を示すものではない。発生地域に記載された中国・英国は研究機関の所在地であり、実際の感染事例発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ghaziabad rolls out month-long drive to curb dengue, malaria
article.articleSummary: Ghaziabad district launches a month-long communicable disease control campaign from Oct 1–31 to curb dengue, malaria and other vector-borne infections, with a Dastak awareness drive Oct 12–31 focusing on communicable diseases and encephalitis. The Ghaziabad Municipal Corporation has deployed around 100 fogging machines, 10 sprinkler units and five power sprayers across vulnerable localities including Mohan Nagar, Shalimar Garden, Vijay Nagar, Crossing Republic, Nandgram, Vasundhara, Khoda, Loni, Muradnagar and Dasna. An awareness rally at Joint District Hospital in Sanjay Nagar marked the campaign’s launch, with the chief medical officer flagging off activities alongside health, education, municipal departments, schoolchildren and Civil Defence cadets. District data report 31 dengue cases and 21 malaria cases, plus 4 scrub typhus and 3 leptospirosis. The initiative emphasizes early identification and prevention, eliminating stagnant water to reduce transmission, with awareness and surveillance across the district through October.

triage.headline_ja: ガジアバード、デング熱・マラリア抑制のため1ヶ月間のキャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性ベクター媒介感染症対策キャンペーンであり、症例数も少なく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは見られない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例的な予防活動（防疫噴霧、啓発活動）であり、症例数（デング31、マラリア21、scrub typhus 4、レプトスピラ3）も局地的かつ小規模。地域行政の通常業務の一環と判断。

article.articleHeadline: وزير: فرنسا تعتزم زيادة التمويل المخصص لمكافحة إيبولا في الكونجو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minister: France plans to increase funding allocated for Ebola response in Congo.
article.articleSummary: France will increase funding for Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), warning that Ebola could re-emerge rapidly if containment weakens. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Baro visited Bunia in northeastern DRC, where mid-September a laboratory-confirmed monkeypox case was reported. France has allocated 13.4 million euros for Ebola efforts from January to July and plans to propose additional humanitarian funding during upcoming budget discussions. The support encompasses humanitarian aid, medical research, and the PRISMS program launched in 2023. A national humanitarian conference in Paris is scheduled for October 6 to discuss Ebola. Baro commended Congolese authorities, UN agencies, NGOs, and healthcare workers for containment and preventing spread to major urban centers. Responding to questions about a reported case in France, he said there is no need for fear and emphasized fighting the outbreak wherever it appears.

triage.headline_ja: 大臣：フランスはコンゴにおけるエボラ対策への資金提供を増やす計画
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ再燃リスクとフランスでの関連症例報告が指摘されており、国際的拡大や深刻な公衆衛生影響の懸念がIHR基準2項目以上に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ対応へのフランスの資金支援拡大が主題。ブニアでのMpox症例報告やフランス国内での関連症例への言及もあるが、フランス自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。パリでの人道会議（10月6日）も言及されているが、これは支援国側の動きであり発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: In Leiden vecht een ebolapatiënt voor zijn leven. Dit is wat we weten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Leiden, an Ebola patient is fighting for his life. This is what we know.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is being treated in Leiden, Netherlands, where a male healthcare worker, likely employed by Doctors Without Borders (MSF), is hospitalized at Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) behind an airlock and under a dedicated care team. He is believed to have been infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where MSF operates; the exact transmission route remains unknown. After a confirming test on Thursday night, Ebola was confirmed in the patient. The case arises amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo, which reported its 4,000th Ebola-related death on Friday, highlighting the outbreak’s severity there. The Leiden patient is under strict isolation with limited information released about his condition or any additional imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ライデンでエボラ患者が生死の境をさまよう。現時点で分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの進行中エボラ流行（死者4000人超）に関連し、欧州（オランダ）への輸入症例が発生しており、国際的拡大が確認されたため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にオランダ（Leiden）が含まれるが、これは感染者が治療を受けている輸入先国であり、感染源はDRCでの進行中のエボラ流行であるため、対象国としてはDRCのみを検証対象とした。

article.articleHeadline: Clean Chemistry, Hidden Germs: Ghana's Boreholes Reveal a Groundwater
article.articleSummary: Sixteen boreholes supplying domestic water in Segyemase, Juaso, and Nsuapemso in Ghana's Eastern Region appear chemically pristine (pH 5.38–7.29, conduct. ~173.5 μS/cm, TDS ~135 mg/L; fluoride below 1.5 mg/L). Yet microbiological testing found faecal coliforms and Escherichia coli in two boreholes, implying potential infection risk with an annual probability up to about 58% for the worst source. The study, published in Discover Geoscience, used an integrated framework combining hydrochemical characterization, six water quality/pollution indices, microbiological indicators, ecological risk diagnostics, and quantitative microbial risk assessment; samples were collected September 2022 during the late wet season and analyzed at CSIR-WRI Accra per APHA methods. Hydrochemistry indicates groundwater from Proterozoic Birimian rocks dominated by carbonate dissolution and silicate weathering, with pH strongly linked to bicarbonate (r=0.97) and iron to manganese (r=0.90). Composite indices correlated highly; trace metals pollution index showed a more complex story.

triage.headline_ja: きれいな化学組成、隠れた細菌：ガーナのボーリング孔が示す地下水のパラドックス
triage.triage_reason: 学術的な水質調査研究であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や人への感染拡大を示すものではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（2022年9月採取のサンプルに基づく地下水質調査）であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。大腸菌汚染による潜在的な感染リスクが指摘されているが、具体的な感染事例や患者数は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 4 018 morts, Kinshasa exige des comptes des 97 partenaires de la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 4,018 dead; Kinshasa demands accountability from the 97 partners in the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 deaths, with 4,018 fatalities and 8,300 confirmed cases reported by the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) on Oct 2. Lethality remains 48.4%. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain and declared May 15, spans seven provinces and 63 health zones, from Ituri (the main hotspot) to Sud-Ubangi. By Sept 23, 2,162 recovered, 842 in isolation or hospital, and contact tracing at 80.6%; the WHO noted 83.4% surveillance. In Mutwanga, two women were discharged after 22 and 28 days; Mutwanga zone recorded 15 confirmed cases and 4 deaths; in Beni, 10 more recovered. Kinshasa demands accountability from 97 partners; only 25% have justified funds. The revised 180-day plan costs $1.3B, with commitments around $2.9B since outbreak, including $886M from the US. An accreditation form is now required for field access; Africa CDC calls for full tracing of funds.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：死者4,018人、キンシャサが対応に関わる97のパートナーに説明責任を要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが死者4,018人・致死率48.4%・7州63保健地区に拡大しており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的な対応・資金問題を伴うためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国は資金拠出国として言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため除外。既知のアウトブレイクだが規模拡大と資金説明責任問題が続報として重要。

article.articleHeadline: غيبريسوس: توسيع الاستجابة لإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية يحدث فرقاً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ghebreyesus: Expanding the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is making a difference.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says expanding the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is making a difference. He notes that new supplies, strengthened logistics, and support for frontline teams are advancing treatment, surveillance, laboratory services, and infection prevention in affected communities. Transmission remains ongoing with new hotspots, underscoring the need to sustain and widen the response, invest in field capacity, increase health workers, boost surveillance, expand access to care, provide safe and dignified burials, and strengthen community engagement. Progress remains fragile and cannot be taken for granted. WHO will continue to support the DRC government and partners with technical expertise, operational leadership, and delivery of essential supplies, stressing that sustainable investment and solidarity are crucial to protecting communities, saving lives, and ending the outbreak. Gratitude was expressed to all supporting partners delivering vital supplies and equipment.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長：コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ対応の拡大が成果を上げている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に複数該当する重大疾患であり、DRCで新たなホットスポットを伴う継続的な感染が確認されているため、既存アウトブレイクの進展として継続的にフルRRA対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中エボラアウトブレイクに関するWHO事務局長の声明記事。新規発生ではなく既存事案の経過報告だが、感染継続・新規ホットスポット発生のため引き続き監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Infezioni del sangue nei bambini, il 73% degli isolati di Klebsiella resiste al meropenem
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bloodstream infections in children: 73% of Klebsiella isolates are resistant to meropenem.
article.articleSummary: Meropenem-resistant bloodstream infections in children at Yangon Children's Hospital, Myanmar, based on a study published Oct 3, 2026 in Scientific Reports, covering Aug 2023–Jul 2025. Among 4,263 pediatric blood samples (median age 228 days; 765 positive), 160 isolates across five species were analyzed, led by Klebsiella pneumoniae (85 isolates, 53.1%). Overall, 82.5% of the isolates were resistant to at least one antibiotic per WHO GLASS. Meropenem resistance was 72.9% among K. pneumoniae and 38.5% among Escherichia coli. The presence of NDM metallo-beta-lactamase—an enzyme that inactivates many beta-lactams—was detected by rapid testing in 47% of 134 Gram-negative isolates; among 71 meropenem-resistant isolates, 88.7% carried NDM. Authors emphasize rapid diagnostics, antibiograms, infection control, and prudent antibiotic use to guide therapy, noting the findings are from a single pediatric hospital and contextualized within global resistance trends reported by WHO.

triage.headline_ja: 小児の血流感染症、クレブシエラ分離株の73%がメロペネムに耐性
triage.triage_reason: ミャンマー・ヤンゴン小児病院での単一施設の後ろ向き研究に基づく薬剤耐性(AMR)サーベイランスデータであり、急性アウトブレイクではないが、高いメロペネム耐性率とNDM保有率は公衆衛生上懸念される。
triage.notes: 単一病院(ヤンゴン小児病院)での2023年8月〜2025年7月の研究データであり、急性のアウトブレイク事例ではなくAMRサーベイランス報告。NDM産生菌の高頻度検出は院内感染対策上のリスクを示唆するが、続報や公的機関の対応状況が不明なため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão contra o Aedes aegypti chega ao Jóquei Clube na segunda-feira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aedes aegypti control drive arrives at the Jockey Club on Monday.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya drive targets Dourados, Brazil, focusing on the Jockey Club neighborhood. A five-day mutirão runs October 5–9, 2026, led by the Municipal Secretariat of Urban Services (Semsur) with Sanesul and the Center for Zoonosis Control (CCZ). Activities combine urban cleaning, waste removal, vegetation maintenance, and population education, including school talks on waste and sewerage; CCZ emphasizes Aedes aegypti prevention and Sanesul on water quality. Residents are urged to keep yards clean, remove containers that collect water, cover water tanks, and dispose of materials that could breed mosquitoes. The effort follows elevated chikungunya activity in the city. As of 2026, Dourados reported 10,633 notified chikungunya cases, 5,242 confirmed, and 19 deaths; authorities say the emergency status has ended, underscoring the importance of eliminating small points of standing water to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 月曜日にジョッキークラブでAedes aegypti対策キャンペーンが実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ドウラードスでチクングニア熱の大規模な症例（確定5,242例、死亡19例）が報告されているが、緊急事態は終了しており、今回の記事は蚊対策の地域活動報告が主題であるため、継続的な経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はチクングニア熱の蔓延状況そのものよりも、蚊媒介対策活動（清掃・教育）の実施案内が主眼。累計症例数・死亡数は過去データとして言及されており、緊急事態は既に終了済みとされている。

article.articleHeadline: Tedros: Ausweitung der Ebola-Bekämpfung in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo zeigt Wirkung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros: Expansion of the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is paying off.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, the World Health Organization reports tangible progress from the expanded Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo. New deliveries, strengthened logistics, and on-ground support to response teams are advancing treatment, surveillance, laboratory services, and infection prevention in affected communities. Transmission continues and new outbreak hotspots are emerging, underscoring the need to sustain and broaden measures, increase health personnel, improve access to care, ensure safe and dignified burials, and deepen community engagement. Progress remains fragile and must not be taken for granted. The agency thanks partners mobilizing life-saving supplies and equipment. WHO will continue to assist the DRC government and partners with technical expertise, operational leadership, and delivery of essential goods. Sustainable investment, solidarity, and collective action are essential to protect communities, save lives, and end the Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス氏:コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ対応の拡大が効果を上げている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続中で新たなホットスポットも出現しており、WHOが対応拡大を継続していることから、深刻な公衆衛生インパクトと国際的拡大リスクを有するシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイクに関するWHO進捗報告。新規発生ではないが、感染継続と新規ホットスポット出現により引き続き監視・フルRRAの対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Agri varsity to conduct advanced research on zoonotic parasite - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: CSKHPKV, Palampur, will conduct advanced research on Toxoplasma gondii at the Dr GC Negi College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, supported by the ANRF National Post-Doctoral Fellowship (N-PDF). Dr Divya Rattan, under Prof. Subhash Verma, will undertake a nearly two-year proteomic and molecular profiling study, with sanctioned funding of about Rs 27.12 lakh. The N-PDF is a competitive national fellowship supporting high-quality work in animal and public health within the One Health domain. T. gondii infection in sheep and goats can cause abortion, fetal death, stillbirth, and weak offspring; cats are definitive hosts, with oocysts contaminating soil, water, feed, and food. Humans may acquire infection via contaminated food/water, poorly washed vegetables, or undercooked meat, and congenital toxoplasmosis can affect eyes, brain, and nervous system. The project aims to identify proteins and molecular markers and study environmental survival and infectivity to aid surveillance, diagnosis, and control.

triage.headline_ja: 農業大学が人獣共通感染症の寄生虫に関する先端研究を実施へ
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染流行事例ではなく、大学による研究プロジェクトの発表であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染事象は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、トキソプラズマ症に関する学術研究資金の獲得・研究計画についての報道であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: പകർച്ചപ്പനി മരണം കഴിഞ്ഞ വർഷത്തേക്കാൾ കുതിച്ചുയർന്നു; എന്നിട്ടും വിചിത്രവാദവുമായി ആരോഗ്യമന്ത്രി; 'വ്യാപനമില്ല!'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Smallpox deaths have surged more than last year; yet the Health Minister, with a strange argument, says, 'There is no transmission!'
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports rising influenza, dengue, and chikungunya activity with conflicting government messaging. As of 3 October 2026, 39 new influenza cases and 5 chikungunya cases were reported today; yesterday saw 58 influenza cases, 35 dengue confirmed, and 125 dengue suspects. Year-to-date influenza deaths reach 120 (vs 40 by the same date last year); dengue deaths 43 (vs 33); chikungunya 477 cases this period (vs 18 by October last year). Health Minister K Muraleedharan maintains no transmission, a stance criticized by DMOs who say data are being ignored. Government hospitals face severe medicine shortages; 18 drugs previously acknowledged as scarce, with shortages now affecting lifestyle-disease meds. KMSSL warehouses reportedly lack even doxycycline tablets for smallpox prophylaxis, prompting an emergency board meeting and re-tender actions.

triage.headline_ja: 昨年より感染症死亡者数が急増；それでも保健大臣は奇妙な主張、「拡大はない！」
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州でインフルエンザ・デング熱・チクングニア熱の死亡者数が前年比で大幅増加しているにもかかわらず、政府が感染拡大を否定し医薬品不足も深刻であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 疾患名にSmallpoxが含まれるが、記事内容はインフルエンザ・デング熱・チクングニア熱に関するものであり、doxycyclineが『天然痘予防薬』とされる記述は誤情報の可能性が高い。実際の主題はベクター媒介感染症と季節性インフルエンザの急増および医薬品供給不足である。

article.articleHeadline: Punjab Govt to begin HIV, Hepatitis screening at de-addiction centres - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Punjab will begin Triple H screening for HIV, Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C at government de-addiction and rehabilitation facilities, integrating testing with addiction treatment under the Yudh Nashean Virudh campaign. The move aims to provide comprehensive care for people with substance-use disorders and curb the spread of blood-borne infections. HIV, Hep B and Hep C spread via high-risk practices such as sharing contaminated needles and syringes, making early detection crucial. Health Minister Balbir Singh noted prior screening camps were irregular (roughly every two months) and lacked robust follow-up. The new approach embeds testing into the de-addiction process to ensure consistent screening and enable referrals for further investigation or treatment. Singh emphasized preventing transmission and aiding reintegration. The government had in August announced adoption of advanced testing technologies—Nucleic Acid Testing (NAT) and Chemiluminescence Immunoassay (CLIA)—to strengthen early detection and blood safety in Punjab.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州政府、脱依存センターでHIV・肝炎スクリーニングを開始へ
triage.triage_reason: 既知の血液媒介感染症（HIV、B型・C型肝炎）に対する既存の公衆衛生対策の強化策であり、新規または異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は薬物依存治療施設における既存感染症の定期スクリーニング体制強化を報じる政策ニュースであり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: விழுப்புரம் நகராட்சியில் கொசு ஒழிப்பு, நோய்த் தடுப்புப் பணிகள் தீவிரம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquito control and disease prevention activities intensified in Viluppuram Municipality.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention efforts are being intensified across Viluppuram Municipality, Tamil Nadu, with an on-site inspection by V. Lokanayaki, Director of the Chennai Medical Education and Research Directorate. All wards are gridlocked with dengue vector-control activities, including a focused review of NSK Nagar in Ward 36. The visit assessed dengue vector-control operations, the scheduling of field personnel, and door-to-door work practices. Lokanayaki urged enhanced awareness among residents about dengue fever and the ongoing vector-control measures, and emphasized cooperation with frontline sanitary workers conducting field activities. The inspection was attended by district health officer S. Senthilkumar, municipal health officer Sripriya, and other health department officials, signaling coordinated district-municipal actions to curb dengue in Viluppuram."

triage.headline_ja: ヴィルップラム市、蚊対策と疾病予防活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の通常の予防・蚊対策活動に関する行政報告であり、異常な流行や重症例の報告はなく、既存の公衆衛生対応の一環と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性デング熱に対する通常の蚊媒介対策活動（防除・啓発）の視察報告であり、感染拡大や異常事態を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Badaun News: कटरी में पहुंची स्वास्थ्य विभाग की टीम, जानी खसरा फैलने की हकीकत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Badaun News: Health department team reaches Katri, truth about the spread of measles comes to light.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Katri area of Badaun district, Uttar Pradesh, near the Kasganj border. After reports of measles in Nayaji Nagla in Kasganj, two siblings aged 8 and 10 died; their grandmother said neither child had received a measles vaccination. The deaths occurred in Kasganj district, and Kasganj health authorities were notified. In Katri and neighboring villages (Kadarbeadi, Pankhiya Nagla, Gangpur Pukhta), a door-to-door screening identified nine suspected measles cases; five samples were collected and sent to Lucknow for testing, while vitamin A was administered to children. Screenings continued in Din Nagar and Dinpur villages, with 585 households surveyed and urged to maintain regular vaccination. MOIC Kadarchowk was instructed to maintain ongoing vaccination camps in border villages. The government was briefed; the situation is reported under control as of 3 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: バダウン・ニュース：カトリ地区に保健局チームが到着、麻疹感染拡大の実態が判明
triage.triage_reason: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州の複数村落で麻疹の疑い例・死亡例（未接種の小児2名）が報告されているが、地元保健当局により状況は制御下にあるとされ、国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 未接種児童2名の死亡と9例の疑い症例が報告されているが、地元保健局の対応（戸別調査・サンプル採取・ビタミンA投与・ワクチン接種キャンプ）により状況は制御下にあると記載。低接種率地域での麻疹流行は定期的に発生しており、国際的な異常性は認められない。続報を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: "ჟამიანობა" რუსეთში: შავი ჭირის გამომწვევმა ინფექციამ ერთი ადამიანი იმსხვერპლა -- რა ვიცით
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague in Russia: the infection caused by the Black Death has killed one person — what do we know?
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, Irkutsk Oblast, Russia reports a death from pneumonic plague caused by Yersinia pestis. A 28-year-old woman, Darya Shipilova, was hospitalized in late September and died on 2 October; the infection is pneumonic, though bubon ic and septicemic forms exist. The source is under investigation, with theories including a laboratory sample leak or infection during travel to Thailand or Buriyatia; the patient had been near the Russia–Mongolia border during an expedition. About 197 potential contacts have been traced; 189 were relocated for observation in medical facilities (114 in one hospital, 63 in another, 12 at the plague institute; 8 not hospitalized). Lab tests so far are negative, and no additional cases are confirmed. Governor Igor Kobzev canceled public events and urged calm. WHO (2019–2025) notes ~4,000 suspected cases in 10 countries; Mongolia reported 17 cases, 7 deaths (5 bubonic, 2 septicemic).

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで「疫病」：黒死病による感染症で1人死亡 ― 何がわかっているか
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で肺ペストによる死亡例が確認され、約200名の濃厚接触者が追跡・隔離されるなどヒト-ヒト感染リスクが懸念されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイやモンゴルへの渡航歴は感染源の仮説として言及されているのみで、発生地としては確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Cataguases reforça preparação das equipes de saúde após identificação do sorotipo 3 da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cataguases reinforces the preparation of health teams after the identification of dengue serotype 3.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, Cataguases reinforced health-team preparedness after identifying dengue serotype 3. A training session at the UBS do Bairro Paraíso, promoted by the Municipal Health Secretariat and led by Dr. Joseph Freire, targeted Family Health Strategy (ESF) teams, focusing on clinical management, early detection, and care protocols for dengue serotype 3. Serotype 3 was identified for the first time during the September LIRAa survey by the Endemias Control sector, triggering heightened vigilance across the public-health network. Dengue comprises four serotypes; introduction of a new serotype can enable reinfections in people without prior exposure. Public-health measures emphasize vector control, including removing water-holding containers inside homes and in public spaces to reduce Aedes aegypti proliferation. The training aims to strengthen rapid, appropriate responses to dengue cases.

triage.headline_ja: カタグアゼス市、デング熱血清型3の確認を受け医療チームの体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: 新規血清型（サロタイプ3）の局地的な確認により再感染リスクや流行拡大の可能性があるが、現時点で重症例や大規模発生の報告はなく、社会的関心も地域レベルにとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・カタグアゼス市における新規デング血清型3の確認とそれに伴う医療従事者研修の実施を報じており、症例数や重症度に関する具体的データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Jean-Noël Barrot effectue une visite à Kinshasa et Bunia, centrée sur la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jean-Noël Barrot visits Kinshasa and Bunia, focusing on the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) is the deadliest on record in the DRC, with Bunia identified as the epicenter and the death toll cited at over 4,000 by press reports. French Minister of Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot visited Kinshasa on Oct 2 and Bunia on Oct 3, 2026, to underscore international support for the Ebola response. Barrot is the first European foreign minister to visit the DRC since the outbreak began. In Bunia he was accompanied by Prof. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, director of the INRB and a leading Ebola expert. In Kinshasa, Barrot addressed gender-based violence and met MONUSCO officials. The trip precedes France-led humanitarian discussions at the 7th national humanitarian conference in Paris on Oct 6, and marks Barrot’s second DRC visit within months, following a Jan 30 meeting with President Tshisekedi after Goma’s fall to AFC/M23.

triage.headline_ja: ジャン＝ノエル・バロ仏外相、キンシャサとブニアを訪問、エボラ対策に焦点
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部（イトゥリ州ブニア）でのエボラ流行がDRC史上最悪規模（死者4,000人超）とされ、フランス外相の異例の訪問という高い社会的・政治的関心を伴うため、フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 本記事は進行中のエボラ流行に対するフランス外相の外交訪問を報じるもので、死者数4,000人超はDRC史上最悪規模と報じられている。既存流行の継続報道だが、国際支援の動きと社会的関心の高さからPICKUPと判定。フランス（パリ）は発生地域リストに含まれるが、対象国リストにないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: France to step up Ebola funding in Congo amid resurgence fears, minister says
article.articleSummary: France will boost funding for Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo amid resurgence fears, with Minister Barrot set to propose additional humanitarian funding in upcoming budget discussions. France's response to Ebola has relied on humanitarian aid, medical research, and the PRISM programme launched during President Macron's 2023 visit. A national humanitarian conference in Paris on October 6 will address Ebola. Barrot cautioned that Ebola may seem distant but can return quickly, stressing the need to fight the epidemic where it emerges. He praised Congolese authorities, UN agencies, humanitarian organisations, and medical workers for containing the outbreak and preventing spread to major urban centres in Congo and beyond. The article notes a recent Ebola case reported in France, underlining vigilance rather than fear.

triage.headline_ja: フランス、コンゴでのエボラ再燃懸念の中で資金支援を強化へ、大臣が表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ再燃懸念に加え、フランス国内でのエボラ症例報告があり国際的拡大の兆候が見られるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はフランスによるDRCでのエボラ対応資金増額の発表が主題。フランス国内での「最近のエボラ症例」の言及があるが詳細不明のため、続報確認が必要。フランス・パリは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு கொசு உற்பத்திக்கான ஆதாரங்களை அழிக்க பணியாளா்களுக்கு அறிவுறுத்தல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Instructions to workers to destroy sources of dengue mosquito breeding.
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026, in Tiruchirappalli (Trichy), Tamil Nadu, district epidemiologist Dr. Madivannan and District Malaria Officer Murugesan urged dengue vector-control workers to identify and eradicate sources of Aedes breeding to curb dengue spread ahead of the northeast monsoon. A training session for dengue-control staff, health inspectors, and investigators emphasized surveying initial settlements, destroying breeding habitats, and focusing on abandoned or locked houses and under-construction sites. Officials urged intensified fever surveillance and the application of larvicides across all wards, with a cycle of reinforced mosquito-control operations. The coordinated effort aims to preempt a rise in dengue cases, detect and treat affected individuals promptly, and prevent further transmission within the community.

triage.headline_ja: デング蚊の発生源を破壊するよう職員に指示
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節的なデング媒介蚊対策活動であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: モンスーン前の予防的な蚊媒介対策活動に関する通常の行政広報であり、感染症流行の兆候は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Rare Fungal Brain Infection Reveals Striking Christmas-Tree Sign on MRI
article.articleSummary: As of 3 October 2026 in Hangzhou, China, a 50-year-old woman with hydrocephalus developed intracranial talaromycosis due to Talaromyces marneffei. The infection progressed from meningitis to widespread vasculitis and multiple hemorrhagic cerebral infarcts. Contrast-enhanced MRI showed skull-base meningitis with a Christmas-tree-like pattern and irregular vessel-wall enhancement and luminal irregularities, implicating vasculitis in which vascular occlusion led to infarcts and hemorrhagic transformation. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing of cerebrospinal fluid and blood confirmed T. marneffei, a thermally dimorphic fungus endemic to Southeast Asia and southern China. CNS involvement is rare, historically seen in HIV-infected individuals but increasingly reported in HIV-negative patients. After induction therapy with liposomal amphotericin B 150 mg daily for two weeks, consciousness did not improve, suggesting irreversible vascular/parenchymal damage and antifungal-refractory fungal vasculitis. Prior empiric piperacillin-tazobactam did not target the fungus.

triage.headline_ja: まれな真菌性脳感染症、MRIで特徴的な『クリスマスツリー徴候』を呈する
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。稀な日和見感染の臨床報告であり、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一症例の臨床報告（中枢神経系Talaromyces marneffei感染）であり、アウトブレイクや集団感染の兆候はない。Talaromyces marneffeiは東南アジア・中国南部に風土病的に存在する日和見真菌であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 台南 3天2境外移入登革熱 憂藏黑數
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan: Two imported dengue fever cases in three days; concerns about underreported cases.
article.articleSummary: Two imported dengue fever cases in three days in Tainan, Taiwan, raise concerns about underreported infections as of 2026-10-03. This year has seen 9 imported dengue cases and 0 local transmissions; ROC Year 112 (2023) recorded >20,000 cases, Year 113 (2024) 0 local and 26 imported, Year 114 (2025) 3 local and 22 imported, with Year 2026 to date also 0 local and 9 imported. The Sept 30 case is a Taiwanese woman in her 50s infected during travel in Vietnam; the Oct 2 case is a Filipino man in his 20s who developed fever after arriving in Taiwan and was hospitalized, not entering the community. Public health measures target three markets—Shui Xian Gong Market, Gui Ren Market, and Jin Hua Market—with spraying and surveillance ongoing. Authorities warn of a potentially hidden caseload, enforcing the Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Act, which imposes penalties on clinicians (NT$90,000–NT$450,000) and institutions (NT$300,000–NT$2,000,000) for underreporting. triage.headline_ja: 台南で3日間に2件の国内輸入性デング熱症例、水面下の感染拡大を懸念
triage.triage_reason: いずれも海外渡航歴のある輸入症例で、現地での地域内感染（ローカル伝播）は確認されていない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは低く、ルーティンのサーベイランス対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（台南）での輸入性デング熱症例であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため該当なし。渡航歴として言及されたベトナムは発生地ではなく除外。局地的感染は0件であり、既存の罰則強化による過少報告対策の一環として報道されたものと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: بعد تجاوز وفيات إيبولا 4 آلاف حالة.. فرنسا تتعهد بتعزيز دعم جهود مكافحة الوباء في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After Ebola deaths exceed 4,000, France pledges to bolster support for efforts to combat the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains a severe outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 8,376 confirmed cases and over 4,000 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barro, during a visit to Bunia in Ituri Province, pledged to reinforce France’s support, proposing additional humanitarian funding during France’s upcoming budget discussions. France has previously allocated 13.4 million euros for Ebola response in the DRC from January to July. Barro warned of a potential resurgence and underscored the need to intensify efforts to prevent new waves of transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者数が4000人を超え、フランスがコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ対策支援強化を約束
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で大規模なエボラ流行（8,376症例、死者4,000人超）が継続中で、国際支援（フランス）が投入されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大・管理可能性の観点から複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: フランスは発生国ではなく支援国であるため、対象国リストには含めない。発生地域はIturi州Buniaを含むDRCのみが対象国に該当。

article.articleHeadline: 日本流感升溫 飆去年10倍 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza activity in Japan surges, up tenfold from last year | Zhonghua Daily | Zhonghua News Cloud
article.articleSummary: Japan faces a surge in influenza activity, with nine consecutive weeks of rising cases, led by Okinawa and Tokyo. Across 47 prefectures, 44 report higher counts; A/H1N1 dominates at 98%, aligning with Taiwan’s circulating strain; the affected age group skews elderly, with people aged 70 and over accounting for about 47.5%. In the week ending September 20, sentinel medical institutions nationwide in Japan reported 31,000 influenza cases, averaging 8.48 cases per facility and a 53% increase from the previous week; this is roughly ten times the level of the same period last year. The surge is attributed to Silver Week travel. Outside Japan, influenza activity is rising in the United States, mainland China, Hong Kong, South Korea, and Singapore. Taiwan’s government-funded influenza vaccine program began on October 1; officials urge high-risk groups to vaccinate, noting flu and COVID-19 vaccination can reduce pneumonia and cardiovascular risks.

triage.headline_ja: 日本でインフルエンザが急増、前年の10倍に | 中華日報・中華新聞雲
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの急増報告であり、前年比10倍という増加率は注目に値するが、IHR基準には該当せず深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。複数国での流行拡大状況は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は日本の季節性インフルエンザ流行（A/H1N1優勢、高齢者中心）。対象国リストの中で中国（香港含む）は『流行拡大中』と明示的に言及されているため含めた。日本・韓国・台湾・米国・シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。季節性インフルエンザであり、通常のRRA対象というよりは経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 台南增第9例境外移入登革熱 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan reports ninth imported dengue fever case | Zhonghua Daily | Zhonghua News Cloud
article.articleSummary: A ninth imported dengue fever case in Tainan involves a Filipino male migrant worker in his 20s. He began symptoms September 29, arrived at Kaohsiung Xiaogang Airport on October 1 with a positive NS1 rapid test, was hospitalized in Tainan (Xinshi District) on October 1, and confirmed on October 2. He will remain hospitalized through the viremic phase before returning to the community to reduce transmission risk. Public health teams conducted education and environmental inspections of his residence and workplace, plus vector-control measures to eliminate mosquito breeding sites. As of October 3, Taiwan reports a total of 179 dengue cases: 12 locally transmitted and 167 imported. Imported cases originate mostly from Vietnam, followed by Indonesia, the Philippines, Maldives, and Malaysia.

triage.headline_ja: 台南で第9例目の境外移入性デング熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入デング熱の1例報告であり、既存の対策（検疫・媒介蚊対策）が機能している通常の公衆衛生対応であるため、特段の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題は台湾（対象国リスト外）における輸入症例。患者の出身国としてフィリピンが明記されているが、感染地は台湾であり発生国としてのフィリピンへの該当性は低い。参考情報として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Siberian Plague-Lab Death Draws FSB Escort For Ambulances
article.articleSummary: Death of 28-year-old Daria Shipilova, a laboratory assistant at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute, triggers a major containment in Irkutsk region, Russia. Shipilova was admitted around Sept 29 with severe pneumonia and died soon after; reports vary on whether a lab accident—breaking a tube of live bacteria—occurred or whether the illness is pneumonic plague, which has not been publicly confirmed. By Oct 2, about 197 contacts were identified, with 189 hospitalized for observation (114 in one facility, 63 in another, 12 at the institute); eight remained outside hospital. No secondary infections have been confirmed; tests reportedly negative. The hospital wing is quarantined and ambulances carrying contacts were reportedly escorted by the FSB, though the agency has not confirmed this. Officials in Irkutsk, Roszdravnadzor, and Rospotrebnadzor are coordinating as investigations continue; competing accounts mention possible exposure abroad (Thailand or Buryatia) and a preliminary criminal case under Article 236.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアの研究所関連死、救急車にFSBの護衛がつく
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所職員が肺ペスト疑いで死亡し大規模な接触者隔離が行われているが、対象国との直接的な関連（発生）は確認されておらず、二次感染も未確認のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州、ブリヤート共和国）であり対象国に該当しない。記事中でタイへの渡航歴（exposure abroad）の可能性が言及されているが、これはロシア人研究員の海外渡航歴の疑惑であり、タイ国内での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。肺ペストの確定診断は未公表で、二次感染も現時点で確認されていない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Branco está entre três capitais com sinal de crescimento de casos de SRAG, aponta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Branco is among three capitals with signs of rising SARI cases, according to Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: Rio Branco, Acre, is among three Brazilian capitals with rising SARI (Severe Acute Respiratory Illness) activity and a six-week growth in cases, according to Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin up to Epidemiological Week 38 (Sept 20–26). Rio Branco, Porto Alegre (Rio Grande do Sul), and Rio de Janeiro show SARI activity at alert, risk, or high risk levels. The bulletin does not specify the virus driving Rio Branco’s increase. Nationally, metapneumovirus and SARS-CoV-2 show upward SARI trends; influenza B rises in Bahia and Mato Grosso, with signals of slowed growth in Rio Grande do Sul. Brazil has recorded 157,908 SARI cases in 2026, with 85,087 lab-positive (53.9%), 56,799 negative; about 7,090 pending. Among positives for the year, rhinovirus 32.1%, RSV 40.4%, influenza A 16.4%, influenza B 5.5%, SARS-CoV-2 3.8%. In the four most recent weeks, rhinovirus dominated 52.4%, followed by RSV 18.1%, influenza B 6.7%, SARS-CoV-2 4%, influenza A 3.2%.

triage.headline_ja: リオブランコ、フィオクルス発表でSARI症例増加の兆候が見られる3首都の一つに
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器疾患（RSV、インフルエンザ、メタニューモウイルス等）のサーベイランス報告であり、複数都市でSARI増加傾向が見られるが、新興感染症や異常事態ではなく通常の季節性サーベイランスの範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 複数の既知季節性呼吸器病原体（RSV、インフルエンザA/B、メタニューモウイルス、ライノウイルス、SARS-CoV-2）による通常のSARIサーベイランス報告。Fiocruzによる定期的なInfoGripe速報であり、新規・異常な病原体の出現は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Shimla Launches Mass Anti-Rabies Drive, 4,000 Stray Dogs Targeted
article.articleSummary: Rabies control drive underway in Shimla as mass anti-rabies vaccination targets more than 4,000 stray dogs over 10 days (Oct 3–13). The effort covers all 34 wards, with nine teams—three net-catchers and six hand-catchers—conducting vaccination and assisting in sterilisation. Volunteers from Shimla, plus teams from Rajasthan and Punjab, participate; preventive anti-rabies vaccination given to teams beforehand. Last year about 3,700 dogs were vaccinated; drives have also been held in Kotkhai, Jubbal, Rohru, and Rampur. ABC (animal birth control) collaboration with Shimla Municipal Corporation and Animal Husbandry Department; vans deployed to access restricted areas. Target vaccination coverage is 70–80%. Aratrika Agrawal of IVSA India stresses breaking the rabies transmission cycle through mass vaccination rather than culling. Residents are advised not to provoke stray dogs; bite victims should wash wounds and seek medical care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: シムラー市が狂犬病集団予防接種活動を開始、野良犬4,000匹を対象に
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病予防のための計画的な野良犬ワクチン接種活動であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病の発生報告ではなく、シムラー市による予防的な野良犬ワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施報告。疾病発生イベントとしての緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: У ДР Конго тестують препарат від вірусу Ебола: кому він допоможе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a drug against the Ebola virus is being tested: who will it help.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, more than 250 participants are enrolled in testing Obeldesivir, an experimental antiviral from Gilead Sciences, to see if it reduces the risk of Ebola virus disease after exposure. The trial targets Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain of Ebola, with the outbreak spanning the DRC and Uganda; the WHO declared it a PHEIC in 2026. Conducted at Ituri Province Hospital, the epicenter, the study enrolls adults and children aged 12 and older who had contact with a confirmed case within five days and are asymptomatic. Half receive Obeldesivir, half receive placebo, with daily monitoring for 21 days and a 42-day follow-up by phone. As of September, Congo reports over 7,000 cases and more than 3,300 deaths. The trial aims to enroll at least 1,000 participants; to date, no symptomatic cases requiring treatment have occurred.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス治療薬を試験中：誰に有効か
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行で、7000人超の症例・3300人超の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダにも流行が及んでいると述べているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。PHEIC宣言により渡航・貿易制限のリスクも高いと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго тестируют препарат от вируса Эбола: кому он поможет
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, a drug to treat Ebola is being tested: who will it help?
article.articleSummary: Obeldesivir, an experimental antiviral by Gilead Sciences, is being tested in the Republic of the Congo against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of six Ebola virus species. More than 250 people are enrolled with a target of about 1,000, including adults and children 12+, all of whom had contact with a confirmed Ebola case within five days but are asymptomatic. The randomized, placebo-controlled trial is underway at a hospital in Ituri province, the outbreak’s epicenter. Participants are assigned to Obeldesivir or placebo; daily monitoring for 21 days and a 42-day post-contact follow-up by phone are conducted. If symptoms develop, those in the drug arm would receive supportive care, though no cases have occurred yet. ALIMA NGO leads recruitment, which began in July. By September, Congo reported over 7,000 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 3,300 deaths; the outbreak has been declared a PHEIC in Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ治療薬の治験、誰に役立つのか
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7000例超・3300人超の死亡が報告されPHEICが宣言された進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに関する内容であり、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRA対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ治験薬Obeldesivirに関するもの。ウガンダも発生地域として挙げられているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。既にPHEIC宣言済みの大規模アウトブレイクであり、既存のRRA対象として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Грозит ли миру новая эпидемия чумы из-за случая в России и насколько опасна болезнь сегодня
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the world at risk of a new plague epidemic due to a case in Russia, and how dangerous is the disease today?
article.articleSummary: Probable pneumonic plague case in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, after a 28-year-old laboratory worker at the anti-plague institute fell ill and died; about 200 contacts were isolated, with 189 hospitalized for observation and the Shelekhov district hospital quarantined. The event reportedly began on 25 September when she allegedly broke a vial containing Yersinia pestis; death occurred by 2 October. Uncertainty remains as Russian authorities have not released full details. Globally, WHO deems a worldwide epidemic unlikely. Pneumonic plague, though deadly, is treatable with antibiotics when diagnosed early. Prophylactic antibiotics are given to close contacts; patient is isolated; health workers use protective equipment. Transmission requires close contact via respiratory droplets. The DRC and Madagascar have recent plague activity, where natural foci persist. The key question is whether new infections emerged among contacts and how quickly they were identified and treated.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでの症例により世界で新たなペスト流行の恐れはあるか、現在の病気の危険性はどの程度か
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの実験室関連の肺ペスト疑い例で死亡者が出ており注目度は高いが、対象国（DRC等）では実際の発生ではなく背景説明に留まり、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州での研究所職員の肺ペスト疑い死亡例であり、対象国リストに含まれない。DRCおよびマダガスカルは『自然流行地が存在する』という一般的背景情報として言及されているのみで、本件の発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Чи загрожує світу нова епідемія чуми через випадок у росії та наскільки небезпечна хвороба сьогодні
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Does a new plague epidemic threaten the world because of a case in Russia, and how dangerous is the disease today?
article.articleSummary: Probable pneumonic plague case in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, triggered the isolation of about 200 contacts after 28-year-old lab worker Darya Shipilova died following exposure to Yersinia pestis. WHO says a global epidemic is highly unlikely; plague persists in natural foci worldwide, with recent cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar. Pneumonic plague is the most dangerous form because it spreads via respiratory droplets between people and is nearly always fatal without treatment; with timely diagnosis and antibiotics, recovery is common. Close contacts receive preventive antibiotics; the patient is isolated and healthcare workers use personal protective equipment. While the Russia incident raises concern, there is no confirmed outbreak, and the epidemiological response focuses on rapid contact tracing and prophylaxis. Uncertainties remain due to incomplete official details, but the scale of isolation does not equal confirmed infection.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでの症例を受け、新たなペスト流行が世界を脅かすのか、現在この病気はどれほど危険なのか
triage.triage_reason: ロシアで致死的な肺ペスト症例が確認され約200人が隔離対象となり、異常性・重症性の観点でIHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 主要な発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）。記事中のDRC・マダガスカルへの言及は『世界各地の自然疫源地で発生が続く』という一般的背景説明であり、本記事の主題イベントの発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Monkeypox Confirmed in Congo's Ebola-Hit Bunia as Health Officials Brace for More Cases
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox has been confirmed in Bunia, the city of Ituri province in the Democratic Republic of Congo, as health officials simultaneously respond to a major Ebola outbreak in the same region. A confirmed Monkeypox case is reported in Bunia, with five additional suspected Monkeypox cases in the same city under investigation. The Ituri Ebola outbreak persists, prompting intensified surveillance and response efforts. In parallel, the United States announced an additional 267 million dollars to support Ebola containment in the DRC, bringing total U.S. funding for this response to 886 million dollars. The funds are allocated for treatment units, safe-burial teams, protective and medical supplies, surveillance, and contact tracing. Published 2026-10-03.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの エボラ流行地ブニアでサル痘（Mpox）確認、保健当局はさらなる症例増加に備える

triage.notes: 米国がエボラ対応に追加2.67億ドル（累計8.86億ドル）を拠出しており、国際的関心と支援が既に動いている。Mpoxの流行状況（Clade I/IIいずれか）は本文からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand Flood Safety: Avoiding Leeches, Snakes, and Infection Risks
article.articleSummary: Thailand floods raise risks of leech and snake encounters and floodwater–borne infections. Leech bites may bleed longer; keep the area clean and monitor for heavy bleeding, swelling, or signs of infection, especially if near the eye or mouth. Do not attempt to catch snakes; give them space and contact local responders. Seek immediate medical care for any suspected snakebite, and keep the bitten limb still during transport. If crossing floodwater is unavoidable, wear rubber boots, cover cuts with waterproof dressings, and wash exposed skin with soap and clean water afterward. Floodwater and mud can carry germs such as those causing leptospirosis and melioidosis; watch for fever, headache, muscle pain (calves/thighs), and red eyes, and seek medical advice if symptoms develop. Melioidosis risk is associated with contaminated soil/water, especially in northeast Thailand. Always inform clinicians about exposure, and avoid unnecessary contact with floodwater.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水に伴うレプトスピラ症・類鼻疽の感染リスクに関する一般的な注意喚起記事であり、具体的な症例数や発生状況の報告はないため、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: 치명률 48%, 넉달 반 만에 4000명 숨졌다"...에볼라 확산 비상인 '이 나라'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case-fatality rate of 48%, 4,000 people have died in a little over four months as Ebola spreads in 'this country'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has killed over 4,000 people, with 8,300 confirmed cases and 2,162 recoveries as of 30 September 2026. The virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus; the outbreak was declared on 15 May, about four and a half months earlier. The case-fatality rate is 48.4%. The epidemic has spread to seven provinces, with 63 health zones reporting infections by 23 September. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the DRC and Uganda on 15 May. Security concerns and distrust hinder reporting; Africa CDC and MSF warn that actual infections and deaths may exceed official tallies due to surveillance gaps. A regional UDPS official, Mari Celestin Karond, was killed in Butembo, North Kivu on 27 September after advocating Ebola prevention efforts; motive unconfirmed.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率48%、4カ月半で4000人死亡...エボラ拡大非常事態の「この国」
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ種)が7州63保健ゾーンに拡大し死者4000人超、致死率48.4%、WHOがPHEIC宣言済みであり、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も多数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダもPHEIC対象国として言及されているが、記事の主題はDRC国内の流行状況であり対象国リストに含まれないため除外。治安悪化や報告妨害により実際の感染・死亡数は公式統計を上回る可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 江西疾控发布十月健康提示 重点防范流感、新冠等呼吸道传染病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jiangxi CDC Issues October Health Tips, Emphasizing Prevention of Influenza, COVID-19, and Other Respiratory Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Jiangxi CDC's October health tips warn of heightened risks for influenza, COVID-19, hand-foot-mouth disease, norovirus gastroenteritis, dengue fever, chikungunya, tick-borne fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome, and foodborne diseases during the October National Day travel period in Jiangxi Province. Despite recent declines in flu and COVID-19, holiday crowds raise transmission risk, especially in nurseries and schools after holidays; vaccination is advised for at-risk groups. Preventive actions include thorough hand hygiene (20 seconds), wearing medical masks in crowded places, ensuring ventilation, and seeking medical care promptly for fever, cough, sore throat, or fatigue. For hand-foot-mouth and norovirus, emphasize sanitation, disinfection, safe food and water, and monitoring schools after holidays. Dengue and chikungunya risk persists for travel to Southeast Asia and other endemic regions; use protective clothing, repellents, and home vector control. Tick-borne diseases require outdoor protection and tick checks with prompt medical evaluation if symptoms develop. Foodborne illness risk during gatherings; ensure thorough cooking and food safety, and report suspected clusters to authorities.

article.articleHeadline: Satara Dengue Alert : डेंग्यूच्या पार्श्वभूमीवर आरोग्य विभाग अलर्ट; भुईंज परिसरात आरोग्य विभागाची पाहणी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Satara Dengue Alert: Health Department on alert against dengue; Health Department's inspection in the Bhuinj area.
article.articleSummary: Dengue alert issued by Satara district health department for Bhuinj in Wai taluka. Health teams inspected Bhuinj, Degav, and Bopardi; no active fever cases were found during visits. Over the past four months, 26 suspected dengue samples from primary health centers were sent for testing, and 50 individuals were tested by RDKE; none were positive. In Degav, private laboratories reported 12 dengue-positive cases, all of whom have recovered. In response, the PHC Bhuinj, with Degav Gram Panchayat, directed preventive actions: eliminating mosquito breeding sites, removing standing water, and applying larvicides as needed. Field teams are conducting door-to-door fever surveys and public awareness on vector-borne diseases, with household larval indices noted as low. Residents are urged to observe a weekly 'Dry Day' and promptly seek care if fever develops.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola epidemic update - October 1
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) update for the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In the last 24 hours, 76 new confirmed cases were reported across four provinces: Ituri (49), North Kivu (23), Haut-Uélé (3), and Tshopo (1). Five treatment-center deaths (Ituri 4, North Kivu 1) bring the period’s confirmed deaths to 24. There were 20 recoveries after two negative tests (Ituri 19, North Kivu 1). As of 1 October 2026, the DRC has 8,376 cumulative confirmed cases and 4,042 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%). Ituri remains the epicenter, with 75.7% of cumulative cases and 64.5% of new cases; North Kivu CFR is 59.0%. Across seven provinces, 63 of 167 health zones (37.7%) have been affected since the start of the epidemic. Ongoing transmission persists in the affected regions.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で累計8,376例・死亡4,042例（致死率48.3%）に達する大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、複数州にまたがる感染拡大と高い重症度が確認されているため。
triage.notes: 本記事は継続中のエボラ流行に関する定期アップデートであり、7州63保健ゾーン（全167中37.7%）が影響を受けている。致死率48.3%は非常に高く、既にWHO/国際社会の支援対象となっている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Tak Perlu Panik Meski Kasus Meningkat, Dinkes Jawa Barat ungkap Cara Ini Ampuh Cegah Sakit Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No Need to Panic Even Though Cases Are Rising, West Java Provincial Health Office Reveals This Method That Effectively Prevents Influenza A
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in West Java, including Bandung City, where emergency department visits have increased, but officials say infections can be managed at primary care facilities (Puskesmas, clinics, private practice, or hospital polyclinics). West Java's Provincial Health Office urges calm and promotes prevention through healthy living (PHBS) and early detection. Preventive measures include masking to reduce droplet transmission, frequent handwashing, avoiding crowds, avoiding contact with the sick, and maintaining immune health. Symptoms align with flu: fever, aches, headache, nausea, and fatigue. In Tangerang Regency, influenza A cases have also risen, with about 30,000 exposure cases reported from January–September 2026. Timely care and ongoing preventive practices are advised.

triage.headline_ja: パニックになる必要はない、症例増加もインフルエンザA予防に効果的な方法を西ジャワ州保健局が発表

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Jean-Noël Barrot à Bunia, au cœur d'une épidémie d'Ebola qui a déjà fait plus de 4 000 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Jean-Noël Barrot in Bunia, at the heart of an Ebola epidemic that has already killed more than 4,000.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola epidemic centers on Ituri, with Bunia hosting the Rwampara treatment center run by ALIMA. As of Oct 3, 2026, 4,018 deaths among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, CFR 48.4%. Ituri is the main hotspot, ahead of Nord-Kivu. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot visited Bunia on Oct 3 to assess the response, touring Rwampara and the INRB lab led by Jean-Jacques Muyembe-Tamfum. Rwampara features a transparent patient-care unit to reduce contamination risk and supports the EBO-PEP trial evaluating obeldesivir, an experimental Gilead antiviral, in recently exposed but asymptomatic individuals to prevent disease and transmission. France allocated €13.4 million to Ebola response from Jan–July 2026 and will seek further humanitarian funding. Populations are urged to follow prevention measures and report suspected cases promptly.

article.articleHeadline: 南市新增第9例境外登革熱　黃偉哲提醒「秋天也不能鬆懈」 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan City reports the 9th imported dengue fever case; Huang Wei-che reminds that autumn should not let its guard down.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s Tainan City reports its 9th imported dengue case of the year. On Oct 2, a Filipino man in his 20s from Xinshi District’s Gangqianli developed fever and headache on Sept 29, flew from Kaohsiung airport on Oct 1; NS1 rapid screening at airport quarantines was positive. After returning to Tainan, he was hospitalized and had no community contact; dengue was PCR-confirmed on Oct 2. Local authorities initiated education, environmental inspections, and vector-control work around his residence and workplace. Since January, Taiwan has 179 dengue cases (12 locally transmitted, 167 imported), with Vietnam contributing the most infections, followed by Indonesia, the Philippines, the Maldives, and Malaysia. In Tainan, the Dengue Prevention Center notes 1,287 positive containers this year, mainly barrels/urns/containers (63.4%), underscoring breeding linked to daily life. Officials urge ongoing vigilance with the 4S (Inspect, Empty, Clean, Scrub) approach, summer-like warmth favorable for Aedes mosquitoes, and prompt medical care if dengue symptoms and travel history occur.

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控发国庆假期健康风险提示：当前流感在中低流行水平波动
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC issues National Day holiday health risk advisory: influenza activity currently fluctuating at a mid-to-low level.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-04, during the Chinese National Day holiday, the China CDC reports COVID-19 at a low level and influenza fluctuating at a mid-to-low level. With increased travel, public health guidance urges masking in transport hubs and indoor venues to curb respiratory infections. Dengue fever and chikungunya fever remain active in southern provinces, presenting as scattered cases and local clusters; residents should eliminate standing water, overturn containers, and use mosquito nets and screens, plus personal protection outdoors. Food- and waterborne risks rise during gatherings; practice hand hygiene before meals, separate raw and cooked foods, and stay vigilant for norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease. For outbound travel, monitor destination public health risks and report overseas travel history if ill; on return, seek medical care and disclose travel history. Influenza vaccination is strongly advised as the season approaches after October to reduce severe disease and death risk.

triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCによる国慶節休暇に向けた定例の公衆衛生注意喚起であり、季節性感染症（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、デング熱等）が通常の範囲で言及されているのみで、異常な増加や新規事象は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 四川疾控发布10月健康提示：国庆假期人员流动增加 重点防范五类疾病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sichuan CDC releases October health tips: Increased population movement during the National Day holiday; focus on preventing five categories of diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-04, Sichuan Province, China, calls for heightened vigilance during National Day travel against five infectious-health risks: mosquito-borne diseases (dengue fever and chikungunya), influenza, COVID-19, other infectious diarrheal diseases (notably norovirus and rotavirus), and hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD). Dengue and chikungunya risk local spread as travelers return from Southeast Asia, South Asia, South America, and Africa; watch for fever, rash, and joint pain and report travel history. Influenza season has begun; despite COVID-19 staying at low levels, high holiday mobility warrants vaccination for children, the elderly, students, and chronic patients. Norovirus and rotavirus drive autumn-winter diarrhea; emphasize hand hygiene and water/food safety. HFMD peaks October–December; EV-A71 vaccine reduces risk of severe disease. Recommend home ventilation (2–3 times daily, at least 30 minutes) and avoiding gatherings when ill.

article.articleHeadline: India News | Shimla Municipal Corporation Launches Mass Anti-Rabies Vaccination for Stray Dogs, Targets 4,000 Animals
article.articleSummary: Rabies control drive underway in Shimla, Himachal Pradesh, India, targeting stray dogs with mass anti-rabies vaccination. The campaign aims to vaccinate more than 4,000 dogs over 10 days (Oct 3–13) across all 34 wards, involving nine teams (three net-catching, others hand-catching) and about 40 volunteers per team from Shimla, Rajasthan, and Punjab. Initiated Oct 3, the effort continues through Oct 12–13 and is part of the Shimla Municipal Corporation’s collaboration with animal welfare groups and the Animal Husbandry Department, plus veterinary students and experts. Last year saw ~3,700 dogs vaccinated; current drive also supports ABC (animal birth control) efforts including sterilisation in Rampur, Kotkhai, Jubbal, and Rohru. Targeting 70–80% herd immunity, organizers urge residents not to provoke stray dogs and to avoid interaction if uncomfortable, with vaccination seen as essential to breaking rabies transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Rabies Belum Ada Obatnya, Ahli Ungkap Pentingnya Vaksin dan Serum Usai Digigit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is no cure yet for rabies; experts reveal the importance of vaccines and serum after a bite.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains incurable once clinical symptoms appear, making post-bite management critical. Experts emphasize administering rabies vaccine and rabies immune serum after suspected exposure to a rabid animal. The vaccine enables antibody development, typically taking one to two weeks; the serum helps neutralize the virus when it is suspected to have entered the body. In some cases, vaccines and serum may be given together based on medical judgment. Rabies is nearly always fatal once symptoms start, reflecting CNS involvement including the brain. The incubation period averages two to three months but can range from weeks to over a year. Do not wait for symptoms; first aid includes washing the wound with running water and soap, then seeking medical care. In Jakarta, facilities offering vaccines/serum include RSPI Prof. Dr. Sulianti Saroso and RSUD Tarakan; others require confirmation of availability.

article.articleHeadline: गाय-भैंस में शरीर पर दिखें गोल गांठें तो न करें नजरअंदाज, जानें लंपी के लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cows and buffaloes: If you notice round lumps on the body, don’t ignore them; learn the symptoms of Lumpy Skin Disease.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) in cows and buffaloes is highlighted in Sultanpur via a Local 18 interview with veterinary scientist Dr. Divakar Kumar of Krishi Vigyan Kendra Sultanpur. LSD is a contagious viral illness transmitted primarily through blood-sucking insects, flies, mosquitoes, and ticks, with higher risk during rainy, humid seasons. Main signs include high fever, reduced appetite, and round, hard nodules on the neck, head, legs, and other body parts; conjunctival/nasal discharge, drooling, and leg swelling may also occur, with weakness and decreased milk production in severe cases. Diagnosis relies on clinical signs, with laboratory confirmation if needed. If LSD is suspected, isolate the affected animal, maintain clean stalls, and implement vector control. Vaccination may be possible under a veterinarian’s guidance to help prevent future outbreaks.

article.articleHeadline: Empat penduduk dijangkiti antraks selepas makan daging kambing mati mengejut
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four residents infected with anthrax after eating meat from a goat that died suddenly.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak in Dadapayu, Semanu, Gunungkidul Regency, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, after four residents were confirmed infected from eating meat of a goat that died suddenly. Health authorities said initial detection occurred in early September when patients presented with clinical symptoms of anthrax. Seven individuals were identified as suspected cases; PCR testing confirmed four positives for Bacillus anthracis. Contact tracing found 47 people at risk due to exposure to the goat. Environmental sampling at the slaughter site detected soil contaminated with anthrax blood residues, with decontamination ongoing. Officials condemn the brandu practice of slaughtering and consuming animals that die suddenly, and encourage reporting of sick or dead livestock for safe disposal with compensation available from local government. Public health and veterinary authorities are coordinating to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 死んだヤギの肉を食べた後、住民4人が炭疽菌に感染
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準の「長期曝露」に該当するが、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低く、地域当局が対応中であり社会的関心の高まりも不明なため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 炭疽菌はインドネシアの「ブランドゥ」慣習（病死・突然死した家畜を解体・消費する行為）に関連して周期的に発生している既知の人獣共通感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はない。現地保健・獣医当局が接触者調査・環境除染を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: 遼寧一家三口食炒蛋中毒　涉保存前水洗加速變質 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Liaoning family of three poisoned after eating scrambled eggs; washing with water before storage accelerates spoilage.
article.articleSummary: Three members of a Liaoning family in Shenyang fell ill after eating scrambled eggs; investigators suspect spoiled eggs as the cause. The eggs had been washed before storage, which experts say can damage the eggshell’s natural protective film and open pores, letting bacteria enter, including Salmonella. Once this protective layer is compromised, spoilage may accelerate, and refrigeration cannot fully eliminate contamination or cross‑infection risk. If eggs have been washed, cook them promptly; for temporary storage, refrigerate immediately and avoid long room‑temperature holding. For shells with light dust, do not wash; wipe with a dry cloth. Heavily soiled shells should be avoided at purchase. Four storage tips: never freeze eggs; do not wash; avoid mixing with other foods; keep the large end up to preserve the air cell. (Source: Dahe News report; published 2026-10-04)

triage.headline_ja: 遼寧一家三人が炒り卵を食べて食中毒、保存前の水洗いが腐敗を加速させた可能性
triage.triage_reason: 家族内での単発の食中毒事例であり、公衆衛生上の広範な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にTyphoid/Paratyphoidが付与されているが、記事内容はSalmonellaによる家庭内食中毒の一般的な注意喚起記事であり、腸チフス・パラチフスの発生を示すものではない。単一家族の3名が罹患した個別事例。

article.articleHeadline: Sablayan tightens ban on live pig entry amid ASF threat
article.articleSummary: ASF outbreak threat prompts Sablayan, Occidental Mindoro, to strengthen a ban on live pig movement into Sablayan and Occidental Mindoro. On Oct. 3, authorities intercepted pig transporters in Barangay Burgos for allegedly violating Executive Order No. 63-B regulating movement of live pigs, a biosecurity measure to safeguard more than 6,006 hogs. The local government warned that unauthorized entry could incur penalties and legal action and urged cooperation to uphold biosecurity and prevent ASF spread. ASF is a highly contagious viral disease affecting domestic and wild pigs but not humans; outbreaks damage livelihoods and disrupt pork supplies. The crackdown underscores ongoing vigilance against ASF in the area, with authorities enforcing movement controls to protect local hog raisers and food security.

triage.headline_ja: サブラヤン、ASF脅威を受け生豚搬入規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: ASF（アフリカ豚熱）は動物のみに影響し人獣共通感染症ではなく、公衆衛生上の脅威は低い。地域的な家畜移動規制強化の行政対応に関する記事であり、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに低い。
triage.notes: ASFは人には感染しない動物疾病であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての緊急性は低い。畜産・経済への影響として注視対象になりうるが、感染症危機管理としてはDISMISS相当。

article.articleHeadline: ആഫ്രിക്കൻ ഒച്ചിൽ നിന്ന് രോഗബാധ; 15കാരന് മസ്തിഷ്കജ്വരം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infection from African strain; 15-year-old has encephalitis.
article.articleSummary: A 15-year-old boy in Kerala (Kottayam, at KIMS Hospital) developed high fever and sinusitis, progressing to severe meningitis/encephalitis attributed to an African strain. Despite initial antibiotic response, he developed intense headache, nausea, and signs of raised intracranial pressure two days later. Neurological exam and MRI revealed infection involving the brain’s outer coverings, with orbital involvement suggesting fungal etiology; simultaneously, blood and CSF showed markedly elevated eosinophils, arguing against typical bacterial or viral meningitis. Clinicians queried possible African exposure; the patient disclosed contact with African ostriches and regular consumption of raw vegetable salads. Consulting senior neurologist Dr. Haris and a targeted treatment plan were implemented to reduce intracranial pressure and address infection. With this approach, the patient’s condition rapidly improved and he was discharged in good health.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカマイマイからの感染;15歳少年が脳炎を発症
triage.triage_reason: 単発の稀な好酸球性髄膜脳炎（アフリカマイマイ関連の疑い）であり、患者は回復済みで公衆衛生上の重大な影響や拡大リスクは確認されていないが、情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疾患タグ『Classical Swine Fever』は記事内容と無関係で誤分類の可能性が高い。実際はアフリカマイマイ（African Land Snail）経由の寄生虫感染（好酸球性髄膜炎、Angiostrongylus cantonensis疑い）と考えられる単発症例。患者は回復・退院済みでヒト-ヒト感染の証拠なし。
